statements.name: dim_campaigns
statements.sql:
WITH campaigns AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_campaigns
),

performance AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_campaign_performance
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    c.campaign_id,
    c.campaign_name,
    c.channel,
    c.objective,
    c.starts_on,
    c.ends_on,
    (
      DATEDIFF(
        'day',
        c.starts_on,
        COALESCE(c.ends_on, '2026-03-31'::DATE)
      )
      + 1
    )::INT AS flight_days,
    CASE
      WHEN c.starts_on > '2026-03-31'::DATE
      THEN 'scheduled'
      WHEN c.ends_on < '2026-03-31'::DATE
      THEN 'ended'
      ELSE 'live'
    END::VARCHAR AS campaign_state,
    IFF(
      c.target_age_min IS NULL AND c.target_age_max IS NULL,
      'all',
      COALESCE(c.target_age_min::VARCHAR, '') || '-' || COALESCE(c.target_age_max::VARCHAR, '')
    )::VARCHAR AS target_age_range,
    c.target_regions,
    p.budget_usd,
    p.spend_usd,
    p.return_on_ad_spend,
    c.source_loaded_at
  FROM campaigns AS c
  LEFT JOIN performance AS p
    ON c.campaign_id = p.campaign_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: dim_carriers
statements.sql:
WITH carriers AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__carriers
),

rate_cards AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_carrier_rate_cards
),

sla AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_fulfilment_sla
),

current_cards AS (
  SELECT
    r.carrier_code,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT r.service_level) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r.service_level) AS service_levels,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.destination_country) AS destination_country_count,
    COUNT(*) AS active_rate_card_count
  FROM rate_cards AS r
  WHERE
    r.valid_from <= '2026-03-31'::DATE
    AND (
      r.valid_to IS NULL
      OR r.valid_to > '2026-03-31'::DATE
    )
  GROUP BY
    r.carrier_code
),

delivery_record AS (
  SELECT
    s.carrier_code,
    COUNT(*) AS shipment_count,
    AVG(IFF(s.is_dispatch_on_time, 1, 0)) AS on_time_dispatch_rate,
    MEDIAN(s.hours_to_deliver) AS median_hours_to_deliver
  FROM sla AS s
  GROUP BY
    s.carrier_code
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    c.carrier_code::VARCHAR AS carrier_code,
    c.carrier_name::VARCHAR AS carrier_name,
    c.is_express::BOOLEAN AS is_express,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(
      c.tracking_url_template,
      '^https?://([^/]+)',
      1,
      1,
      'e',
      1
    )::VARCHAR AS tracking_host,
    COALESCE(r.service_levels, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT())::ARRAY AS service_levels,
    COALESCE(r.destination_country_count, 0)::INT AS destination_country_count,
    COALESCE(r.active_rate_card_count, 0)::INT AS active_rate_card_count,
    COALESCE(d.shipment_count, 0)::INT AS shipment_count,
    ROUND(d.on_time_dispatch_rate, 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS on_time_dispatch_rate,
    ROUND(d.median_hours_to_deliver, 2)::NUMBER(10, 2) AS median_hours_to_deliver
  FROM carriers AS c
  LEFT JOIN current_cards AS r
    ON c.carrier_code = r.carrier_code
  LEFT JOIN delivery_record AS d
    ON c.carrier_code = d.carrier_code
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: dim_customers
statements.sql:
WITH customers AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_customers
),

identities AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_customer_identity
),

addresses AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_customer_address_current
),

rfm AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_customer_rfm
),

consents AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_customer_consent_state
),

tier_changes AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_loyalty_tier_changes
),

devices AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_cross_device_identity
),

current_tiers AS (
  SELECT
    t.customer_id,
    t.tier_code
  FROM tier_changes AS t
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY t.customer_id
      ORDER BY t.change_sequence DESC, t.tier_change_key DESC
    ) = 1
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    a.city,
    a.postcode_canonical,
    a.country_code,
    COALESCE(a.region_code, c.region_code)::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    i.email_domain,
    i.full_name,
    c.storefront_code,
    c.preferred_language,
    c.created_at,
    CASE
      WHEN c.birth_year IS NULL
      THEN 'unknown'
      WHEN YEAR('2026-03-31'::DATE) - c.birth_year < 25
      THEN 'under_25'
      WHEN YEAR('2026-03-31'::DATE) - c.birth_year < 40
      THEN '25_39'
      WHEN YEAR('2026-03-31'::DATE) - c.birth_year < 60
      THEN '40_59'
      ELSE '60_plus'
    END::VARCHAR AS age_band,
    COALESCE(r.order_count, 0)::INT AS order_count,
    COALESCE(r.lifetime_revenue_usd, 0)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS lifetime_revenue_usd,
    r.days_since_last_order,
    COALESCE(r.segment, 'prospect')::VARCHAR AS rfm_segment,
    COALESCE(r.is_vip, FALSE)::BOOLEAN AS is_vip,
    COALESCE(s.email_marketing, c.marketing_opt_in, FALSE)::BOOLEAN AS email_marketing,
    COALESCE(s.sms_marketing, FALSE)::BOOLEAN AS sms_marketing,
    t.tier_code AS loyalty_tier_code,
    COALESCE(d.is_multi_device, FALSE)::BOOLEAN AS is_multi_device,
    i.duplicate_candidate_id AS possible_duplicate_of,
    (
      MOD(ABS(HASH(c.customer_id)), 100) < 5
    )::BOOLEAN AS is_marketing_holdout
  FROM customers AS c
  LEFT JOIN identities AS i
    ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN addresses AS a
    ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN rfm AS r
    ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN consents AS s
    ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN current_tiers AS t
    ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN devices AS d
    ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: dim_date
statements.sql:
WITH holidays AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__holiday_calendar
),

generated AS (
  SELECT
    DATEADD(
      'day',
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SEQ4()) - 1,
      '2025-01-01'::DATE
    ) AS calendar_date
  FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT => 1095))
),

holiday_days AS (
  SELECT
    h.holiday_date,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT h.region_code) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY h.region_code) AS holiday_regions
  FROM holidays AS h
  GROUP BY
    h.holiday_date
),

attributes AS (
  SELECT
    g.calendar_date,
    DAYOFWEEKISO(g.calendar_date) AS day_of_week_iso,
    DAYNAME(g.calendar_date) AS day_name,
    YEAROFWEEKISO(g.calendar_date) AS iso_year,
    WEEKISO(g.calendar_date) AS iso_week,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', g.calendar_date) AS month_start,
    LAST_DAY(g.calendar_date, 'month') AS month_end,
    YEAR(g.calendar_date) || '-Q' || QUARTER(g.calendar_date) AS quarter_label,
    YEAR(
      DATEADD('month', 12 - 4 + 1, g.calendar_date)
    ) AS fiscal_year,
    CEIL(
      MONTH(DATEADD('month', 12 - 4 + 1, g.calendar_date)) / 3
    ) AS fiscal_quarter
  FROM generated AS g
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    a.calendar_date::DATE AS calendar_date,
    a.day_of_week_iso::INT AS day_of_week_iso,
    a.day_name::VARCHAR AS day_name,
    (
      a.day_of_week_iso >= 6
    )::BOOLEAN AS is_weekend,
    a.iso_year::INT AS iso_year,
    a.iso_week::INT AS iso_week,
    a.month_start::DATE AS month_start,
    a.month_end::DATE AS month_end,
    a.quarter_label::VARCHAR AS quarter_label,
    a.fiscal_year::INT AS fiscal_year,
    a.fiscal_quarter::INT AS fiscal_quarter,
    COALESCE(h.holiday_regions, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT())::ARRAY AS holiday_regions,
    (
      h.holiday_date IS NOT NULL
    )::BOOLEAN AS is_holiday_somewhere,
    (
      a.calendar_date <= '2026-03-31'::DATE
    )::BOOLEAN AS is_on_or_before_valuation
  FROM attributes AS a
  LEFT JOIN holiday_days AS h
    ON a.calendar_date = h.holiday_date
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: dim_products
statements.sql:
WITH catalogue AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_product_catalogue
),

products AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_products
),

margins AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_product_margin
),

supplier_costs AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_supplier_cost_current
),

reviews AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_reviews_moderated
),

wishlists AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_wishlist_demand
),

usd_margins AS (
  SELECT
    m.sku,
    m.list_price,
    m.margin_pct
  FROM margins AS m
  WHERE m.currency_code = 'USD'
),

review_stats AS (
  SELECT
    r.sku,
    COUNT(*) AS review_count,
    AVG(r.rating) AS average_rating
  FROM reviews AS r
  GROUP BY
    r.sku
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    c.sku,
    c.product_id,
    c.sku_family,
    c.title,
    c.variant_label,
    c.brand_name,
    c.is_private_label,
    c.category_level_1,
    c.category_slug_path,
    c.is_active,
    c.launched_on,
    m.list_price AS list_price_usd,
    m.margin_pct,
    s.supplier_code AS primary_supplier_code,
    COALESCE(s.supplier_count, 0)::INT AS supplier_count,
    COALESCE(r.review_count, 0)::INT AS review_count,
    ROUND(r.average_rating, 2)::NUMBER(4, 2) AS average_rating,
    COALESCE(w.wishlisting_customers, 0)::INT AS wishlisting_customers,
    p.source_loaded_at
  FROM catalogue AS c
  INNER JOIN products AS p
    ON c.product_id = p.product_id
  LEFT JOIN usd_margins AS m
    ON c.sku = m.sku
  LEFT JOIN supplier_costs AS s
    ON c.sku = s.sku
  LEFT JOIN review_stats AS r
    ON c.sku = r.sku
  LEFT JOIN wishlists AS w
    ON c.sku = w.sku
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.sql:

statements.name: dim_suppliers
statements.sql:
WITH suppliers AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_suppliers
),

lead_times AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_supplier_lead_times
),

costs AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_supplier_cost_current
),

sku_counts AS (
  SELECT
    c.supplier_code,
    COUNT(*) AS supplied_sku_count
  FROM costs AS c
  GROUP BY
    c.supplier_code
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    s.supplier_code,
    s.supplier_name,
    s.country_code,
    s.payment_terms_days,
    s.early_payment_discount_pct,
    UPPER(s.payment_terms:currency::VARCHAR)::VARCHAR AS terms_currency_code,
    LOWER(SPLIT_PART(s.primary_contact_email, '@', 2))::VARCHAR AS contact_domain,
    COALESCE(k.supplied_sku_count, 0)::INT AS supplied_sku_count,
    l.lead_time_p50_days,
    l.on_time_rate,
    l.avg_fill_rate,
    CASE
      WHEN l.on_time_rate IS NULL
      THEN 'unrated'
      WHEN l.on_time_rate >= 0.95
      AND l.avg_fill_rate >= 0.98
      THEN 'preferred'
      WHEN l.on_time_rate >= 0.8
      THEN 'approved'
      ELSE 'at_risk'
    END::VARCHAR AS performance_band,
    s.source_loaded_at
  FROM suppliers AS s
  LEFT JOIN lead_times AS l
    ON s.supplier_code = l.supplier_code
  LEFT JOIN sku_counts AS k
    ON s.supplier_code = k.supplier_code
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: dim_warehouses
statements.sql:
WITH warehouses AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_warehouses
),

bins AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_bin_locations
),

valuation AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_inventory_valuation_daily
),

slots AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_delivery_slot_utilisation
),

countries AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__countries
),

bin_counts AS (
  SELECT
    b.warehouse_code,
    COUNT(*) AS bin_count
  FROM bins AS b
  GROUP BY
    b.warehouse_code
),

latest_stock AS (
  SELECT
    v.warehouse_code,
    v.units_on_hand
  FROM valuation AS v
  WHERE v.calendar_date <= '2026-03-31'::DATE
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY v.warehouse_code
      ORDER BY v.calendar_date DESC, v.valuation_key
    ) = 1
),

slot_averages AS (
  SELECT
    s.warehouse_code,
    AVG(s.utilisation) AS average_slot_utilisation
  FROM slots AS s
  GROUP BY
    s.warehouse_code
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    w.warehouse_code,
    w.warehouse_name,
    w.country_code,
    c.region_code::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    w.iana_timezone,
    ROUND(
      DATEDIFF(
        'minute',
        '2026-03-31'::TIMESTAMP_NTZ,
        CONVERT_TIMEZONE(
          'UTC',
          w.iana_timezone,
          '2026-03-31'::TIMESTAMP_NTZ
        )
      )
      / 60,
      2
    )::NUMBER(4, 2) AS utc_offset_hours,
    w.opens_local,
    w.closes_local,
    w.opening_minutes,
    w.supports_same_day,
    w.supports_cold_chain,
    COALESCE(b.bin_count, 0)::INT AS bin_count,
    COALESCE(s.units_on_hand, 0)::INT AS units_on_hand,
    ROUND(u.average_slot_utilisation, 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS average_slot_utilisation,
    w.source_loaded_at
  FROM warehouses AS w
  LEFT JOIN countries AS c
    ON w.country_code = c.country_code
  LEFT JOIN bin_counts AS b
    ON w.warehouse_code = b.warehouse_code
  LEFT JOIN latest_stock AS s
    ON w.warehouse_code = s.warehouse_code
  LEFT JOIN slot_averages AS u
    ON w.warehouse_code = u.warehouse_code
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: fct_campaign_spend
statements.sql:
WITH spend AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_campaign_spend_usd
),

final AS (

    s.spend_id,
    s.campaign_id,
    s.channel,

    s.currency_code,
    s.spend_usd,
    s.impressions,
    s.clicks,
    s.conversions,
    s.cost_per_click_usd,
    s.is_in_flight,

      ARRAY_SIZE(ARRAY_COMPACT(s.unknown_metrics)) > 0
    )::BOOLEAN AS has_unknown_metrics
  FROM spend AS s
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: fct_inventory_daily
statements.sql:
WITH stock AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_stock_on_hand_daily
),

costs AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_supplier_cost_current
),

windowed AS (
  SELECT
    s.stock_day_key,
    s.sku,
    s.warehouse_code,
    s.calendar_date,
    s.on_hand_qty,
    s.is_stocked_out,
    s.days_since_count
  FROM stock AS s
  WHERE
    s.calendar_date >= TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ('2026-01-01 00:00:00')
    AND s.calendar_date < TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ('2026-01-02 00:00:00')
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    w.stock_day_key,
    w.sku,
    w.warehouse_code,
    w.calendar_date,
    w.on_hand_qty,
    c.unit_cost_usd,
    ROUND(GREATEST(w.on_hand_qty, 0) * c.unit_cost_usd, 2)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS stock_value_usd,
    w.is_stocked_out,
    w.days_since_count,
    COALESCE(w.days_since_count > 90, TRUE)::BOOLEAN AS is_count_overdue
  FROM windowed AS w
  LEFT JOIN costs AS c
    ON w.sku = c.sku
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: fct_ledger_month_end
statements.sql:
WITH balances AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_ledger_balances_daily
),

fx_rates AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
),

month_ends AS (
  SELECT
    b.account_code,
    b.account_class,
    b.currency_code,
    b.calendar_date AS month_end,
    LAST_DAY(b.calendar_date) AS month_last_day,
    b.closing_balance,
    b.is_normal_side
  FROM balances AS b
  WHERE
    b.is_month_end
    OR b.calendar_date = '2026-03-31'::DATE
),

month_flows AS (
  SELECT
    b.account_code,
    b.currency_code,
    LAST_DAY(b.calendar_date) AS month_last_day,
    SUM(b.debit_minor) AS month_debit_minor,
    SUM(b.credit_minor) AS month_credit_minor
  FROM balances AS b
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2,
    3
),

with_rate AS (
  SELECT
    m.account_code,
    m.account_class,
    m.currency_code,
    m.month_end,
    m.month_last_day,
    m.closing_balance,
    m.is_normal_side,
    fx.rate_to_usd
  FROM month_ends AS m
  ASOF JOIN fx_rates AS fx MATCH_CONDITION (m.month_end >= fx.rate_date)
    ON m.currency_code = fx.currency_code
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      w.account_code || ':' || w.currency_code || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(w.month_end, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    )::VARCHAR AS ledger_month_key,
    w.account_code,
    w.account_class,
    w.currency_code,
    w.month_end,
    COALESCE(f.month_debit_minor, 0)::INT AS month_debit_minor,
    COALESCE(f.month_credit_minor, 0)::INT AS month_credit_minor,
    w.closing_balance,
    ROUND(w.closing_balance * w.rate_to_usd, 2)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS closing_balance_usd,
    w.is_normal_side
  FROM with_rate AS w
  LEFT JOIN month_flows AS f
    ON w.account_code = f.account_code
    AND w.currency_code = f.currency_code
    AND w.month_last_day = f.month_last_day
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: fct_order_lines
statements.sql:
WITH priced AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_order_lines_priced
),

discounted AS (

  FROM rel__int_order_lines_discounted
),

catalogue AS (

final AS (
  SELECT
    p.order_line_id,
    p.order_id,
    p.sku,
    p.sku_family,
    c.category_level_1,
    p.quantity,
    p.unit_amount_minor,
    p.list_amount_minor,
    p.markdown_pct,
    p.gross_amount_minor,
    p.discount_amount_minor,
    p.net_amount_minor,
    p.tax_amount_minor,
    COALESCE(d.promo_codes, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT())::ARRAY AS promo_codes,
    COALESCE(d.has_stacked_promotions, FALSE)::BOOLEAN AS has_stacked_promotions,
    p.line_weight_kg
  FROM priced AS p
  LEFT JOIN discounted AS d
    ON p.order_line_id = d.order_line_id
  LEFT JOIN catalogue AS c

statements.name: fct_orders
statements.sql:
WITH orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_orders_usd
),

timelines AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_order_status_timeline
),

payments AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_order_payments_rollup
),

sequence AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_customer_order_sequence
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.region_code,
    o.placed_at,
    o.placed_date_local,
    o.order_status,
    o.sales_channel,
    o.units,
    o.currency_code,
    o.amount,
    o.amount_usd,
    o.rate_to_usd,
    o.rate_date,
    o.gross_amount_usd,
    o.discount_amount_usd,
    o.tax_amount_usd,
    o.promo_code,
    o.utm_source,
    o.utm_medium,
    o.utm_campaign,
    o.basket_size,
    s.order_number,
    COALESCE(s.is_first_order, FALSE)::BOOLEAN AS is_first_order,
    t.first_paid_at,
    t.first_delivered_at,
    t.hours_paid_to_shipped,
    COALESCE(p.captured_minor, 0)::INT AS captured_minor,
    COALESCE(p.refunded_minor, 0)::INT AS refunded_minor,
    COALESCE(p.net_collected_minor, 0)::INT AS net_collected_minor,
    (
      COALESCE(p.captured_minor, 0) > 0
      AND COALESCE(p.refunded_minor, 0) >= p.captured_minor
    )::BOOLEAN AS is_fully_refunded
  FROM orders AS o
  LEFT JOIN timelines AS t
    ON o.order_id = t.order_id
  LEFT JOIN payments AS p
    ON o.order_id = p.order_id
  LEFT JOIN sequence AS s
    ON o.order_id = s.order_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: fct_partner_orders
statements.sql:
WITH partner_orders AS (

final AS (

    o.currency_code,
    o.placed_at_utc,

statements.name: fct_payments
statements.sql:
WITH attempts AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_payment_attempts
),

fx_rates AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
),

currencies AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__currencies
),

with_exponent AS (
  SELECT
    a.payment_id,
    a.order_id,
    a.attempt_number,
    a.is_final_attempt,
    a.payment_method,
    a.authorised_at,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', a.authorised_at)::DATE AS authorised_date,
    a.is_successful,
    a.decline_family,
    a.risk_band,
    a.card_scheme,
    a.had_chargeback,
    a.currency_code,
    a.amount_minor,
    c.minor_unit_exponent
  FROM attempts AS a
  INNER JOIN currencies AS c
    ON a.currency_code = c.currency_code
),

with_rate AS (
  SELECT
    w.payment_id,
    w.order_id,
    w.attempt_number,
    w.is_final_attempt,
    w.payment_method,
    w.authorised_at,
    w.is_successful,
    w.decline_family,
    w.risk_band,
    w.card_scheme,
    w.had_chargeback,
    w.currency_code,
    w.amount_minor,
    w.minor_unit_exponent,
    fx.rate_to_usd
  FROM with_exponent AS w
  ASOF JOIN fx_rates AS fx MATCH_CONDITION (w.authorised_date >= fx.rate_date)
    ON w.currency_code = fx.currency_code
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    r.payment_id,
    r.order_id,
    r.attempt_number,
    r.is_final_attempt,
    r.payment_method,
    r.authorised_at,
    r.is_successful,
    r.decline_family,
    r.risk_band,
    r.card_scheme,
    r.had_chargeback,
    r.currency_code,
    ROUND((
  (r.amount_minor) / NULLIF((POWER(10, (r.minor_unit_exponent))::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 6)::NUMBER(38, 6) AS amount,
  ROUND(
    (ROUND((
  (r.amount_minor) / NULLIF((POWER(10, (r.minor_unit_exponent))::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 6)::NUMBER(38, 6)) * r.rate_to_usd,
    2
  )::NUMBER(18, 2) AS amount_usd
  FROM with_rate AS r
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: fct_shipments
statements.sql:
WITH shipments AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_shipments
),

sla AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_fulfilment_sla
),

packages AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_shipment_costs
),

exceptions AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_delivery_exceptions_classified
),

package_totals AS (
  SELECT
    p.shipment_id,
    COUNT(*) AS package_count,
    SUM(p.chargeable_weight_kg) AS chargeable_weight_kg,
    SUM(p.rate_minor) AS rate_minor
  FROM packages AS p
  GROUP BY
    p.shipment_id
),

exception_totals AS (
  SELECT
    e.shipment_id,
    COUNT(*) AS exception_count,
    SUM(e.compensation_usd) AS compensation_usd
  FROM exceptions AS e
  GROUP BY
    e.shipment_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    s.shipment_id,
    s.order_id,
    CASE
      WHEN s.warehouse_code IS NULL
      THEN 'partner'
      WHEN s.service_level ILIKE '%collect%'
      THEN 'click_and_collect'
      ELSE 'home_delivery'
    END::VARCHAR AS fulfilment_method,
    s.warehouse_code,
    s.carrier_code,
    s.service_level,
    s.shipped_at,
    s.delivered_at,
    l.business_days_to_ship,
    l.is_dispatch_on_time,
    l.hours_to_deliver,
    COALESCE(p.package_count, 0)::INT AS package_count,
    p.chargeable_weight_kg::NUMBER(10, 3) AS chargeable_weight_kg,
    p.rate_minor::INT AS rate_minor,
    COALESCE(e.exception_count, 0)::INT AS exception_count,
    COALESCE(e.compensation_usd, 0)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS compensation_usd,
    s.tracking_event_count
  FROM shipments AS s
  LEFT JOIN sla AS l
    ON s.shipment_id = l.shipment_id
  LEFT JOIN package_totals AS p
    ON s.shipment_id = p.shipment_id
  LEFT JOIN exception_totals AS e
    ON s.shipment_id = e.shipment_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: fct_support_tickets
statements.sql:
WITH tickets AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_tickets
),

first_responses AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_ticket_first_response
),

business_hours AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_ticket_business_hours
),

breaches AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_ticket_sla_breaches
),

threads AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_ticket_threads
),

chats AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_chat_sentiment
),

history AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_customer_support_history
),

changed_tickets AS (
  SELECT
    t.ticket_id,
    t.channel,
    t.ticket_status,
    t.contact_reason,
    t.solved_at,
    t.source_loaded_at
  FROM tickets AS t
  WHERE
    t.source_loaded_at >= TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ('2026-01-01 00:00:00')
    AND t.source_loaded_at < TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ('2026-01-02 00:00:00')
),

ticket_sentiment AS (
  SELECT
    c.ticket_id,
    MIN_BY(c.sentiment_label, c.sentiment_score) AS sentiment_label
  FROM chats AS c
  WHERE c.ticket_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    c.ticket_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    t.ticket_id,
    h.customer_id,
    t.channel,
    b.priority,
    t.ticket_status,
    t.contact_reason,
    f.created_at_utc,
    t.solved_at,
    f.minutes_to_first_response,
    bh.business_minutes_to_response,
    COALESCE(b.is_first_response_breached, FALSE)::BOOLEAN AS is_first_response_breached,
    COALESCE(b.is_resolution_breached, FALSE)::BOOLEAN AS is_resolution_breached,
    COALESCE(th.comment_count, 0)::INT AS comment_count,
    COALESCE(th.handoff_count, 0)::INT AS handoff_count,
    s.sentiment_label::VARCHAR AS sentiment_label,
    h.ticket_number_for_customer,
    COALESCE(h.is_repeat_contact_7d, FALSE)::BOOLEAN AS is_repeat_contact_7d,
    h.csat_score,
    t.source_loaded_at
  FROM changed_tickets AS t
  LEFT JOIN first_responses AS f
    ON t.ticket_id = f.ticket_id
  LEFT JOIN business_hours AS bh
    ON t.ticket_id = bh.ticket_id
  LEFT JOIN breaches AS b
    ON t.ticket_id = b.ticket_id
  LEFT JOIN threads AS th
    ON t.ticket_id = th.ticket_id
  LEFT JOIN ticket_sentiment AS s
    ON t.ticket_id = s.ticket_id
  LEFT JOIN history AS h
    ON t.ticket_id = h.ticket_id
)

FROM final

statements.name: int_affiliate_commissions_usd
statements.sql:
WITH conversions AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_affiliate_conversions
),

orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_orders_usd
),

fx_rates AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
),

currencies AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__currencies
),

ranked_claims AS (
  SELECT
    c.conversion_id,
    c.affiliate_code,
    c.order_id,
    c.commission_minor,
    c.currency_code,
    c.converted_at,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', c.converted_at)::DATE AS converted_date,
    c.click_to_conversion_hours,
    c.sub_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.order_id
      ORDER BY c.clicked_at DESC NULLS LAST, c.conversion_id
    ) AS claim_rank,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY c.order_id) AS claims_on_order
  FROM conversions AS c
),

parsed_codes AS (
  SELECT
    r.conversion_id,
    UPPER(
      COALESCE(REGEXP_SUBSTR(r.affiliate_code, '^([A-Za-z]{2,5})[-_]', 1, 1, 'e', 1), 'DIRECT')
    ) AS affiliate_network,
    LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(
      REGEXP_SUBSTR(r.sub_id, '^[a-zA-Z]+'),
      '[^a-z]',
      ''
    )) AS sub_channel
  FROM ranked_claims AS r
),

with_exponent AS (
  SELECT
    r.conversion_id,
    r.affiliate_code,
    r.order_id,
    r.commission_minor,
    r.currency_code,
    r.converted_at,
    r.converted_date,
    r.click_to_conversion_hours,
    r.claim_rank,
    r.claims_on_order,
    cur.minor_unit_exponent
  FROM ranked_claims AS r
  LEFT JOIN currencies AS cur
    ON r.currency_code = cur.currency_code
),

with_rate AS (
  SELECT
    w.conversion_id,
    w.affiliate_code,
    w.order_id,
    w.commission_minor,
    w.converted_at,
    w.click_to_conversion_hours,
    w.claim_rank,
    w.claims_on_order,
    w.minor_unit_exponent,
    fx.rate_to_usd
  FROM with_exponent AS w
  ASOF JOIN fx_rates AS fx MATCH_CONDITION (w.converted_date >= fx.rate_date)
    ON w.currency_code = fx.currency_code
),

with_order AS (
  SELECT
    w.conversion_id,
    w.affiliate_code,
    p.affiliate_network,
    p.sub_channel,
    w.order_id,
    w.converted_at,
    w.click_to_conversion_hours,
    ROUND((
  w.commission_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, COALESCE(w.minor_unit_exponent, 2))::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 6)::NUMBER(38, 6) AS commission,
    w.rate_to_usd,
    w.claim_rank,
    w.claims_on_order,
    o.amount_usd AS order_amount_usd,
    o.order_status
  FROM with_rate AS w
  INNER JOIN parsed_codes AS p
    ON w.conversion_id = p.conversion_id
  LEFT JOIN orders AS o
    ON w.order_id = o.order_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    o.conversion_id,
    o.affiliate_code,
    o.affiliate_network::VARCHAR AS affiliate_network,
    NULLIF(o.sub_channel, '')::VARCHAR AS sub_channel,
    o.order_id,
    o.converted_at,
    o.click_to_conversion_hours,
    o.commission::NUMBER(38, 6) AS commission,
    ROUND(o.commission * o.rate_to_usd, 2)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS commission_usd,
    o.order_amount_usd,
    ROUND(
      o.commission * o.rate_to_usd / NULLIF(o.order_amount_usd, 0),
      6
    )::NUMBER(9, 6) AS commission_rate,
    o.claims_on_order::INT AS claims_on_order,
    (
      o.claim_rank = 1
    )::BOOLEAN AS is_last_click,
    COALESCE(o.order_status IN ('CANCELLED', 'RETURNED'), FALSE)::BOOLEAN AS is_reversible,
    IFF(
      o.claim_rank = 1 AND COALESCE(o.order_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'RETURNED'), FALSE),
      ROUND(o.commission * o.rate_to_usd, 2),
      0
    )::NUMBER(18, 2) AS payable_commission_usd
  FROM with_order AS o
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_agent_utilisation
statements.sql:
WITH shifts AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_agent_shifts
),

agents AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_agents
),

calls AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_call_records
),

first_responses AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_ticket_first_response
),

shifts_utc AS (
  SELECT
    s.shift_id,
    s.agent_id,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE(s.iana_timezone, 'UTC', s.shift_start_local)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS shift_start_utc,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE(s.iana_timezone, 'UTC', s.shift_end_local)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS shift_end_utc,
    s.scheduled_minutes - s.break_minutes AS productive_minutes,
    (
      s.shift_end_local::DATE > s.shift_start_local::DATE
    ) AS is_overnight
  FROM shifts AS s
),

calls_in_shift AS (
  SELECT
    su.shift_id,
    COUNT(c.call_id) AS calls_handled,
    SUM(c.duration_seconds) / 60 AS call_minutes
  FROM shifts_utc AS su
  INNER JOIN calls AS c
    ON su.agent_id = c.agent_id
  WHERE
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE(
      'UTC',
      c.started_at
    )::TIMESTAMP_NTZ BETWEEN su.shift_start_utc AND su.shift_end_utc
  GROUP BY
    su.shift_id
),

responses_in_shift AS (
  SELECT
    su.shift_id,
    COUNT(f.ticket_id) AS tickets_first_responded
  FROM shifts_utc AS su
  INNER JOIN first_responses AS f
    ON su.agent_id = f.first_responder_id
    AND f.first_response_at_utc >= su.shift_start_utc
    AND f.first_response_at_utc < su.shift_end_utc
  GROUP BY
    su.shift_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    su.shift_id,
    su.agent_id,
    a.team_code,
    su.shift_start_utc,
    su.shift_end_utc,
    su.productive_minutes::INT AS productive_minutes,
    ROUND(COALESCE(c.call_minutes, 0), 2)::NUMBER(10, 2) AS call_minutes,
    COALESCE(c.calls_handled, 0)::INT AS calls_handled,
    COALESCE(r.tickets_first_responded, 0)::INT AS tickets_first_responded,
    ROUND(
      (
        COALESCE(c.call_minutes, 0) + 6 * COALESCE(r.tickets_first_responded, 0)
      )
      / NULLIF(su.productive_minutes, 0),
      4
    )::NUMBER(9, 4) AS utilisation,
    su.is_overnight
  FROM shifts_utc AS su
  LEFT JOIN agents AS a
    ON su.agent_id = a.agent_id
  LEFT JOIN calls_in_shift AS c
    ON su.shift_id = c.shift_id
  LEFT JOIN responses_in_shift AS r
    ON su.shift_id = r.shift_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_app_sessions
statements.sql:
WITH app_events AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_app_events
),

device_events AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    e.device_id,
    e.customer_id,
    e.platform,
    e.app_major_version,
    e.event_name,
    e.event_at_utc,
    IFF(COALESCE(DATEDIFF(
      'minute',
      LAG(e.event_at_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY e.device_id ORDER BY e.event_at_utc, e.event_id),
      e.event_at_utc
    ), 999) > 30, 1, 0) AS starts_session
  FROM app_events AS e
  WHERE
    e.device_id IS NOT NULL
    AND e.event_at_utc IS NOT NULL
),

numbered AS (
  SELECT
    d.device_id,
    d.customer_id,
    d.platform,
    d.app_major_version,
    d.event_name,
    d.event_at_utc,
    d.starts_session,
    SUM(d.starts_session) OVER (
      PARTITION BY d.device_id
      ORDER BY d.event_at_utc, d.event_id
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS session_number
  FROM device_events AS d
),

sessions AS (
  SELECT
    n.device_id,
    MAX(n.customer_id) AS customer_id,
    ANY_VALUE(n.platform) AS platform,
    MAX(n.app_major_version) AS app_major_version,
    MIN(n.event_at_utc) AS session_start_utc,
    MAX(n.event_at_utc) AS session_end_utc,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    COUNT_IF(n.event_name = 'screen_view') AS screen_count,
    BOOLOR_AGG(n.starts_session = 1 AND n.event_name = 'push_open') AS started_from_push
  FROM numbered AS n
  GROUP BY
    n.device_id,
    n.session_number
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      s.device_id || ':' || TO_CHAR(s.session_start_utc, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
    )::VARCHAR AS app_session_id,
    s.device_id,
    s.customer_id::VARCHAR AS customer_id,
    s.platform::VARCHAR AS platform,
    s.app_major_version::INT AS app_major_version,
    s.session_start_utc,
    s.session_end_utc,
    DATEDIFF('second', s.session_start_utc, s.session_end_utc)::INT AS duration_seconds,
    s.event_count::INT AS event_count,
    s.screen_count::INT AS screen_count,
    s.started_from_push::BOOLEAN AS started_from_push
  FROM sessions AS s
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_bundle_pricing
statements.sql:
WITH bundles AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_bundles
),

components AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_bundle_components
),

price_history AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_price_history
),

current_prices AS (
  SELECT
    ph.sku,
    ph.currency_code,
    ph.list_amount_minor
  FROM price_history AS ph
  WHERE ph.effective_valid_to IS NULL
),

required_components AS (
  SELECT
    c.bundle_sku,
    c.component_sku,
    c.quantity
  FROM components AS c
  WHERE NOT c.is_optional
),

priced_components AS (
  SELECT
    rc.bundle_sku,
    cp.currency_code,
    rc.quantity * cp.list_amount_minor AS extended_minor,
    cp.list_amount_minor AS unit_list_minor
  FROM required_components AS rc
  INNER JOIN current_prices AS cp
    ON rc.component_sku = cp.sku
),

component_counts AS (
  SELECT
    rc.bundle_sku,
    COUNT(*) AS component_count
  FROM required_components AS rc
  GROUP BY
    rc.bundle_sku
),

totals AS (
  SELECT
    pc.bundle_sku,
    pc.currency_code,
    COUNT(*) AS priced_count,
    SUM(pc.extended_minor) AS components_list_minor,
    MIN(pc.unit_list_minor) AS cheapest_unit_minor
  FROM priced_components AS pc
  GROUP BY
    pc.bundle_sku,
    pc.currency_code
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      t.bundle_sku || ':' || t.currency_code
    )::VARCHAR AS bundle_price_key,
    t.bundle_sku,
    t.currency_code,
    cc.component_count::INT AS component_count,
    t.components_list_minor::INT AS components_list_minor,
    CASE b.pricing_mode
      WHEN 'fixed'
      THEN IFF(b.pricing_currency_code = t.currency_code, b.fixed_amount_minor, NULL)
      WHEN 'percent_off'
      THEN ROUND(t.components_list_minor
      * (
        1 - b.percent_off / 100
      ))
      WHEN 'cheapest_free'
      THEN t.components_list_minor - t.cheapest_unit_minor
    END::INT AS bundle_price_minor,
    (
      t.components_list_minor
      - CASE b.pricing_mode
        WHEN 'fixed'
        THEN IFF(b.pricing_currency_code = t.currency_code, b.fixed_amount_minor, NULL)
        WHEN 'percent_off'
        THEN ROUND(t.components_list_minor
        * (
          1 - b.percent_off / 100
        ))
        WHEN 'cheapest_free'
        THEN t.components_list_minor - t.cheapest_unit_minor
      END
    )::INT AS saving_minor,
    ROUND(
      100
      * (
        1
        - CASE b.pricing_mode
          WHEN 'fixed'
          THEN IFF(b.pricing_currency_code = t.currency_code, b.fixed_amount_minor, NULL)
          WHEN 'percent_off'
          THEN ROUND(t.components_list_minor
          * (
            1 - b.percent_off / 100
          ))
          WHEN 'cheapest_free'
          THEN t.components_list_minor - t.cheapest_unit_minor
        END
        / NULLIF(t.components_list_minor, 0)
      ),
      4
    )::NUMBER(9, 4) AS saving_pct,
    (
      t.priced_count < cc.component_count
    ) AS has_unpriced_component
  FROM totals AS t
  INNER JOIN bundles AS b
    ON t.bundle_sku = b.bundle_sku
  INNER JOIN component_counts AS cc
    ON t.bundle_sku = cc.bundle_sku
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_call_ivr_paths
statements.sql:
WITH calls AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_call_records
),

call_paths AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__support__call_records
),

latest_paths AS (
  SELECT
    p.call_id,
    p.ivr_path
  FROM call_paths AS p
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.call_id ORDER BY p._seq DESC) = 1
),

steps AS (
  SELECT
    l.call_id,
    s.index AS step_index,
    LOWER(s.value::VARCHAR) AS menu_node
  FROM latest_paths AS l, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => l.ivr_path) AS s
),

step_summary AS (
  SELECT
    s.call_id,
    MIN_BY(s.menu_node, s.step_index) AS first_menu_choice,
    MAX_BY(s.menu_node, s.step_index) AS final_menu_node,
    COUNT(*) AS menu_steps,
    COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT s.menu_node) AS repeated_menu_visits
  FROM steps AS s
  GROUP BY
    s.call_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    c.call_id,
    c.ticket_id,
    c.agent_id,
    s.first_menu_choice::VARCHAR AS first_menu_choice,
    s.final_menu_node::VARCHAR AS final_menu_node,
    COALESCE(s.menu_steps, 0)::INT AS menu_steps,
    COALESCE(s.repeated_menu_visits, 0)::INT AS repeated_menu_visits,
    (
      c.agent_id IS NULL
      AND COALESCE(s.final_menu_node, '') NOT IN ('self_service_complete', 'callback_booked')
    ) AS abandoned_in_ivr,
    CASE c.caller_country_prefix
      WHEN '1'
      THEN 'US'
      WHEN '81'
      THEN 'APAC'
      WHEN '61'
      THEN 'APAC'
      WHEN '965'
      THEN 'MENA'
      ELSE 'EU'
    END::VARCHAR AS caller_region,
    CASE
      WHEN c.duration_seconds < 60
      THEN 'under_1m'
      WHEN c.duration_seconds < 300
      THEN '1_to_5m'
      WHEN c.duration_seconds < 900
      THEN '5_to_15m'
      ELSE 'over_15m'
    END::VARCHAR AS duration_bucket
  FROM calls AS c
  LEFT JOIN step_summary AS s
    ON c.call_id = s.call_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_campaign_performance
statements.sql:
WITH campaigns AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_campaigns
),

spend AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_campaign_spend_usd
),

sessions AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_session_attribution
),

orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_orders_usd
),

emails AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_email_engagement
),

fx_rates AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
),

currencies AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__currencies
),

campaign_keys AS (
  SELECT
    c.campaign_id,
    LOWER(c.campaign_id) AS utm_campaign_key,
    c.campaign_name,
    c.channel,
    c.objective,
    c.starts_on,
    c.ends_on,
    c.budget_minor,
    c.currency_code,
    c.target_regions
  FROM campaigns AS c
),

budget_rate AS (
  SELECT
    k.campaign_id,
    ROUND(
      (ROUND((
  k.budget_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, cur.minor_unit_exponent)::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 6)::NUMBER(38, 6)) * fx.rate_to_usd,
      2
    ) AS budget_usd
  FROM campaign_keys AS k
  INNER JOIN currencies AS cur
    ON k.currency_code = cur.currency_code
  ASOF JOIN fx_rates AS fx MATCH_CONDITION (k.starts_on >= fx.rate_date)
    ON k.currency_code = fx.currency_code
),

target_regions AS (
  SELECT
    k.campaign_id,
    COUNT(r.value) AS target_region_count,
    ARRAY_AGG(
      IFF(COALESCE((r.value::VARCHAR) IN ('EU', 'US', 'APAC', 'MENA'), FALSE), NULL, r.value::VARCHAR)
    ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r.value::VARCHAR) AS unsupported_target_regions
  FROM campaign_keys AS k, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => k.target_regions) AS r
  GROUP BY
    k.campaign_id
),

touches AS (
  SELECT
    s.campaign_id::VARCHAR AS campaign_id,
    'paid'::VARCHAR AS touch_type,
    COALESCE(s.clicks, 0)::INT AS touch_count
  FROM spend AS s
  WHERE s.campaign_id IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    e.campaign_id::VARCHAR AS campaign_id,
    'email'::VARCHAR AS touch_type,
    e.click_count::INT AS touch_count
  FROM emails AS e
  WHERE
    e.campaign_id IS NOT NULL
    AND e.click_count > 0
),

touch_totals AS (
  SELECT
    t.campaign_id,
    SUM(IFF(t.touch_type = 'paid', t.touch_count, 0)) AS paid_clicks,
    SUM(IFF(t.touch_type = 'email', t.touch_count, 0)) AS email_clicks
  FROM touches AS t
  GROUP BY
    t.campaign_id
),

spend_totals AS (
  SELECT
    s.campaign_id,
    SUM(s.spend_usd) AS spend_usd
  FROM spend AS s
  GROUP BY
    s.campaign_id
),

session_totals AS (
  SELECT
    s.utm_campaign,
    COUNT(*) AS attributed_sessions
  FROM sessions AS s
  WHERE s.utm_campaign IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    s.utm_campaign
),

order_totals AS (
  SELECT
    o.utm_campaign,
    COUNT(*) AS attributed_orders,
    SUM(o.amount_usd) AS attributed_revenue_usd
  FROM orders AS o
  WHERE
    o.utm_campaign IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'PENDING')
  GROUP BY
    o.utm_campaign
),

combined AS (
  SELECT
    k.campaign_id,
    k.campaign_name,
    k.channel,
    k.objective,
    k.starts_on,
    k.ends_on,
    b.budget_usd,
    COALESCE(sp.spend_usd, 0) AS spend_usd,
    COALESCE(t.paid_clicks, 0) AS paid_clicks,
    COALESCE(t.email_clicks, 0) AS email_clicks,
    COALESCE(st.attributed_sessions, 0) AS attributed_sessions,
    COALESCE(ot.attributed_orders, 0) AS attributed_orders,
    COALESCE(ot.attributed_revenue_usd, 0) AS attributed_revenue_usd,
    COALESCE(tr.target_region_count, 0) AS target_region_count,
    COALESCE(tr.unsupported_target_regions, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT()) AS unsupported_target_regions
  FROM campaign_keys AS k
  LEFT JOIN budget_rate AS b
    ON k.campaign_id = b.campaign_id
  LEFT JOIN spend_totals AS sp
    ON k.campaign_id = sp.campaign_id
  LEFT JOIN touch_totals AS t
    ON k.campaign_id = t.campaign_id
  LEFT JOIN session_totals AS st
    ON k.utm_campaign_key = st.utm_campaign
  LEFT JOIN order_totals AS ot
    ON k.utm_campaign_key = ot.utm_campaign
  LEFT JOIN target_regions AS tr
    ON k.campaign_id = tr.campaign_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    c.campaign_id,
    c.campaign_name,
    c.channel,
    c.objective,
    c.starts_on,
    c.ends_on,
    c.budget_usd::NUMBER(18, 2) AS budget_usd,
    c.spend_usd::NUMBER(18, 2) AS spend_usd,
    ROUND(100 * c.spend_usd / NULLIF(c.budget_usd, 0), 2)::NUMBER(9, 2) AS budget_used_pct,
    c.paid_clicks::INT AS paid_clicks,
    c.email_clicks::INT AS email_clicks,
    c.attributed_sessions::INT AS attributed_sessions,
    c.attributed_orders::INT AS attributed_orders,
    c.attributed_revenue_usd::NUMBER(18, 2) AS attributed_revenue_usd,
    ROUND(
      c.attributed_revenue_usd / NULLIF(c.spend_usd, 0),
      4
    )::NUMBER(12, 4) AS return_on_ad_spend,
    c.target_region_count::INT AS target_region_count,
    c.unsupported_target_regions::ARRAY AS unsupported_target_regions,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.channel
      ORDER BY c.spend_usd DESC
    )::INT AS spend_rank_in_channel
  FROM combined AS c
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_campaign_spend_usd
statements.sql:
WITH spend AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_campaign_spend
),

campaigns AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_campaigns
),

fx_rates AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
),

report_headers AS (
  SELECT
    s.spend_id,
    s.spend_date,
    s.channel,
    s.campaign_id,
    s.currency_code,
    s.platform_account_id
  FROM spend AS s
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.spend_id ORDER BY s.spend_metric_key) = 1
),

metric_values AS (
  SELECT
    s.spend_id,
    MAX(IFF(s.metric_name = 'spend', s.metric_value, NULL)) AS spend_amount,
    MAX(IFF(s.metric_name = 'impressions', s.metric_value, NULL)) AS impressions,
    MAX(IFF(s.metric_name IN ('clicks', 'link_clicks'), s.metric_value, NULL)) AS clicks,
    MAX(
      IFF(REGEXP_LIKE(s.metric_name, '^(conversions|purchases)(_[0-9]+d)?$'), s.metric_value, NULL)
    ) AS conversions,
    COUNT(*) AS metric_count,
    ARRAY_AGG(
      DISTINCT IFF(
        REGEXP_LIKE(
          s.metric_name,
          '^(spend|impressions|clicks|link_clicks|conversions|purchases)(_[0-9]+d)?$'
        ),
        NULL,
        s.metric_name
      )
    ) WITHIN GROUP (
      ORDER BY IFF(
        REGEXP_LIKE(
          s.metric_name,
          '^(spend|impressions|clicks|link_clicks|conversions|purchases)(_[0-9]+d)?$'
        ),
        NULL,
        s.metric_name
      )
    ) AS unknown_metrics
  FROM spend AS s
  GROUP BY
    s.spend_id
),

reports AS (
  SELECT
    h.spend_id,
    h.spend_date,
    h.channel,
    h.campaign_id,
    h.currency_code,
    h.platform_account_id,
    m.spend_amount,
    m.impressions,
    m.clicks,
    m.conversions,
    m.metric_count,
    m.unknown_metrics
  FROM report_headers AS h
  INNER JOIN metric_values AS m
    ON h.spend_id = m.spend_id
),

with_rate AS (
  SELECT
    r.spend_id,
    r.spend_date,
    r.channel,
    r.campaign_id,
    r.currency_code,
    r.platform_account_id,
    r.spend_amount,
    r.impressions,
    r.clicks,
    r.conversions,
    r.metric_count,
    r.unknown_metrics,
    fx.rate_to_usd
  FROM reports AS r
  ASOF JOIN fx_rates AS fx MATCH_CONDITION (r.spend_date >= fx.rate_date)
    ON r.currency_code = fx.currency_code
),

with_campaign AS (
  SELECT
    w.spend_id,
    w.campaign_id,
    c.campaign_name,
    COALESCE(w.channel, c.channel) AS channel,
    w.platform_account_id,
    w.spend_date,
    w.currency_code,
    w.spend_amount,
    w.spend_amount * w.rate_to_usd AS spend_usd_unrounded,
    w.impressions,
    w.clicks,
    w.conversions,
    w.metric_count,
    w.unknown_metrics,
    COALESCE(
      w.spend_date BETWEEN c.starts_on AND COALESCE(c.ends_on, '2026-03-31'::DATE),
      FALSE
    ) AS is_in_flight
  FROM with_rate AS w
  LEFT JOIN campaigns AS c
    ON w.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    c.spend_id,
    c.campaign_id,
    c.campaign_name::VARCHAR AS campaign_name,
    c.channel::VARCHAR AS channel,
    c.platform_account_id,
    c.spend_date,
    c.currency_code,
    c.spend_amount::NUMBER(38, 6) AS spend_amount,
    ROUND(c.spend_usd_unrounded, 2, 'HALF_TO_EVEN')::NUMBER(18, 2) AS spend_usd,
    c.impressions::INT AS impressions,
    c.clicks::INT AS clicks,
    c.conversions::INT AS conversions,
    ROUND(c.clicks / NULLIF(c.impressions, 0), 6)::NUMBER(9, 6) AS click_through_rate,
    ROUND(c.spend_usd_unrounded / NULLIF(c.clicks, 0), 4)::NUMBER(18, 4) AS cost_per_click_usd,
    c.metric_count::INT AS metric_count,
    c.unknown_metrics::ARRAY AS unknown_metrics,
    c.is_in_flight::BOOLEAN AS is_in_flight
  FROM with_campaign AS c
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_carrier_webhook_events
statements.sql:
WITH webhooks AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_carrier_webhooks
),

shipments AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_shipments
),

first_delivery AS (
  SELECT
    w.carrier_update_key,
    w.carrier_code,
    w.tracking_number,
    w.status_code,
    w.status_at,
    w.received_at,
    w.is_batched
  FROM webhooks AS w
  WHERE w.tracking_number IS NOT NULL
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY w.carrier_code, COALESCE(w.carrier_event_id::VARCHAR, w.carrier_update_key)
      ORDER BY w.received_at, w.carrier_update_key
    ) = 1
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    f.carrier_update_key,
    s.shipment_id,
    f.carrier_code,
    f.status_code,
    f.status_at,
    f.received_at,
    DATEDIFF(
      'minute',
      CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', f.status_at)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ,
      f.received_at
    )::INT AS receive_lag_minutes,
    f.is_batched
  FROM first_delivery AS f
  INNER JOIN shipments AS s
    ON f.tracking_number = s.tracking_number
    AND f.carrier_code = s.carrier_code
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_cart_funnel
statements.sql:
WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_web_sessions
),

web_events AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_web_events
),

checkout_steps AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_web_checkout_steps
),

cart_events AS (
  SELECT
    e.anonymous_id,
    e.event_at_utc,
    e.event_type,
    FILTER(
      e.items,
      i -> i:sku IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(i:quantity::INT, 1) > 0
    ) AS valid_items
  FROM web_events AS e
  WHERE e.event_type IN ('add_to_cart', 'remove_from_cart')
),

session_cart AS (
  SELECT
    s.session_id,
    ARRAY_AGG(IFF(c.event_type = 'add_to_cart', c.valid_items, NULL)) AS added_item_lists,
    SUM(IFF(c.event_type = 'remove_from_cart', ARRAY_SIZE(c.valid_items), 0)) AS removed_sku_count,
    SUM(IFF(c.event_type = 'add_to_cart', 1, -1)
    * REDUCE(
      TRANSFORM(
        c.valid_items,
        i -> COALESCE(i:quantity::INT, 1)
      ),
      0,
      (acc, q) -> acc + q
    )) AS net_units,
    MAX(ARRAY_MAX(
      TRANSFORM(c.valid_items, i -> i:price_minor::INT)
    )) AS max_added_unit_minor
  FROM sessions AS s
  INNER JOIN cart_events AS c
    ON s.anonymous_id = c.anonymous_id
    AND c.event_at_utc BETWEEN s.session_start_utc AND s.session_end_utc
  GROUP BY
    s.session_id
),

session_checkout AS (
  SELECT
    s.session_id,
    MAX(cs.step_number) AS max_step
  FROM sessions AS s
  INNER JOIN checkout_steps AS cs
    ON s.anonymous_id = cs.anonymous_id
    AND cs.first_reached_at_utc BETWEEN s.session_start_utc AND s.session_end_utc
  GROUP BY
    s.session_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    s.session_id,
    s.anonymous_id,
    s.session_start_utc,
    ARRAY_SORT(
      ARRAY_DISTINCT(TRANSFORM(
        ARRAY_FLATTEN(COALESCE(sc.added_item_lists, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT())),
        i -> UPPER(i:sku::VARCHAR)
      ))
    )::ARRAY AS added_skus,
    COALESCE(sc.removed_sku_count, 0)::INT AS removed_sku_count,
    COALESCE(sc.net_units, 0)::INT AS net_units,
    sc.max_added_unit_minor::INT AS max_added_unit_minor,
    (
      COALESCE(ck.max_step, 0) >= 1
    ) AS reached_checkout,
    (
      COALESCE(ck.max_step, 0) >= 3
    ) AS reached_payment,
    s.has_order AS converted,
    CASE
      WHEN s.has_order
      THEN 'order'
      WHEN COALESCE(ck.max_step, 0) >= 3
      THEN 'payment'
      WHEN COALESCE(ck.max_step, 0) >= 1
      THEN 'checkout'
      WHEN s.has_add_to_cart
      THEN 'cart'
      ELSE 'browse'
    END::VARCHAR AS funnel_stage
  FROM sessions AS s
  LEFT JOIN session_cart AS sc
    ON s.session_id = sc.session_id
  LEFT JOIN session_checkout AS ck
    ON s.session_id = ck.session_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_category_paths
statements.sql:
WITH categories AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_categories
),

tree AS (
  SELECT
    c.category_id,
    c.parent_category_id,
    c.slug,
    c.display_name,
    c.sort_order,
    LEVEL AS depth,
    SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(c.slug, '/') AS slug_path,
    CONNECT_BY_ROOT c.category_id AS root_category_id
  FROM categories AS c
START WITH c.is_root
CONNECT BY PRIOR c.category_id = c.parent_category_id
),

parents AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    c.parent_category_id
  FROM categories AS c
  WHERE c.parent_category_id IS NOT NULL
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    t.category_id,
    t.parent_category_id,
    t.root_category_id::VARCHAR AS root_category_id,
    t.slug,
    t.display_name,
    t.depth::INT AS depth,
    LTRIM(t.slug_path, '/')::VARCHAR AS slug_path,
    (
      p.parent_category_id IS NULL
    ) AS is_leaf,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY t.parent_category_id
      ORDER BY t.sort_order, t.slug
    )::INT AS sibling_rank
  FROM tree AS t
  LEFT JOIN parents AS p
    ON t.category_id = p.parent_category_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_chargeback_exposure
statements.sql:
WITH chargebacks AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_chargebacks
),

payments AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_payments
),

orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_orders_usd
),

fx_rates AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
),

currencies AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__currencies
),

evidence AS (
  SELECT
    c.chargeback_id,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT LOWER(d.value:kind::VARCHAR)) WITHIN GROUP (
      ORDER BY LOWER(d.value:kind::VARCHAR)
    ) AS evidence_kinds,
    BOOLOR_AGG(REGEXP_LIKE(
      LOWER(d.value:kind::VARCHAR),
      '.*(tracking|delivery|signature|pod).*'
    )) AS has_delivery_proof
  FROM chargebacks AS c, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => c.evidence:documents) AS d
  GROUP BY
    c.chargeback_id
),

with_payment AS (
  SELECT
    c.chargeback_id,
    c.payment_id,
    p.order_id,
    p.payment_method,
    c.reason_code,
    c.reason_family,
    c.opened_at,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', c.opened_at)::DATE AS opened_date,
    c.closed_at,
    c.outcome,
    c.amount_minor,
    c.currency_code,
    p.amount_minor AS payment_amount_minor
  FROM chargebacks AS c
  LEFT JOIN payments AS p
    ON c.payment_id = p.payment_id
),

with_rate AS (
  SELECT
    w.chargeback_id,
    w.payment_id,
    w.order_id,
    w.payment_method,
    w.reason_code,
    w.reason_family,
    w.opened_at,
    w.opened_date,
    w.closed_at,
    w.outcome,
    w.amount_minor,
    w.payment_amount_minor,
    cur.minor_unit_exponent,
    fx.rate_to_usd
  FROM with_payment AS w
  LEFT JOIN currencies AS cur
    ON w.currency_code = cur.currency_code
  ASOF JOIN fx_rates AS fx MATCH_CONDITION (w.opened_date >= fx.rate_date)
    ON w.currency_code = fx.currency_code
),

with_order AS (
  SELECT
    r.chargeback_id,
    r.payment_id,
    r.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    r.payment_method,
    r.reason_code,
    r.reason_family,
    r.opened_at,
    r.opened_date,
    DATEADD(
      'day',
      COALESCE(PARSE_JSON('{"consumer_dispute":30,"fraud":20,"processing":45}')[r.reason_family]::INT, 30),
      r.opened_date
    ) AS response_due_on,
    r.closed_at,
    r.outcome,
    ROUND(
      (ROUND((
  r.amount_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, COALESCE(r.minor_unit_exponent, 2))::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 6)::NUMBER(38, 6)) * r.rate_to_usd,
      2
    ) AS amount_usd,
    r.amount_minor / NULLIF(r.payment_amount_minor, 0) AS share_of_payment
  FROM with_rate AS r
  LEFT JOIN orders AS o
    ON r.order_id = o.order_id
),

customer_history AS (
  SELECT
    w.chargeback_id,
    COUNT(*) OVER (
      PARTITION BY w.customer_id
      ORDER BY w.opened_at
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    )
      - 1 AS prior_chargebacks_for_customer
  FROM with_order AS w
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    w.chargeback_id,
    w.payment_id,
    w.order_id,
    w.customer_id,
    w.payment_method,
    w.reason_code,
    w.reason_family,
    w.opened_at,
    w.response_due_on::DATE AS response_due_on,
    w.outcome,
    w.amount_usd::NUMBER(18, 2) AS amount_usd,
    ROUND(w.share_of_payment, 6)::NUMBER(9, 6) AS share_of_payment,
    COALESCE(e.evidence_kinds, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT())::ARRAY AS evidence_kinds,
    COALESCE(e.has_delivery_proof, FALSE)::BOOLEAN AS has_delivery_proof,
    DATEDIFF(
      'day',
      w.opened_date,
      COALESCE(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', w.closed_at)::DATE, '2026-03-31'::DATE)
    )::INT AS days_open,
    (
      w.closed_at IS NULL
      AND w.response_due_on < '2026-03-31'::DATE
    )::BOOLEAN AS is_overdue,
    IFF(w.outcome IN ('open', 'lost', 'pending'), w.amount_usd, 0)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS at_risk_usd,
    h.prior_chargebacks_for_customer::INT AS prior_chargebacks_for_customer
  FROM with_order AS w
  INNER JOIN customer_history AS h
    ON w.chargeback_id = h.chargeback_id
  LEFT JOIN evidence AS e
    ON w.chargeback_id = e.chargeback_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_chat_sentiment
statements.sql:
WITH messages AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_chat_messages
),

chats AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_chat_transcripts
),

with_previous AS (
  SELECT
    m.chat_id,
    m.message_index,
    m.sender_role,
    m.sent_at,
    LOWER(m.message_text_masked) AS message_text,
    LAG(m.sender_role) OVER (PARTITION BY m.chat_id ORDER BY m.message_index) AS previous_role,
    LAG(m.sent_at) OVER (PARTITION BY m.chat_id ORDER BY m.message_index) AS previous_sent_at
  FROM messages AS m
),

scored AS (
  SELECT
    w.chat_id,
    w.message_index,
    w.sender_role,
    w.message_text,
    IFF(
      w.sender_role = 'customer',
      REGEXP_COUNT(w.message_text, '(thanks|thank you|great|perfect|helpful|appreciate|sorted)')
        - REGEXP_COUNT(w.message_text, '(angry|terrible|worst|refund|cancel|broken|never again|ridiculous)'),
      0
    ) AS message_sentiment,
    IFF(
      w.sender_role = 'agent' AND w.previous_role = 'customer',
      DATEDIFF('second', w.previous_sent_at, w.sent_at),
      NULL
    ) AS agent_reply_seconds
  FROM with_previous AS w
),

per_chat AS (
  SELECT
    s.chat_id,
    COUNT_IF(s.sender_role = 'customer') AS customer_message_count,
    COUNT_IF(s.sender_role = 'agent') AS agent_message_count,
    SUM(s.message_sentiment) AS sentiment_score,
    MEDIAN(s.agent_reply_seconds) AS median_agent_reply_seconds,
    REGEXP_LIKE(
      MAX_BY(s.message_text, s.message_index),
      '.*(thanks|thank you|cheers).*'
    ) AS ends_with_thanks
  FROM scored AS s
  GROUP BY
    s.chat_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    c.chat_id,
    c.ticket_id,
    COALESCE(p.customer_message_count, 0)::INT AS customer_message_count,
    COALESCE(p.agent_message_count, 0)::INT AS agent_message_count,
    COALESCE(p.sentiment_score, 0)::INT AS sentiment_score,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(p.sentiment_score, 0) < 0
      THEN 'negative'
      WHEN COALESCE(p.sentiment_score, 0) > 0
      THEN 'positive'
      ELSE 'neutral'
    END::VARCHAR AS sentiment_label,
    p.median_agent_reply_seconds::INT AS median_agent_reply_seconds,
    COALESCE(p.ends_with_thanks, FALSE)::BOOLEAN AS ends_with_thanks,
    ROUND(DATEDIFF('second', c.started_at, c.ended_at) / 60, 2)::NUMBER(10, 2) AS chat_minutes
  FROM chats AS c
  LEFT JOIN per_chat AS p
    ON c.chat_id = p.chat_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_cross_device_identity
statements.sql:
WITH web_identities AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_web_identifies
),

app_events AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_app_events
),

web_links AS (
  SELECT
    w.customer_id::VARCHAR AS customer_id,
    w.anonymous_id::VARCHAR AS identifier,
    'web'::VARCHAR AS platform,
    w.first_seen_at_utc::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS first_seen_at_utc
  FROM web_identities AS w
),

app_links AS (
  SELECT
    a.customer_id::VARCHAR AS customer_id,
    a.device_id::VARCHAR AS identifier,
    a.platform::VARCHAR AS platform,
    MIN(a.event_at_utc)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS first_seen_at_utc
  FROM app_events AS a
  WHERE
    a.customer_id IS NOT NULL
    AND a.device_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    a.customer_id,
    a.device_id,
    a.platform
),

all_links AS (
  SELECT
    wl.customer_id::VARCHAR AS customer_id,
    wl.identifier::VARCHAR AS identifier,
    wl.platform::VARCHAR AS platform,
    wl.first_seen_at_utc::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS first_seen_at_utc
  FROM web_links AS wl
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    al.customer_id::VARCHAR AS customer_id,
    al.identifier::VARCHAR AS identifier,
    al.platform::VARCHAR AS platform,
    al.first_seen_at_utc::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS first_seen_at_utc
  FROM app_links AS al
),

per_platform AS (
  SELECT
    l.customer_id,
    l.platform,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT l.identifier) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.identifier) AS identifiers,
    MIN(l.first_seen_at_utc) AS first_seen_at_utc
  FROM all_links AS l
  GROUP BY
    l.customer_id,
    l.platform
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    p.customer_id,
    SUM(IFF(p.platform = 'web', ARRAY_SIZE(p.identifiers), 0))::INT AS web_visitor_count,
    SUM(IFF(p.platform <> 'web', ARRAY_SIZE(p.identifiers), 0))::INT AS app_device_count,
    ARRAY_AGG(p.platform) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.platform)::ARRAY AS platforms,
    (
      SUM(ARRAY_SIZE(p.identifiers)) > 1
    ) AS is_multi_device,
    MIN(p.first_seen_at_utc) AS first_seen_at_utc,
    OBJECT_AGG(p.platform, p.identifiers::VARIANT)::OBJECT AS identity_graph
  FROM per_platform AS p
  GROUP BY
    p.customer_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_customer_address_current
statements.sql:
WITH addresses AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_customer_addresses
),

countries AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__countries
),

ranked AS (
  SELECT
    a.customer_id,
    a.address_id,
    a.city,
    a.postcode_canonical,
    a.country_code,
    a.latitude,
    a.longitude,
    a.is_default,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id) AS address_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.country_code) OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id) AS distinct_countries
  FROM addresses AS a
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.customer_id
      ORDER BY a.is_default DESC, a.valid_from DESC, a.address_id DESC
    ) = 1
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    r.customer_id,
    r.address_id,
    r.city,
    r.postcode_canonical,
    r.country_code,
    c.region_code::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    r.latitude,
    r.longitude,
    r.is_default AS is_explicit_default,
    r.address_count::INT AS address_count,
    r.distinct_countries::INT AS distinct_countries
  FROM ranked AS r
  LEFT JOIN countries AS c
    ON r.country_code = c.country_code
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_customer_consent_state
statements.sql:
WITH consents AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_customer_consents
),

current_consents AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.consent_type,
    c.is_granted,
    c.captured_at,
    c.is_legacy
  FROM consents AS c
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.customer_id, c.consent_type
      ORDER BY c.captured_at DESC, c.consent_id DESC
    ) = 1
),

consent_matrix AS (
  SELECT
    cc.customer_id,
    cc.consent_type,
    cc.is_granted
  FROM current_consents AS cc
),

pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    p.customer_id,
    p.email_marketing,
    p.sms_marketing,
    p.personalisation,
    p.third_party_sharing
  FROM consent_matrix PIVOT(
    MAX(is_granted) FOR consent_type IN (
      'EMAIL_MARKETING',
      'SMS_MARKETING',
      'PERSONALISATION',
      'THIRD_PARTY_SHARING'
    )
  ) AS p(customer_id, email_marketing, sms_marketing, personalisation, third_party_sharing)
),

summary AS (
  SELECT
    cc.customer_id,
    OBJECT_AGG(cc.consent_type, cc.is_granted::VARIANT) AS consent_state,
    MAX(cc.captured_at) AS last_consent_change_at,
    BOOLOR_AGG(cc.is_legacy) AS has_legacy_consent
  FROM current_consents AS cc
  GROUP BY
    cc.customer_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    COALESCE(p.email_marketing, FALSE)::BOOLEAN AS email_marketing,
    COALESCE(p.sms_marketing, FALSE)::BOOLEAN AS sms_marketing,
    COALESCE(p.personalisation, FALSE)::BOOLEAN AS personalisation,
    COALESCE(p.third_party_sharing, FALSE)::BOOLEAN AS third_party_sharing,
    s.consent_state::OBJECT AS consent_state,
    s.last_consent_change_at,
    s.has_legacy_consent::BOOLEAN AS has_legacy_consent
  FROM summary AS s
  LEFT JOIN pivoted AS p
    ON s.customer_id = p.customer_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_customer_identity
statements.sql:
WITH customers AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_customers
),

web_identities AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_web_identifies
),

newsletter AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_newsletter_subscriptions
),

tickets AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_tickets
),

base AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.email_normalised,
    SPLIT_PART(c.email_normalised, '@', 2) AS email_domain,
    HASH(c.email_normalised) AS email_dedupe_key,
    c.phone_normalised,
    TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', c.first_name, c.last_name)) AS full_name
  FROM customers AS c
),

anonymous_links AS (
  SELECT
    w.customer_id,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT w.anonymous_id) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY w.anonymous_id) AS anonymous_ids
  FROM web_identities AS w
  GROUP BY
    w.customer_id
),

newsletter_links AS (
  SELECT
    b.customer_id,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT n.list_code) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY n.list_code) AS newsletter_lists
  FROM base AS b
  INNER JOIN newsletter AS n
    ON b.email_normalised = n.email
  WHERE n.list_status = 'subscribed'
  GROUP BY
    b.customer_id
),

ticket_links AS (
  SELECT
    b.customer_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.ticket_id) AS ticket_count
  FROM base AS b
  INNER JOIN tickets AS t
    ON b.email_normalised = t.customer_email
  GROUP BY
    b.customer_id
),

shared_phone_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    a.customer_id,
    b.customer_id AS other_customer_id,
    JAROWINKLER_SIMILARITY(LOWER(a.full_name), LOWER(b.full_name)) AS name_similarity
  FROM base AS a
  INNER JOIN base AS b
    ON a.phone_normalised = b.phone_normalised
    AND a.customer_id <> b.customer_id
),

best_duplicate AS (
  SELECT
    p.customer_id,
    MAX_BY(p.other_customer_id, p.name_similarity) AS other_customer_id,
    MAX(p.name_similarity) AS name_similarity
  FROM shared_phone_pairs AS p
  WHERE p.name_similarity >= 85
  GROUP BY
    p.customer_id
),

email_collisions AS (
  SELECT
    b.email_dedupe_key,
    COUNT(*) AS accounts_sharing_email
  FROM base AS b
  WHERE b.email_normalised IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    b.email_dedupe_key
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    b.customer_id,
    b.email_normalised,
    b.email_domain::VARCHAR AS email_domain,
    b.email_dedupe_key::NUMBER(38, 0) AS email_dedupe_key,
    b.phone_normalised,
    b.full_name::VARCHAR AS full_name,
    COALESCE(a.anonymous_ids, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT())::ARRAY AS anonymous_ids,
    ARRAY_SIZE(COALESCE(a.anonymous_ids, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT()))::INT AS anonymous_id_count,
    COALESCE(n.newsletter_lists, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT())::ARRAY AS newsletter_lists,
    COALESCE(t.ticket_count, 0)::INT AS ticket_count,
    d.other_customer_id::VARCHAR AS duplicate_candidate_id,
    d.name_similarity::INT AS duplicate_name_similarity,
    COALESCE(e.accounts_sharing_email, 1)::INT AS accounts_sharing_email
  FROM base AS b
  LEFT JOIN anonymous_links AS a
    ON b.customer_id = a.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN newsletter_links AS n
    ON b.customer_id = n.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN ticket_links AS t
    ON b.customer_id = t.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN best_duplicate AS d
    ON b.customer_id = d.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN email_collisions AS e
    ON b.email_dedupe_key = e.email_dedupe_key
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_customer_order_sequence
statements.sql:
WITH orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_orders_usd
),

valid_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.placed_at,
    o.placed_date_local,
    o.amount_usd,
    o.sales_channel
  FROM orders AS o
  WHERE NOT (order_status = 'CANCELLED')
),

sequenced AS (
  SELECT
    v.order_id,
    v.customer_id,
    v.placed_at,
    v.placed_date_local,
    v.amount_usd,
    v.sales_channel,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.customer_id ORDER BY v.placed_at, v.order_id) AS order_number,
    LAG(v.placed_date_local) OVER (
      PARTITION BY v.customer_id
      ORDER BY v.placed_at, v.order_id
    ) AS previous_date,
    LAG(v.sales_channel) OVER (
      PARTITION BY v.customer_id
      ORDER BY v.placed_at, v.order_id
    ) AS previous_sales_channel,
    SUM(v.amount_usd) OVER (
      PARTITION BY v.customer_id
      ORDER BY v.placed_at, v.order_id
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS lifetime_revenue_usd,
    SUM(v.amount_usd) OVER (
      PARTITION BY v.customer_id
      ORDER BY v.placed_date_local
      RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '89 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS rolling_90d_revenue_usd,
    MIN(v.placed_date_local) OVER (PARTITION BY v.customer_id) AS first_order_date
  FROM valid_orders AS v
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    s.order_id,
    s.customer_id,
    s.placed_at,
    s.placed_date_local,
    s.order_number::INT AS order_number,
    (
      s.order_number = 1
    ) AS is_first_order,
    DATEDIFF('day', s.previous_date, s.placed_date_local)::INT AS days_since_previous_order,
    s.amount_usd,
    s.lifetime_revenue_usd::NUMBER(18, 2) AS lifetime_revenue_usd,
    s.rolling_90d_revenue_usd::NUMBER(18, 2) AS rolling_90d_revenue_usd,
    s.previous_sales_channel::VARCHAR AS previous_sales_channel,
    COALESCE(s.previous_sales_channel <> s.sales_channel, FALSE) AS is_channel_switch,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', s.first_order_date)::DATE AS cohort_month
  FROM sequenced AS s
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_customer_rfm
statements.sql:
WITH order_sequence AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_customer_order_sequence
),

as_of AS (
  SELECT MAX(o.placed_date_local) AS as_of_date
  FROM order_sequence AS o
),

per_customer AS (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    MAX(o.placed_date_local) AS last_order_date,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count,
    MAX(o.lifetime_revenue_usd) AS lifetime_revenue_usd
  FROM order_sequence AS o
  GROUP BY
    o.customer_id
),

scored AS (
  SELECT
    p.customer_id,
    p.last_order_date,
    DATEDIFF('day', p.last_order_date, a.as_of_date) AS days_since_last_order,
    p.order_count,
    p.lifetime_revenue_usd,
    6
      - NTILE(5) OVER (
        ORDER BY DATEDIFF('day', p.last_order_date, a.as_of_date), p.customer_id
      ) AS recency_score,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY p.order_count, p.customer_id) AS frequency_score,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY p.lifetime_revenue_usd, p.customer_id) AS monetary_score
  FROM per_customer AS p
  CROSS JOIN as_of AS a
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    s.last_order_date,
    s.days_since_last_order::INT AS days_since_last_order,
    s.order_count::INT AS order_count,
    s.lifetime_revenue_usd,
    ROUND(s.lifetime_revenue_usd / NULLIF(s.order_count, 0), 2)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS average_order_usd,
    s.recency_score::INT AS recency_score,
    s.frequency_score::INT AS frequency_score,
    s.monetary_score::INT AS monetary_score,
    (
      s.recency_score::VARCHAR || s.frequency_score::VARCHAR || s.monetary_score::VARCHAR
    )::VARCHAR AS rfm_code,
    CASE
      WHEN s.order_count = 1
      AND s.recency_score >= 4
      THEN 'NEW'
      WHEN s.recency_score >= 4
      AND s.frequency_score >= 4
      THEN 'CHAMPION'
      WHEN s.frequency_score >= 3
      AND s.recency_score >= 3
      THEN 'LOYAL'
      WHEN s.recency_score >= 3
      THEN 'PROMISING'
      WHEN s.frequency_score >= 3
      THEN 'AT_RISK'
      ELSE 'HIBERNATING'
    END::VARCHAR AS segment,
    (
      s.lifetime_revenue_usd >= 2500.00
    ) AS is_vip
  FROM scored AS s
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_customer_support_history
statements.sql:
WITH tickets AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_tickets
),

identities AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_customer_identity
),

csat AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_csat_responses
),

latest_csat AS (
  SELECT
    c.ticket_id,
    c.score
  FROM csat AS c
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.ticket_id
      ORDER BY c.responded_at DESC, c.response_id DESC
    ) = 1
),

email_owners AS (
  SELECT
    i.email_normalised,
    MIN(i.customer_id) AS customer_id
  FROM identities AS i
  WHERE i.email_normalised IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    i.email_normalised
),

linked AS (
  SELECT
    t.ticket_id,
    i.customer_id,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', t.created_at)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS created_at_utc,
    t.contact_reason,
    lc.score AS csat_score
  FROM tickets AS t
  LEFT JOIN email_owners AS i
    ON t.customer_email = i.email_normalised
  LEFT JOIN latest_csat AS lc
    ON t.ticket_id = lc.ticket_id
),

sequenced AS (
  SELECT
    l.ticket_id,
    l.customer_id,
    l.created_at_utc,
    l.contact_reason,
    l.csat_score,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY l.customer_id
      ORDER BY l.created_at_utc, l.ticket_id
    ) AS ticket_number_for_customer,
    LAG(l.created_at_utc) OVER (
      PARTITION BY l.customer_id
      ORDER BY l.created_at_utc, l.ticket_id
    ) AS previous_created_at_utc,
    AVG(l.csat_score) OVER (
      PARTITION BY l.customer_id
      ORDER BY l.created_at_utc, l.ticket_id
      ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS rolling_csat_avg
  FROM linked AS l
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    s.ticket_id,
    s.customer_id,
    IFF(
      s.customer_id IS NULL,
      NULL,
      s.ticket_number_for_customer
    )::INT AS ticket_number_for_customer,
    DATEDIFF('day', s.previous_created_at_utc, s.created_at_utc)::INT AS days_since_previous_ticket,
    s.csat_score,
    ROUND(s.rolling_csat_avg, 3)::NUMBER(6, 3) AS rolling_csat_avg,
    COALESCE(
      DATEDIFF('hour', s.previous_created_at_utc, s.created_at_utc) <= 168,
      FALSE
    ) AS is_repeat_contact_7d,
    s.contact_reason
  FROM sequenced AS s
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_delivery_exceptions_classified
statements.sql:
WITH exceptions AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_delivery_exceptions
),

shipments AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_shipments
),

orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_orders_usd
),

classified AS (
  SELECT
    e.exception_id,
    e.shipment_id,
    e.exception_code,
    e.occurred_at,
    e.resolved_at,
    e.resolution_type,
    e.compensation_minor,
    CASE
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(e.exception_code, '^(ADDR|NOT_HOME|REFUSED|ACCESS).*')
      THEN 'customer'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(e.exception_code, '^(LOST|DAMAGED|DELAY|MISROUTE).*')
      THEN 'carrier'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(e.exception_code, '^(LABEL|PACK|WRONG_ITEM).*')
      THEN 'warehouse'
      ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS responsibility
  FROM exceptions AS e
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    c.exception_id,
    c.shipment_id,
    s.carrier_code,
    c.exception_code,
    c.responsibility::VARCHAR AS responsibility,
    c.occurred_at,
    ROUND(
      DATEDIFF('minute', c.occurred_at, c.resolved_at) / 60,
      2
    )::NUMBER(10, 2) AS hours_to_resolve,
    c.resolution_type,
    ROUND(
      c.compensation_minor / POWER(10, (CASE o.currency_code WHEN 'AUD' THEN 2 WHEN 'EUR' THEN 2 WHEN 'GBP' THEN 2 WHEN 'JPY' THEN 0 WHEN 'KWD' THEN 3 WHEN 'USD' THEN 2 ELSE 2 END)) * o.rate_to_usd,
      2
    )::NUMBER(18, 2) AS compensation_usd,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.shipment_id
      ORDER BY c.occurred_at
    )::INT AS exception_rank_in_shipment
  FROM classified AS c
  INNER JOIN shipments AS s
    ON c.shipment_id = s.shipment_id
  LEFT JOIN orders AS o
    ON s.order_id = o.order_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_delivery_slot_utilisation
statements.sql:
WITH slots AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_delivery_slots
),

warehouses AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_warehouses
),

countries AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__countries
),

holidays AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__holiday_calendar
),

warehouse_regions AS (
  SELECT
    w.warehouse_code,
    c.region_code
  FROM warehouses AS w
  INNER JOIN countries AS c
    ON w.country_code = c.country_code
),

busiest_slots AS (
  SELECT
    s.warehouse_code,
    s.slot_start_local::DATE AS slot_date_local,
    s.slot_start_local AS busiest_slot_start_local
  FROM slots AS s
  WHERE s.capacity <> 0
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY s.warehouse_code, s.slot_start_local::DATE
      ORDER BY s.booked / s.capacity DESC, s.slot_start_local, s.slot_id
    ) = 1
),

by_day AS (
  SELECT
    s.warehouse_code,
    s.slot_start_local::DATE AS slot_date_local,
    COUNT(*) AS slot_count,
    SUM(s.capacity) AS total_capacity,
    SUM(s.booked) AS total_booked,
    COUNT_IF(s.remaining_capacity = 0) AS full_slot_count
  FROM slots AS s
  GROUP BY
    s.warehouse_code,
    s.slot_start_local::DATE
),

with_calendar AS (
  SELECT
    d.warehouse_code,
    d.slot_date_local,
    d.slot_count,
    d.total_capacity,
    d.total_booked,
    d.full_slot_count,
    b.busiest_slot_start_local,
    r.region_code,
    (
      h.holiday_date IS NOT NULL
    ) AS is_holiday,
    d.total_booked / NULLIF(d.total_capacity, 0) AS utilisation_raw
  FROM by_day AS d
  LEFT JOIN busiest_slots AS b
    ON d.warehouse_code = b.warehouse_code
    AND d.slot_date_local = b.slot_date_local
  LEFT JOIN warehouse_regions AS r
    ON d.warehouse_code = r.warehouse_code
  LEFT JOIN holidays AS h
    ON r.region_code = h.region_code
    AND d.slot_date_local = h.holiday_date
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      d.warehouse_code || '|' || TO_CHAR(d.slot_date_local, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    )::VARCHAR AS slot_day_key,
    d.warehouse_code,
    d.slot_date_local,
    d.slot_count::INT AS slot_count,
    d.total_capacity::INT AS total_capacity,
    d.total_booked::INT AS total_booked,
    ROUND(d.utilisation_raw, 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS utilisation,
    d.full_slot_count::INT AS full_slot_count,
    d.busiest_slot_start_local::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS busiest_slot_start_local,
    (
      DAYOFWEEKISO(d.slot_date_local) >= 6
    ) AS is_weekend,
    IFF(
      COALESCE(d.region_code IN ('EU', 'US', 'APAC', 'MENA'), FALSE),
      d.region_code,
      NULL
    )::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    d.is_holiday::BOOLEAN AS is_holiday,
    ROUND(
      d.utilisation_raw
        - SUM(d.utilisation_raw) OVER (
          PARTITION BY d.warehouse_code, DAYOFWEEKISO(d.slot_date_local)
        )
        / COUNT(d.utilisation_raw) OVER (
          PARTITION BY d.warehouse_code, DAYOFWEEKISO(d.slot_date_local)
        ),
      4
    )::NUMBER(9, 4) AS utilisation_vs_weekday_avg
  FROM with_calendar AS d
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_email_engagement
statements.sql:
WITH email_events AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_email_events
),

customers AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_customers
),

campaigns AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_campaigns
),

email_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    c.email_normalised,
    MIN(c.customer_id) AS customer_id
  FROM customers AS c
  WHERE c.email_normalised IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    c.email_normalised
),

per_message AS (
  SELECT
    e.message_id,
    MAX(e.campaign_id) AS campaign_id,
    MAX(e.recipient_email) AS recipient_email,
    MIN(IFF(e.event_type = 'sent', e.occurred_at, NULL)) AS sent_at,
    BOOLOR_AGG(e.event_type = 'delivered') AS is_delivered,
    MAX(e.bounce_type) AS bounce_type,
    COUNT_IF(e.event_type = 'open' AND NOT COALESCE(e.is_machine_open, FALSE)) AS human_open_count,
    COUNT_IF(e.event_type = 'click') AS click_count,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT LOWER(PARSE_URL(e.clicked_url, 1)['host']::VARCHAR)) WITHIN GROUP (
      ORDER BY LOWER(PARSE_URL(e.clicked_url, 1)['host']::VARCHAR)
    ) AS clicked_domains,
    BOOLOR_AGG(e.event_type = 'unsubscribe') AS unsubscribed,
    BOOLOR_AGG(e.event_type = 'complaint') AS complained,
    MIN(IFF(e.event_type = 'click', e.occurred_at, NULL)) AS first_click_at
  FROM email_events AS e
  GROUP BY
    e.message_id
),

with_context AS (
  SELECT
    p.message_id,
    p.campaign_id,
    p.recipient_email,
    p.sent_at,
    p.is_delivered,
    p.bounce_type,
    p.human_open_count,
    p.click_count,
    p.clicked_domains,
    p.unsubscribed,
    p.complained,
    p.first_click_at,
    a.customer_id,
    c.channel AS campaign_channel,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', p.sent_at)::DATE BETWEEN c.starts_on AND COALESCE(
      c.ends_on,
      '2026-03-31'::DATE
    ) AS is_campaign_in_flight
  FROM per_message AS p
  LEFT JOIN email_accounts AS a
    ON p.recipient_email = a.email_normalised
  LEFT JOIN campaigns AS c
    ON p.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    p.message_id,
    p.campaign_id::VARCHAR AS campaign_id,
    p.recipient_email::VARCHAR AS recipient_email,
    p.sent_at,
    COALESCE(p.is_delivered, FALSE)::BOOLEAN AS is_delivered,
    p.bounce_type::VARCHAR AS bounce_type,
    p.human_open_count::INT AS human_open_count,
    p.click_count::INT AS click_count,
    p.clicked_domains::ARRAY AS clicked_domains,
    COALESCE(p.unsubscribed, FALSE)::BOOLEAN AS unsubscribed,
    COALESCE(p.complained, FALSE)::BOOLEAN AS complained,
    DATEDIFF('minute', p.sent_at, p.first_click_at)::INT AS minutes_to_first_click,
    p.customer_id::VARCHAR AS customer_id,
    p.campaign_channel::VARCHAR AS campaign_channel,
    COALESCE(p.is_campaign_in_flight, FALSE)::BOOLEAN AS is_campaign_in_flight
  FROM with_context AS p
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_experiment_exposures
statements.sql:
WITH assignments AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_experiment_assignments
),

sessions AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_web_sessions
),

assigned AS (
  SELECT
    a.assignment_id,
    a.experiment_key,
    a.variant_key,
    a.anonymous_id,
    a.assignment_surface,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', a.assigned_at)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS assigned_at_utc
  FROM assignments AS a
),

after_assignment AS (
  SELECT
    x.assignment_id,
    COUNT(s.session_id) AS sessions_after,
    MIN(IFF(s.has_order, s.session_start_utc, NULL)) AS first_order_session_utc
  FROM assigned AS x
  LEFT JOIN sessions AS s
    ON x.anonymous_id = s.anonymous_id
    AND s.session_start_utc >= x.assigned_at_utc
  GROUP BY
    x.assignment_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    x.assignment_id,
    x.experiment_key,
    x.variant_key,
    (
      x.variant_key IN ('control', 'a', 'baseline')
    ) AS is_control,
    x.anonymous_id,
    x.assigned_at_utc,
    COALESCE(f.sessions_after, 0)::INT AS sessions_after,
    (
      f.first_order_session_utc IS NOT NULL
    ) AS converted,
    ROUND(
      DATEDIFF('minute', x.assigned_at_utc, f.first_order_session_utc) / 1440,
      2
    )::NUMBER(10, 2) AS days_to_convert,
    x.assignment_surface
  FROM assigned AS x
  LEFT JOIN after_assignment AS f
    ON x.assignment_id = f.assignment_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_fulfilment_sla
statements.sql:
WITH shipments AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_shipments
),

orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_orders_enriched
),

warehouses AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_warehouses
),

tracking AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_shipment_tracking_events
),

countries AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__countries
),

holidays AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__holiday_calendar
),

spine_offsets AS (
  SELECT ARRAY_GENERATE_RANGE(0, 730) AS day_offsets
),

date_spine AS (
  SELECT
    DATEADD(
      'day',
      d.value::INT,
      '2025-01-01'::DATE
    )::DATE AS calendar_date
  FROM spine_offsets AS o, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => o.day_offsets) AS d
),

local_times AS (
  SELECT
    s.shipment_id,
    s.order_id,
    s.warehouse_code,
    s.carrier_code,
    c.region_code,
    w.opening_minutes,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE(w.iana_timezone, o.placed_at)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS placed_at_local,
