    CONVERT_TIMEZONE(w.iana_timezone, s.shipped_at)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS shipped_at_local,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE(w.iana_timezone, o.placed_at)::DATE AS placed_date_local,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE(w.iana_timezone, s.shipped_at)::DATE AS shipped_date_local
  FROM shipments AS s
  INNER JOIN orders AS o
    ON s.order_id = o.order_id
  INNER JOIN warehouses AS w
    ON s.warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
  LEFT JOIN countries AS c
    ON w.country_code = c.country_code
  WHERE s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL
), window_days AS (
  SELECT
    l.shipment_id,
    DAYOFWEEKISO(d.calendar_date) AS iso_weekday,
    h.holiday_date
  FROM local_times AS l
  INNER JOIN date_spine AS d
    ON d.calendar_date > l.placed_date_local
    AND d.calendar_date <= l.shipped_date_local
  LEFT JOIN holidays AS h
    ON l.region_code = h.region_code
    AND d.calendar_date = h.holiday_date
), business_days AS (
  SELECT
    wd.shipment_id,
    COUNT_IF(wd.iso_weekday <= 5 AND wd.holiday_date IS NULL) AS business_days_to_ship,
    COUNT_IF(wd.holiday_date IS NOT NULL) AS holidays_in_window
  FROM window_days AS wd
  GROUP BY
    wd.shipment_id
), delivery AS (
  SELECT
    t.shipment_id,
    MIN(t.event_at_utc) AS delivered_at_utc
  FROM tracking AS t
  WHERE t.is_delivery_event
  GROUP BY
    t.shipment_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    l.shipment_id,
    l.order_id,
    l.warehouse_code,
    l.carrier_code,
    l.placed_at_local,
    l.shipped_at_local,
    DATEDIFF('day', l.placed_at_local, l.shipped_at_local)::INT AS calendar_days_to_ship,
    COALESCE(b.business_days_to_ship, 0)::INT AS business_days_to_ship,
    COALESCE(b.holidays_in_window, 0)::INT AS holidays_in_window,
    IFF(
      COALESCE(b.business_days_to_ship, 0) = 0,
      DATEDIFF('minute', l.placed_at_local, l.shipped_at_local),
      COALESCE(b.business_days_to_ship, 0) * l.opening_minutes
    )::INT AS dispatch_business_minutes,
    (
      IFF(
        COALESCE(b.business_days_to_ship, 0) = 0,
        DATEDIFF('minute', l.placed_at_local, l.shipped_at_local),
        COALESCE(b.business_days_to_ship, 0) * l.opening_minutes
      ) <= 480
    ) AS is_dispatch_on_time,
    dl.delivered_at_utc,
    ROUND(
      DATEDIFF(
        'minute',
        CONVERT_TIMEZONE(w.iana_timezone, 'UTC', l.shipped_at_local),
        dl.delivered_at_utc
      )
      / 60,
      2
    )::NUMBER(10, 2) AS hours_to_deliver
  FROM local_times AS l
  INNER JOIN warehouses AS w
    ON l.warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
  LEFT JOIN business_days AS b
    ON l.shipment_id = b.shipment_id
  LEFT JOIN delivery AS dl
    ON l.shipment_id = dl.shipment_id
)
SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_gift_card_balances
statements.sql:
WITH gift_cards AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_gift_cards
),

transactions AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_gift_card_transactions
),

fx_rates AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
),

currencies AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__currencies
),

movement AS (
  SELECT
    t.gift_card_id,
    SUM(IFF(t.signed_amount_minor < 0, -t.signed_amount_minor, 0)) AS redeemed_minor,
    SUM(t.signed_amount_minor) AS net_movement_minor,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    MAX(t.occurred_at) AS last_used_at
  FROM transactions AS t
  GROUP BY
    t.gift_card_id
),

balances AS (
  SELECT
    g.gift_card_id,
    g.currency_code,
    g.issued_at,
    g.expires_on,
    g.initial_amount_minor,
    COALESCE(m.redeemed_minor, 0) AS redeemed_minor,
    GREATEST(g.initial_amount_minor + COALESCE(m.net_movement_minor, 0), 0) AS balance_minor,
    COALESCE(m.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    m.last_used_at,
    c.minor_unit_exponent,
    '2026-03-31'::DATE AS valuation_date
  FROM gift_cards AS g
  INNER JOIN currencies AS c
    ON g.currency_code = c.currency_code
  LEFT JOIN movement AS m
    ON g.gift_card_id = m.gift_card_id
),

valued AS (
  SELECT
    b.gift_card_id,
    b.currency_code,
    b.issued_at,
    b.expires_on,
    b.initial_amount_minor,
    b.redeemed_minor,
    b.balance_minor,
    b.transaction_count,
    b.last_used_at,
    b.minor_unit_exponent,
    b.valuation_date,
    fx.rate_to_usd
  FROM balances AS b
  ASOF JOIN fx_rates AS fx MATCH_CONDITION (b.valuation_date >= fx.rate_date)
    ON b.currency_code = fx.currency_code
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    v.gift_card_id,
    v.currency_code,
    v.issued_at,
    v.expires_on,
    ROUND((
  v.initial_amount_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, v.minor_unit_exponent)::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 3)::NUMBER(38, 6) AS initial_amount,
    ROUND((
  v.redeemed_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, v.minor_unit_exponent)::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 3)::NUMBER(38, 6) AS redeemed_amount,
    ROUND((
  v.balance_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, v.minor_unit_exponent)::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 3)::NUMBER(38, 6) AS balance_amount,
    ROUND(
      (ROUND((
  v.balance_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, v.minor_unit_exponent)::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 6)::NUMBER(38, 6)) * v.rate_to_usd,
      2
    )::NUMBER(18, 2) AS balance_usd,
    v.transaction_count::INT AS transaction_count,
    v.last_used_at,
    CASE
      WHEN v.balance_minor = 0
      THEN 'fully_redeemed'
      WHEN v.expires_on < v.valuation_date
      AND v.redeemed_minor = 0
      THEN 'expired_unused'
      WHEN v.expires_on < v.valuation_date
      THEN 'expired_partial'
      ELSE 'active'
    END::VARCHAR AS liability_status
  FROM valued AS v
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_influencer_promo_orders
statements.sql:
WITH posts AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_influencer_posts
),

orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_orders_usd
),

post_codes AS (
  SELECT
    p.post_id,
    LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(p.creator_handle, '^@+|\\s+', '')) AS creator_handle,
    LOWER(p.platform) AS platform,
    p.posted_at,
    UPPER(p.promo_code) AS promo_code,
    p.impressions,
    COALESCE(p.likes, 0)
      + COALESCE(p.metrics:comments::INT, 0)
      + COALESCE(p.metrics:shares::INT, 0) AS engagements,
    p.metrics:saves::INT AS saves,
    REGEXP_LIKE(
      COALESCE(p.metrics:link_url::VARCHAR, ''),
      '^https?://[^ ]+[?&]utm_source=.*'
    ) AS has_tracking_link
  FROM posts AS p
  WHERE p.promo_code IS NOT NULL
),

promo_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    UPPER(o.promo_code) AS promo_code,
    o.placed_at,
    o.amount_usd,
    o.discount_amount_usd
  FROM orders AS o
  WHERE
    o.promo_code IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_status <> 'CANCELLED'
),

credited AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.placed_at,
    o.amount_usd,
    o.discount_amount_usd,
    p.post_id,
    p.posted_at
  FROM promo_orders AS o
  ASOF JOIN post_codes AS p MATCH_CONDITION (o.placed_at >= p.posted_at)
    ON o.promo_code = p.promo_code
),

in_window AS (
  SELECT
    c.post_id,
    c.order_id,
    c.customer_id,
    c.amount_usd,
    c.discount_amount_usd,
    DATEDIFF('minute', c.posted_at, c.placed_at) / 60 AS hours_after_post
  FROM credited AS c
  WHERE
    c.post_id IS NOT NULL
    AND DATEDIFF('day', c.posted_at, c.placed_at) <= 14
),

per_post AS (
  SELECT
    w.post_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT w.order_id) AS credited_orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT w.customer_id) AS credited_customers,
    SUM(w.amount_usd) AS credited_revenue_usd,
    SUM(w.discount_amount_usd) AS discount_given_usd,
    MIN(w.hours_after_post) AS first_order_hours_after_post
  FROM in_window AS w
  GROUP BY
    w.post_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    p.post_id,
    p.creator_handle::VARCHAR AS creator_handle,
    p.platform::VARCHAR AS platform,
    p.posted_at,
    p.promo_code::VARCHAR AS promo_code,
    p.impressions,
    p.engagements::INT AS engagements,
    p.saves::INT AS saves,
    p.has_tracking_link::BOOLEAN AS has_tracking_link,
    COALESCE(s.credited_orders, 0)::INT AS credited_orders,
    COALESCE(s.credited_customers, 0)::INT AS credited_customers,
    COALESCE(s.credited_revenue_usd, 0)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS credited_revenue_usd,
    COALESCE(s.discount_given_usd, 0)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS discount_given_usd,
    ROUND(s.first_order_hours_after_post, 2)::NUMBER(10, 2) AS first_order_hours_after_post,
    ROUND(
      1000 * COALESCE(s.credited_orders, 0) / NULLIF(p.impressions, 0),
      4
    )::NUMBER(12, 4) AS orders_per_thousand_impressions
  FROM post_codes AS p
  LEFT JOIN per_post AS s
    ON p.post_id = s.post_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_inventory_ledger
statements.sql:
WITH movements AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_stock_movements
),

receipts AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_po_receipts
),

transfers AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_stock_transfers
),

warehouses AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_warehouses
),

movement_entries AS (
  SELECT
    (
      'M:' || m.movement_id
    )::VARCHAR AS ledger_entry_key,
    m.sku::VARCHAR AS sku,
    m.warehouse_code::VARCHAR AS warehouse_code,
    'movement'::VARCHAR AS entry_source,
    m.qty_delta::INT AS qty_delta,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE(w.iana_timezone, 'UTC', m.moved_at_local)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS occurred_at_utc,
    m.moved_at_local::DATE AS occurred_date_local
  FROM movements AS m
  INNER JOIN warehouses AS w
    ON m.warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
  WHERE m.reference_type <> 'PO'
),

receipt_entries AS (
  SELECT
    (
      'R:' || r.receipt_id
    )::VARCHAR AS ledger_entry_key,
    r.sku::VARCHAR AS sku,
    r.warehouse_code::VARCHAR AS warehouse_code,
    'receipt'::VARCHAR AS entry_source,
    r.sellable_qty::INT AS qty_delta,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE(w.iana_timezone, 'UTC', r.received_at_local)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS occurred_at_utc,
    r.received_at_local::DATE AS occurred_date_local
  FROM receipts AS r
  INNER JOIN warehouses AS w
    ON r.warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
),

transfer_out_entries AS (
  SELECT
    (
      'TO:' || t.transfer_id
    )::VARCHAR AS ledger_entry_key,
    t.sku::VARCHAR AS sku,
    t.from_warehouse_code::VARCHAR AS warehouse_code,
    'transfer_out'::VARCHAR AS entry_source,
    (
      -t.qty
    )::INT AS qty_delta,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', t.shipped_at)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS occurred_at_utc,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE(w.iana_timezone, t.shipped_at)::DATE AS occurred_date_local
  FROM transfers AS t
  INNER JOIN warehouses AS w
    ON t.from_warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
  WHERE t.shipped_at IS NOT NULL
),

transfer_in_entries AS (
  SELECT
    (
      'TI:' || t.transfer_id
    )::VARCHAR AS ledger_entry_key,
    t.sku::VARCHAR AS sku,
    t.to_warehouse_code::VARCHAR AS warehouse_code,
    'transfer_in'::VARCHAR AS entry_source,
    t.qty::INT AS qty_delta,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', t.arrived_at)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS occurred_at_utc,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE(w.iana_timezone, t.arrived_at)::DATE AS occurred_date_local
  FROM transfers AS t
  INNER JOIN warehouses AS w
    ON t.to_warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
  WHERE t.arrived_at IS NOT NULL
),

all_entries AS (
  SELECT
    me.ledger_entry_key::VARCHAR AS ledger_entry_key,
    me.sku::VARCHAR AS sku,
    me.warehouse_code::VARCHAR AS warehouse_code,
    me.entry_source::VARCHAR AS entry_source,
    me.qty_delta::INT AS qty_delta,
    me.occurred_at_utc::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS occurred_at_utc,
    me.occurred_date_local::DATE AS occurred_date_local
  FROM movement_entries AS me
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    re.ledger_entry_key::VARCHAR AS ledger_entry_key,
    re.sku::VARCHAR AS sku,
    re.warehouse_code::VARCHAR AS warehouse_code,
    re.entry_source::VARCHAR AS entry_source,
    re.qty_delta::INT AS qty_delta,
    re.occurred_at_utc::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS occurred_at_utc,
    re.occurred_date_local::DATE AS occurred_date_local
  FROM receipt_entries AS re
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    toe.ledger_entry_key::VARCHAR AS ledger_entry_key,
    toe.sku::VARCHAR AS sku,
    toe.warehouse_code::VARCHAR AS warehouse_code,
    toe.entry_source::VARCHAR AS entry_source,
    toe.qty_delta::INT AS qty_delta,
    toe.occurred_at_utc::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS occurred_at_utc,
    toe.occurred_date_local::DATE AS occurred_date_local
  FROM transfer_out_entries AS toe
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    tie.ledger_entry_key::VARCHAR AS ledger_entry_key,
    tie.sku::VARCHAR AS sku,
    tie.warehouse_code::VARCHAR AS warehouse_code,
    tie.entry_source::VARCHAR AS entry_source,
    tie.qty_delta::INT AS qty_delta,
    tie.occurred_at_utc::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS occurred_at_utc,
    tie.occurred_date_local::DATE AS occurred_date_local
  FROM transfer_in_entries AS tie
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    a.ledger_entry_key,
    a.sku,
    a.warehouse_code,
    a.entry_source,
    a.qty_delta,
    a.occurred_at_utc,
    a.occurred_date_local,
    SUM(a.qty_delta) OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.sku, a.warehouse_code
      ORDER BY a.occurred_at_utc, a.ledger_entry_key
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    )::INT AS running_on_hand,
    COUNT(*) OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.sku, a.warehouse_code
      ORDER BY a.occurred_at_utc, a.ledger_entry_key
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    )::INT AS entry_sequence,
    (
      SUM(a.qty_delta) OVER (
        PARTITION BY a.sku, a.warehouse_code
        ORDER BY a.occurred_at_utc, a.ledger_entry_key
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) < 0
    ) AS is_negative_balance
  FROM all_entries AS a
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_inventory_valuation_daily
statements.sql:
WITH stock_days AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_stock_on_hand_daily
),

costs AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_supplier_cost_current
),

valued AS (
  SELECT
    s.warehouse_code,
    s.calendar_date,
    s.sku,
    s.on_hand_qty,
    s.is_stocked_out,
    s.on_hand_qty * c.unit_cost_usd AS stock_value_usd,
    IFF(c.unit_cost_usd IS NULL, s.on_hand_qty, 0) AS unvalued_units
  FROM stock_days AS s
  LEFT JOIN costs AS c
    ON s.sku = c.sku
),

daily AS (
  SELECT
    v.warehouse_code,
    v.calendar_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT v.sku) AS sku_count,
    SUM(GREATEST(v.on_hand_qty, 0)) AS units_on_hand,
    SUM(GREATEST(v.stock_value_usd, 0)) AS stock_value_usd,
    SUM(v.unvalued_units) AS unvalued_units,
    COUNT_IF(v.is_stocked_out) AS stocked_out_skus
  FROM valued AS v
  GROUP BY
    v.warehouse_code,
    v.calendar_date
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      d.warehouse_code || '|' || TO_CHAR(d.calendar_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    )::VARCHAR AS valuation_key,
    d.warehouse_code,
    d.calendar_date,
    d.sku_count::INT AS sku_count,
    d.units_on_hand::INT AS units_on_hand,
    ROUND(d.stock_value_usd, 2)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS stock_value_usd,
    d.unvalued_units::INT AS unvalued_units,
    d.stocked_out_skus::INT AS stocked_out_skus,
    ROUND(
      d.stock_value_usd
        - LAG(d.stock_value_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY d.warehouse_code ORDER BY d.calendar_date),
      2
    )::NUMBER(18, 2) AS value_change_usd
  FROM daily AS d
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_invoices_reconciled
statements.sql:
WITH invoices AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_invoices
),

tax_lines AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_invoice_tax_lines
),

orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_orders_enriched
),

currencies AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__currencies
),

numbered AS (
  SELECT
    i.invoice_id,
    i.order_id,
    COALESCE(
      i.invoice_series,
      REGEXP_SUBSTR(i.invoice_number, '^([A-Z]+)-', 1, 1, 'e', 1),
      'NONE'
    ) AS invoice_series,
    TRY_TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(i.invoice_number, '([0-9]+)$', 1, 1, 'e', 1)) AS invoice_sequence,
    i.issued_at,
    i.currency_code,
    i.net_minor,
    i.tax_minor,
    i.gross_minor,
    i.tax_lines
  FROM invoices AS i
),

sequenced AS (
  SELECT
    n.invoice_id,
    n.invoice_sequence
      - LAG(n.invoice_sequence) OVER (
        PARTITION BY n.invoice_series
        ORDER BY n.invoice_sequence, n.invoice_id
      )
      - 1 AS sequence_gap
  FROM numbered AS n
),

embedded AS (
  SELECT
    n.invoice_id,
    SUM(t.value:tax_minor::INT) AS embedded_tax_minor,
    COUNT(t.value) AS embedded_line_count
  FROM numbered AS n, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => n.tax_lines) AS t
  GROUP BY
    n.invoice_id
),

loaded AS (
  SELECT
    l.invoice_id,
    SUM(l.tax_minor) AS loaded_tax_minor,
    COUNT(*) AS loaded_line_count,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT l.tax_code) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.tax_code) AS tax_codes
  FROM tax_lines AS l
  GROUP BY
    l.invoice_id
),

order_tax AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.tax_amount_minor,
    o.currency_code,
    o.storefront_timezone
  FROM orders AS o
),

joined AS (
  SELECT
    n.invoice_id,
    n.order_id,
    n.invoice_series,
    n.invoice_sequence,
    s.sequence_gap,
    n.issued_at,
    n.currency_code,
    n.net_minor,
    n.tax_minor,
    n.gross_minor,
    c.minor_unit_exponent,
    e.embedded_tax_minor,
    e.embedded_line_count,
    l.loaded_tax_minor,
    l.loaded_line_count,
    l.tax_codes,
    o.tax_amount_minor AS order_tax_minor,
    o.currency_code AS order_currency_code,
    o.storefront_timezone
  FROM numbered AS n
  INNER JOIN sequenced AS s
    ON n.invoice_id = s.invoice_id
  LEFT JOIN currencies AS c
    ON n.currency_code = c.currency_code
  LEFT JOIN embedded AS e
    ON n.invoice_id = e.invoice_id
  LEFT JOIN loaded AS l
    ON n.invoice_id = l.invoice_id
  LEFT JOIN order_tax AS o
    ON n.order_id = o.order_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    j.invoice_id,
    j.order_id,
    j.invoice_series::VARCHAR AS invoice_series,
    j.invoice_sequence::INT AS invoice_sequence,
    NULLIF(j.sequence_gap, 0)::INT AS sequence_gap,
    j.issued_at,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE(COALESCE(j.storefront_timezone, 'UTC'), j.issued_at)::DATE AS issued_date_local,
    j.currency_code,
    ROUND((
  j.net_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, COALESCE(j.minor_unit_exponent, 2))::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 2)::NUMBER(38, 6) AS net,
    ROUND((
  j.tax_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, COALESCE(j.minor_unit_exponent, 2))::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 2)::NUMBER(38, 6) AS tax,
    ROUND((
  j.gross_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, COALESCE(j.minor_unit_exponent, 2))::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 2)::NUMBER(38, 6) AS gross,
    j.embedded_tax_minor::INT AS embedded_tax_minor,
    j.loaded_tax_minor::INT AS loaded_tax_minor,
    j.order_tax_minor,
    GREATEST(
      COALESCE(j.embedded_line_count, 0),
      COALESCE(j.loaded_line_count, 0)
    )::INT AS tax_line_count,
    COALESCE(j.tax_codes, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT())::ARRAY AS tax_codes,
    (
      j.net_minor + j.tax_minor = j.gross_minor
    )::BOOLEAN AS header_balances,
    COALESCE(
      ABS(j.embedded_tax_minor - j.loaded_tax_minor) <= 1
      AND ABS(j.loaded_tax_minor - j.tax_minor) <= 1,
      FALSE
    )::BOOLEAN AS tax_lines_agree,
    COALESCE(
      ABS(j.tax_minor - j.order_tax_minor) <= 1,
      FALSE
    )::BOOLEAN AS matches_order_tax,
    EQUAL_NULL(j.currency_code, j.order_currency_code)::BOOLEAN AS invoice_currency_matches_order
  FROM joined AS j
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_ledger_balances_daily
statements.sql:
WITH entries AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_ledger_entries
),

currencies AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__currencies
),

spine_offsets AS (
  SELECT ARRAY_GENERATE_RANGE(0, 730) AS day_offsets
),

date_spine AS (
  SELECT
    DATEADD(
      'day',
      d.value::INT,
      '2025-01-01'::DATE
    )::DATE AS calendar_date
  FROM spine_offsets AS o, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => o.day_offsets) AS d
),

posting_days AS (
  SELECT
    e.account_code,
    e.account_class,
    e.currency_code,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', e.posted_at)::DATE AS posted_date,
    e.signed_amount_minor
  FROM entries AS e
), daily_postings AS (
  SELECT
    p.account_code,
    p.currency_code,
    p.posted_date,
    SUM(IFF(p.signed_amount_minor > 0, p.signed_amount_minor, 0)) AS debit_minor,
    SUM(IFF(p.signed_amount_minor < 0, -p.signed_amount_minor, 0)) AS credit_minor,
    SUM(p.signed_amount_minor) AS net_minor,
    COUNT(*) AS posting_count
  FROM posting_days AS p
  GROUP BY
    p.account_code,
    p.currency_code,
    p.posted_date
), accounts AS (
  SELECT
    p.account_code,
    p.currency_code,
    MAX(p.account_class) AS account_class,
    MIN(p.posted_date) AS first_posted_date
  FROM posting_days AS p
  GROUP BY
    p.account_code,
    p.currency_code
), account_days AS (
  SELECT
    a.account_code,
    a.currency_code,
    a.account_class,
    d.calendar_date
  FROM accounts AS a
  INNER JOIN date_spine AS d
    ON d.calendar_date >= a.first_posted_date
  WHERE d.calendar_date <= '2026-03-31'::DATE
), filled AS (
  SELECT
    a.account_code,
    a.currency_code,
    a.account_class,
    a.calendar_date,
    COALESCE(p.debit_minor, 0) AS debit_minor,
    COALESCE(p.credit_minor, 0) AS credit_minor,
    COALESCE(p.net_minor, 0) AS net_minor,
    COALESCE(p.posting_count, 0) AS posting_count
  FROM account_days AS a
  LEFT JOIN daily_postings AS p
    ON a.account_code = p.account_code
    AND a.currency_code = p.currency_code
    AND a.calendar_date = p.posted_date
), balances AS (
  SELECT
    f.account_code,
    f.currency_code,
    f.account_class,
    f.calendar_date,
    f.debit_minor,
    f.credit_minor,
    f.posting_count,
    SUM(f.net_minor) OVER (
      PARTITION BY f.account_code, f.currency_code
      ORDER BY f.calendar_date
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS closing_balance_minor,
    SUM(f.net_minor) OVER (
      PARTITION BY f.account_code, f.currency_code, DATE_TRUNC('month', f.calendar_date)
      ORDER BY f.calendar_date
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS month_to_date_movement_minor
  FROM filled AS f
), final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      b.account_code || ':' || b.currency_code || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(b.calendar_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    )::VARCHAR AS balance_key,
    b.account_code,
    b.account_class::VARCHAR AS account_class,
    b.currency_code,
    b.calendar_date,
    b.debit_minor::INT AS debit_minor,
    b.credit_minor::INT AS credit_minor,
    b.posting_count::INT AS posting_count,
    b.closing_balance_minor::INT AS closing_balance_minor,
    ROUND((
  b.closing_balance_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, COALESCE(c.minor_unit_exponent, 2))::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 2)::NUMBER(38, 6) AS closing_balance,
    b.month_to_date_movement_minor::INT AS month_to_date_movement_minor,
    (
      b.calendar_date = LAST_DAY(b.calendar_date)
    )::BOOLEAN AS is_month_end,
    CASE
      WHEN b.account_class IN ('asset', 'expense')
      THEN b.closing_balance_minor >= 0
      ELSE b.closing_balance_minor <= 0
    END::BOOLEAN AS is_normal_side
  FROM balances AS b
  LEFT JOIN currencies AS c
    ON b.currency_code = c.currency_code
)
SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_loyalty_balances
statements.sql:
WITH ledger AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_loyalty_ledger
),

accounts AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_loyalty_accounts
),

postings AS (
  SELECT
    l.entry_id,
    l.loyalty_account_id,
    l.posted_at,
    l.points_delta,
    l.reason_code,
    l.expires_on,
    SUM(l.points_delta) OVER (
      PARTITION BY l.loyalty_account_id
      ORDER BY l.posted_at, l.entry_id
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS running_points
  FROM ledger AS l
),

expiry AS (
  SELECT
    p.entry_id,
    IFF(
      p.points_delta > 0 AND p.expires_on < '2026-03-31'::DATE,
      p.points_delta,
      0
    ) AS expiring_points
  FROM postings AS p
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    p.entry_id,
    p.loyalty_account_id,
    a.customer_id,
    p.posted_at,
    p.points_delta,
    p.running_points::INT AS running_points,
    e.expiring_points::INT AS expiring_points,
    (
      e.expiring_points > 0
    ) AS is_expired,
    ROUND(p.running_points * 0.0100, 4)::NUMBER(18, 4) AS running_value_usd,
    p.reason_code,
    a.tier_code
  FROM postings AS p
  INNER JOIN expiry AS e
    ON p.entry_id = e.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    ON p.loyalty_account_id = a.loyalty_account_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_loyalty_tier_changes
statements.sql:
WITH accounts AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_loyalty_accounts
),

history AS (
  SELECT
    a.loyalty_account_id,
    a.customer_id,
    h.index::INT AS change_sequence,
    UPPER(h.value:tier::VARCHAR) AS tier_code,
    TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(h.value:at::VARCHAR) AS changed_at
  FROM accounts AS a, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => a.tier_history) AS h
),

with_previous AS (
  SELECT
    h.loyalty_account_id,
    h.customer_id,
    h.change_sequence,
    h.tier_code,
    h.changed_at,
    LAG(h.tier_code) OVER (
      PARTITION BY h.loyalty_account_id
      ORDER BY h.change_sequence
    ) AS previous_tier_code,
    LAG(h.changed_at) OVER (
      PARTITION BY h.loyalty_account_id
      ORDER BY h.change_sequence
    ) AS previous_changed_at
  FROM history AS h
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      w.loyalty_account_id || ':' || w.change_sequence::VARCHAR
    )::VARCHAR AS tier_change_key,
    w.loyalty_account_id,
    w.customer_id,
    w.change_sequence,
    w.tier_code::VARCHAR AS tier_code,
    w.previous_tier_code::VARCHAR AS previous_tier_code,
    w.changed_at,
    CASE
      WHEN w.previous_tier_code IS NULL
      THEN 'enrol'
      WHEN DECODE(
        w.tier_code,
        'DUCKLING', 1,
        'DRAKE', 2,
        'GOLDEN_DUCK', 3,
        'PLATINUM_DUCK', 4,
        0
      ) > DECODE(
        w.previous_tier_code,
        'DUCKLING', 1,
        'DRAKE', 2,
        'GOLDEN_DUCK', 3,
        'PLATINUM_DUCK', 4,
        0
      )
      THEN 'upgrade'
      WHEN w.tier_code = w.previous_tier_code
      THEN 'same'
      ELSE 'downgrade'
    END::VARCHAR AS direction,
    DATEDIFF('day', w.previous_changed_at, w.changed_at)::INT AS days_in_previous_tier
  FROM with_previous AS w
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_newsletter_status
statements.sql:
WITH subscriptions AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_newsletter_subscriptions
),

customers AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_customers
),

latest_per_list AS (
  SELECT
    s.email,
    s.list_code,
    s.list_status,
    s.subscribed_at,
    s.unsubscribed_at,
    s.is_double_opt_in
  FROM subscriptions AS s
  WHERE s.email IS NOT NULL
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY s.email, s.list_code
      ORDER BY COALESCE(
        s.unsubscribed_at,
        s.subscribed_at
      ) DESC NULLS LAST, s.list_subscription_id DESC
    ) = 1
),

first_signup AS (
  SELECT
    s.email,
    s.signup_form AS first_signup_form
  FROM subscriptions AS s
  WHERE s.email IS NOT NULL
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY s.email
      ORDER BY s.subscribed_at NULLS LAST, s.list_subscription_id
    ) = 1
),

by_email AS (
  SELECT
    l.email,
    OBJECT_AGG(l.list_code, l.list_status::VARIANT) AS list_status_by_list,
    ARRAY_AGG(
      IFF(l.list_status = 'subscribed', l.list_code, NULL)
    ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.list_code) AS subscribed_lists,
    COUNT_IF(l.list_status = 'subscribed') AS subscribed_list_count,
    MIN(l.subscribed_at) AS first_subscribed_at,
    MAX(l.unsubscribed_at) AS last_unsubscribed_at,
    BOOLAND_AGG(l.list_status IN ('unsubscribed', 'cleaned')) AS is_globally_unsubscribed,
    BOOLOR_AGG(COALESCE(l.is_double_opt_in, FALSE)) AS has_double_opt_in
  FROM latest_per_list AS l
  GROUP BY
    l.email
),

customer_emails AS (
  SELECT
    c.email_normalised AS email,
    MIN(c.customer_id) AS customer_id
  FROM customers AS c
  WHERE c.email_normalised IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    c.email_normalised
),

prospect_emails AS (
  SELECT b.email::VARCHAR AS email
  FROM by_email AS b
  MINUS
  SELECT c.email::VARCHAR AS email
  FROM customer_emails AS c
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    b.email,
    SPLIT_PART(b.email, '@', 2)::VARCHAR AS email_domain,
    REGEXP_LIKE(
      b.email,
      '^(info|admin|sales|support|hello|contact|noreply|no-reply)@.*'
    )::BOOLEAN AS is_role_address,
    c.customer_id,
    (
      p.email IS NOT NULL
    )::BOOLEAN AS is_prospect,
    b.list_status_by_list::OBJECT AS list_status_by_list,
    b.subscribed_lists::ARRAY AS subscribed_lists,
    b.subscribed_list_count::INT AS subscribed_list_count,
    b.first_subscribed_at,
    b.last_unsubscribed_at,
    b.is_globally_unsubscribed::BOOLEAN AS is_globally_unsubscribed,
    b.has_double_opt_in::BOOLEAN AS has_double_opt_in,
    f.first_signup_form::VARCHAR AS first_signup_form
  FROM by_email AS b
  LEFT JOIN customer_emails AS c
    ON b.email = c.email
  LEFT JOIN prospect_emails AS p
    ON b.email = p.email
  LEFT JOIN first_signup AS f
    ON b.email = f.email
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_order_lines_discounted
statements.sql:
WITH order_lines AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_order_lines
),

line_discounts AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_order_line_discounts
),

promotions AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_promotions
),

discounts_with_promotion AS (
  SELECT
    d.order_line_id,
    d.discount_kind,
    COALESCE(d.discount_amount_minor, 0) AS discount_amount_minor,
    p.promo_code,
    COALESCE(p.is_stackable, FALSE) AS is_stackable
  FROM line_discounts AS d
  LEFT JOIN promotions AS p
    ON d.discount_code = p.promo_code
),

kind_totals AS (
  SELECT
    dp.order_line_id,
    dp.discount_kind,
    SUM(dp.discount_amount_minor) AS kind_amount_minor
  FROM discounts_with_promotion AS dp
  GROUP BY
    dp.order_line_id,
    dp.discount_kind
),

kind_objects AS (
  SELECT
    k.order_line_id,
    OBJECT_AGG(k.discount_kind, k.kind_amount_minor::VARIANT) AS discount_by_kind,
    SUM(k.kind_amount_minor) AS discount_amount_minor
  FROM kind_totals AS k
  GROUP BY
    k.order_line_id
),

promotion_sets AS (
  SELECT
    dp.order_line_id,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT dp.promo_code) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY dp.promo_code) AS promo_codes,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dp.promo_code) AS promotion_count,
    BOOLAND_AGG(dp.is_stackable) AS all_stackable
  FROM discounts_with_promotion AS dp
  WHERE dp.promo_code IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    dp.order_line_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    l.order_line_id,
    l.order_id,
    l.sku,
    l.quantity,
    l.gross_amount_minor,
    LEAST(COALESCE(k.discount_amount_minor, 0), l.gross_amount_minor)::INT AS discount_amount_minor,
    (
      l.gross_amount_minor - LEAST(COALESCE(k.discount_amount_minor, 0), l.gross_amount_minor)
    )::INT AS net_amount_minor,
    l.tax_amount_minor,
    COALESCE(k.discount_by_kind, OBJECT_CONSTRUCT())::OBJECT AS discount_by_kind,
    COALESCE(ps.promo_codes, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT())::ARRAY AS promo_codes,
    (
      COALESCE(ps.promotion_count, 0) > 1
      AND COALESCE(ps.all_stackable, FALSE)
    ) AS has_stacked_promotions,
    ROUND(
      COALESCE(k.discount_amount_minor, 0) / NULLIF(l.gross_amount_minor, 0),
      6
    )::NUMBER(9, 6) AS discount_share
  FROM order_lines AS l
  LEFT JOIN kind_objects AS k
    ON l.order_line_id = k.order_line_id
  LEFT JOIN promotion_sets AS ps
    ON l.order_line_id = ps.order_line_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_order_payments_rollup
statements.sql:
WITH attempts AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_payment_attempts
),

refunds AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_refunds
),

chargebacks AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_chargebacks
),

gift_card_transactions AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_gift_card_transactions
),

successful AS (
  SELECT
    a.order_id,
    CASE
      WHEN a.payment_method IN ('card', 'credit_card', 'debit_card')
      THEN 'CARD'
      WHEN a.payment_method IN ('wallet', 'phone_wallet', 'browser_wallet', 'account_wallet')
      THEN 'WALLET'
      WHEN a.payment_method IN ('bank_transfer', 'sepa', 'bank_redirect')
      THEN 'BANK'
      ELSE 'OTHER'
    END AS method_group,
    a.amount_minor
  FROM attempts AS a
  WHERE a.is_successful
),

captured_by_method AS (
  SELECT
    p.order_id,
    COALESCE(p.card, 0) AS card_captured_minor,
    COALESCE(p.wallet, 0) AS wallet_captured_minor,
    COALESCE(p.bank, 0) AS bank_transfer_captured_minor,
    COALESCE(p.other, 0) AS other_captured_minor
  FROM successful PIVOT(
    SUM(amount_minor) FOR method_group IN ('CARD', 'WALLET', 'BANK', 'OTHER')
  ) AS p(order_id, card, wallet, bank, other)
),

attempt_stats AS (
  SELECT
    a.order_id,
    COUNT_IF(NOT a.is_successful) AS failed_attempts,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT a.payment_method) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY a.payment_method) AS tender_methods
  FROM attempts AS a
  GROUP BY
    a.order_id
),

payment_orders AS (
  SELECT
    a.payment_id,
    a.order_id
  FROM attempts AS a
),

refunded AS (
  SELECT
    po.order_id,
    SUM(r.amount_minor) AS refunded_minor
  FROM refunds AS r
  INNER JOIN payment_orders AS po
    ON r.payment_id = po.payment_id
  GROUP BY
    po.order_id
),

charged_back AS (
  SELECT
    po.order_id,
    SUM(c.amount_minor) AS chargeback_minor
  FROM chargebacks AS c
  INNER JOIN payment_orders AS po
    ON c.payment_id = po.payment_id
  WHERE c.outcome <> 'won'
  GROUP BY
    po.order_id
),

gift_card_tender AS (
  SELECT
    g.order_id,
    -SUM(g.signed_amount_minor) AS gift_card_tender_minor
  FROM gift_card_transactions AS g
  WHERE
    g.transaction_type IN ('REDEEM', 'REVERSAL')
    AND g.order_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    g.order_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    s.order_id,
    COALESCE(m.card_captured_minor, 0)::INT AS card_captured_minor,
    COALESCE(m.wallet_captured_minor, 0)::INT AS wallet_captured_minor,
    COALESCE(m.bank_transfer_captured_minor, 0)::INT AS bank_transfer_captured_minor,
    COALESCE(m.other_captured_minor, 0)::INT AS other_captured_minor,
    (
      COALESCE(m.card_captured_minor, 0)
        + COALESCE(m.wallet_captured_minor, 0)
        + COALESCE(m.bank_transfer_captured_minor, 0)
        + COALESCE(m.other_captured_minor, 0)
    )::INT AS captured_minor,
    COALESCE(r.refunded_minor, 0)::INT AS refunded_minor,
    COALESCE(cb.chargeback_minor, 0)::INT AS chargeback_minor,
    COALESCE(g.gift_card_tender_minor, 0)::INT AS gift_card_tender_minor,
    (
      COALESCE(m.card_captured_minor, 0)
        + COALESCE(m.wallet_captured_minor, 0)
        + COALESCE(m.bank_transfer_captured_minor, 0)
        + COALESCE(m.other_captured_minor, 0)
        + COALESCE(g.gift_card_tender_minor, 0)
        - COALESCE(r.refunded_minor, 0)
        - COALESCE(cb.chargeback_minor, 0)
    )::INT AS net_collected_minor,
    s.failed_attempts::INT AS failed_attempts,
    s.tender_methods::ARRAY AS tender_methods
  FROM attempt_stats AS s
  LEFT JOIN captured_by_method AS m
    ON s.order_id = m.order_id
  LEFT JOIN refunded AS r
    ON s.order_id = r.order_id
  LEFT JOIN charged_back AS cb
    ON s.order_id = cb.order_id
  LEFT JOIN gift_card_tender AS g
    ON s.order_id = g.order_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_order_status_timeline
statements.sql:
WITH status_events AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_order_status_events
),

orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_orders
),

ranked_events AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    e.order_id,
    e.to_status,
    e.changed_at,
    PARSE_JSON('{"cancelled":7,"delivered":5,"packed":3,"paid":2,"pending":1,"returned":6,"shipped":4}')[e.to_status]::INT AS status_rank,
    LEAD(e.changed_at) OVER (
      PARTITION BY e.order_id
      ORDER BY e.changed_at, e.event_id
    ) AS next_changed_at
  FROM status_events AS e
),

with_previous AS (
  SELECT
    r.event_id,
    r.order_id,
    r.to_status,
    r.changed_at,
    r.status_rank,
    r.next_changed_at,
    LAG(r.status_rank) OVER (
      PARTITION BY r.order_id
      ORDER BY r.changed_at, r.event_id
    ) AS previous_rank
  FROM ranked_events AS r
),

durations AS (
  SELECT
    w.order_id,
    w.to_status,
    SUM(
      DATEDIFF('minute', w.changed_at, COALESCE(w.next_changed_at, w.changed_at))
    ) AS minutes_in_status
  FROM with_previous AS w
  GROUP BY
    w.order_id,
    w.to_status
),

longest AS (
  SELECT
    d.order_id,
    MAX_BY(d.to_status, d.minutes_in_status) AS longest_status
  FROM durations AS d
  GROUP BY
    d.order_id
),

milestones AS (
  SELECT
    w.order_id,
    COUNT(*) AS transition_count,
    MIN(IFF(w.to_status = 'paid', w.changed_at, NULL)) AS first_paid_at,
    MIN(IFF(w.to_status = 'shipped', w.changed_at, NULL)) AS first_shipped_at,
    MIN(IFF(w.to_status = 'delivered', w.changed_at, NULL)) AS first_delivered_at,
    MAX(IFF(w.to_status = 'cancelled', w.changed_at, NULL)) AS cancelled_at,
    LISTAGG(w.to_status, ' > ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY w.changed_at, w.event_id) AS status_path,
    BOOLOR_AGG(
      w.status_rank < w.previous_rank AND w.to_status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')
    ) AS has_regression,
    MAX_BY(w.to_status, w.changed_at) AS last_status
  FROM with_previous AS w
  GROUP BY
    w.order_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    m.order_id,
    m.transition_count::INT AS transition_count,
    m.first_paid_at,
    m.first_shipped_at,
    m.first_delivered_at,
    m.cancelled_at,
    DATEDIFF('minute', o.placed_at, m.first_paid_at)::INT AS minutes_to_pay,
    ROUND(
      DATEDIFF('minute', m.first_paid_at, m.first_shipped_at) / 60,
      2
    )::NUMBER(12, 2) AS hours_paid_to_shipped,
    m.status_path::VARCHAR AS status_path,
    COALESCE(m.has_regression, FALSE) AS has_regression,
    m.last_status::VARCHAR AS last_status,
    l.longest_status::VARCHAR AS longest_status
  FROM milestones AS m
  INNER JOIN orders AS o
    ON m.order_id = o.order_id
  LEFT JOIN longest AS l
    ON m.order_id = l.order_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_orders_enriched
statements.sql:
WITH orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_orders
),

lines AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_order_lines_priced
),

customers AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_customers
),

payments AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_payments
),

addresses AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_customer_addresses
),

redemptions AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_promotion_redemptions
),

countries AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__countries
),

line_totals AS (
  SELECT
    l.order_id,
    COUNT(*) AS line_count,
    SUM(l.quantity) AS units,
    SUM(l.gross_amount_minor) AS gross_amount_minor,
    SUM(l.discount_amount_minor) AS discount_amount_minor,
    SUM(l.net_amount_minor) AS net_amount_minor,
    SUM(l.tax_amount_minor) AS tax_amount_minor,
    SUM(l.line_weight_kg) AS total_weight_kg
  FROM lines AS l
  GROUP BY
    l.order_id
),

captured AS (
  SELECT
    p.order_id,
    SUM(
      IFF(p.gateway_status IN ('captured', 'settled'), p.amount_minor, 0)
    ) AS captured_amount_minor
  FROM payments AS p
  GROUP BY
    p.order_id
),

first_redemption AS (
  SELECT
    r.order_id,
    r.promo_code
  FROM redemptions AS r
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.order_id ORDER BY r.redeemed_at, r.redemption_id) = 1
),

shipping AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    a.country_code AS ship_to_country_code
  FROM orders AS o
  INNER JOIN addresses AS a
    ON o.shipping_address_id = a.address_id
),

storefronts AS (
  SELECT
    c.country_code AS storefront_code,
    c.region_code,
    c.default_timezone
  FROM countries AS c
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.storefront_code,
    COALESCE(s.region_code, cu.region_code)::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    COALESCE(s.default_timezone, 'UTC')::VARCHAR AS storefront_timezone,
    o.currency_code,
    o.placed_at,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE(COALESCE(s.default_timezone, 'UTC'), o.placed_at)::DATE AS placed_date_local,
    o.order_status,
    COALESCE(o.sales_channel, 'web')::VARCHAR AS sales_channel,
    COALESCE(t.line_count, 0)::INT AS line_count,
    COALESCE(t.units, 0)::INT AS units,
    COALESCE(t.gross_amount_minor, 0)::INT AS gross_amount_minor,
    COALESCE(t.discount_amount_minor, 0)::INT AS discount_amount_minor,
    COALESCE(t.net_amount_minor, 0)::INT AS net_amount_minor,
    COALESCE(t.tax_amount_minor, 0)::INT AS tax_amount_minor,
    COALESCE(c.captured_amount_minor, 0)::INT AS captured_amount_minor,
    GREATEST(
      COALESCE(t.net_amount_minor, 0)
        + COALESCE(t.tax_amount_minor, 0)
        - COALESCE(c.captured_amount_minor, 0),
      0
    )::INT AS outstanding_amount_minor,
    r.promo_code,
    sh.ship_to_country_code,
    COALESCE(sh.ship_to_country_code <> o.storefront_code, FALSE) AS is_cross_border,
    NOT RLIKE(
      COALESCE(cu.email_normalised, ''),
      '.*@example\\.(org|net)$'
    ) AS is_first_party_customer,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(t.units, 0) <= 1
      THEN 'SINGLE'
      WHEN t.units < 6
      THEN 'SMALL'
      ELSE 'LARGE'
    END::VARCHAR AS basket_size,
    COALESCE(o.is_gift, FALSE) AS is_gift,
    NULLIF(LOWER(o.utm_source), '')::VARCHAR AS utm_source,
    NULLIF(LOWER(o.utm_medium), '')::VARCHAR AS utm_medium,
    NULLIF(LOWER(o.utm_campaign), '')::VARCHAR AS utm_campaign,
    COALESCE(t.total_weight_kg, 0)::NUMBER(12, 3) AS total_weight_kg
  FROM orders AS o
  LEFT JOIN line_totals AS t
    ON o.order_id = t.order_id
  LEFT JOIN captured AS c
    ON o.order_id = c.order_id
  LEFT JOIN first_redemption AS r
    ON o.order_id = r.order_id
  LEFT JOIN shipping AS sh
    ON o.order_id = sh.order_id
  LEFT JOIN storefronts AS s
    ON o.storefront_code = s.storefront_code
  LEFT JOIN customers AS cu
    ON o.customer_id = cu.customer_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_orders_usd
statements.sql:
WITH orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_orders_enriched
),

fx_rates AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
),

currencies AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__currencies
),

orders_with_exponent AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.region_code,
    o.currency_code,
    o.placed_at,
    o.placed_date_local,
    o.order_status,
    o.sales_channel,
    o.units,
    o.net_amount_minor AS amount_minor,
    o.gross_amount_minor,
    o.discount_amount_minor,
    o.tax_amount_minor,
    o.promo_code,
    o.utm_source,
    o.utm_medium,
    o.utm_campaign,
    o.basket_size,
    c.minor_unit_exponent
  FROM orders AS o
  INNER JOIN currencies AS c
    ON o.currency_code = c.currency_code
),

orders_with_rate AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.region_code,
    o.currency_code,
    o.placed_at,
    o.placed_date_local,
    o.order_status,
    o.sales_channel,
    o.units,
    o.amount_minor,
    o.gross_amount_minor,
    o.discount_amount_minor,
    o.tax_amount_minor,
    o.promo_code,
    o.utm_source,
    o.utm_medium,
    o.utm_campaign,
    o.basket_size,
    o.minor_unit_exponent,
    fx.rate_to_usd,
    fx.rate_date
  FROM orders_with_exponent AS o
  ASOF JOIN fx_rates AS fx MATCH_CONDITION (o.placed_date_local >= fx.rate_date)
    ON o.currency_code = fx.currency_code
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    r.order_id,
    r.customer_id,
    r.region_code,
    r.currency_code,
    r.placed_at,
    r.placed_date_local,
    r.order_status,
    r.sales_channel,
    r.units,
    ROUND((
  (r.amount_minor) / NULLIF((POWER(10, (r.minor_unit_exponent))::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 6)::NUMBER(38, 6) AS amount,
  ROUND(
    (ROUND((
  (r.amount_minor) / NULLIF((POWER(10, (r.minor_unit_exponent))::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 6)::NUMBER(38, 6)) * r.rate_to_usd,
    2
  )::NUMBER(18, 2) AS amount_usd,
    ROUND(
      (ROUND((
  r.gross_amount_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, r.minor_unit_exponent)::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 6)::NUMBER(38, 6)) * r.rate_to_usd,
      2
    )::NUMBER(18, 2) AS gross_amount_usd,
    ROUND(
      (ROUND((
  r.discount_amount_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, r.minor_unit_exponent)::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 6)::NUMBER(38, 6)) * r.rate_to_usd,
      2
    )::NUMBER(18, 2) AS discount_amount_usd,
    ROUND(
      (ROUND((
  r.tax_amount_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, r.minor_unit_exponent)::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 6)::NUMBER(38, 6)) * r.rate_to_usd,
      2
    )::NUMBER(18, 2) AS tax_amount_usd,
    r.rate_to_usd,
    r.rate_date,
    DATEDIFF('day', r.rate_date, r.placed_date_local)::INT AS rate_age_days,
    (
      DATEDIFF('day', r.rate_date, r.placed_date_local) > 7
    ) AS is_rate_stale,
    r.promo_code,
    r.utm_source,
    r.utm_medium,
    r.utm_campaign,
    r.basket_size
  FROM orders_with_rate AS r
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_partner_fees_usd
statements.sql:
WITH settlements AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_partner_settlements
),

orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_partner_orders_unified
),

order_lines AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_partner_order_lines
),

listings AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_partner_listings
),

fx_rates AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
),

currencies AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__currencies
),

listing_terms AS (
  SELECT
    l.partner_code,
    l.sku,
    l.commission_pct
  FROM listings AS l
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY l.partner_code, l.sku
      ORDER BY l.listed_at DESC NULLS LAST, l.listing_id DESC
    ) = 1
),

line_context AS (
  SELECT
    o.partner_code,
    o.placed_date,
    o.partner_order_key,
    l.sku,
    l.quantity * l.unit_amount_minor AS line_amount_minor
  FROM order_lines AS l
  INNER JOIN orders AS o
    ON l.partner_order_key = o.partner_order_key
),

line_commission AS (
  SELECT
    c.partner_code,
    c.placed_date,
    c.partner_order_key,
    c.line_amount_minor * t.commission_pct / 100 AS expected_commission_minor,
    (
      t.commission_pct IS NULL
    ) AS has_no_listing
  FROM line_context AS c
  LEFT JOIN listing_terms AS t
    ON c.partner_code = t.partner_code
    AND c.sku = t.sku
),

period_lines AS (
  SELECT
    s.settlement_id,
    SUM(c.expected_commission_minor) AS expected_commission_minor,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.partner_order_key) AS period_order_count,
    COUNT_IF(c.has_no_listing) AS lines_without_listing
  FROM settlements AS s
  INNER JOIN line_commission AS c
    ON s.partner_code = c.partner_code
    AND c.placed_date BETWEEN s.period_start AND s.period_end
  GROUP BY
    s.settlement_id
),

with_rate AS (
  SELECT
    s.settlement_id,
    s.partner_code,
    s.period_start,
    s.period_end,
    s.currency_code,
    s.gross_sales_minor,
    s.commission_minor,
    s.other_fees_minor,
    s.net_payable_minor,
    cur.minor_unit_exponent,
    fx.rate_to_usd
  FROM settlements AS s
  LEFT JOIN currencies AS cur
    ON s.currency_code = cur.currency_code
  ASOF JOIN fx_rates AS fx MATCH_CONDITION (s.period_end >= fx.rate_date)
    ON s.currency_code = fx.currency_code
),

converted AS (
  SELECT
    w.settlement_id,
    w.partner_code,
    w.period_start,
    w.period_end,
    w.currency_code,
    w.gross_sales_minor,
    w.commission_minor,
    w.other_fees_minor,
    w.net_payable_minor,
    (ROUND((
  w.gross_sales_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, COALESCE(w.minor_unit_exponent, 2))::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 6)::NUMBER(38, 6)) * w.rate_to_usd AS gross_sales_usd,
    (ROUND((
  w.commission_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, COALESCE(w.minor_unit_exponent, 2))::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 6)::NUMBER(38, 6)) * w.rate_to_usd AS stated_commission_usd,
    (ROUND((
  p.expected_commission_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, COALESCE(w.minor_unit_exponent, 2))::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 6)::NUMBER(38, 6)) * w.rate_to_usd AS expected_commission_usd,
    (ROUND((
  w.other_fees_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, COALESCE(w.minor_unit_exponent, 2))::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 6)::NUMBER(38, 6)) * w.rate_to_usd AS other_fees_usd,
    (ROUND((
  w.net_payable_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, COALESCE(w.minor_unit_exponent, 2))::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 6)::NUMBER(38, 6)) * w.rate_to_usd AS net_payable_usd,
    COALESCE(p.period_order_count, 0) AS period_order_count,
    COALESCE(p.lines_without_listing, 0) AS lines_without_listing
  FROM with_rate AS w
  LEFT JOIN period_lines AS p
    ON w.settlement_id = p.settlement_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    c.settlement_id,
    c.partner_code,
    c.period_start,
    c.period_end,
    (
      DATEDIFF('day', c.period_start, c.period_end) + 1
    )::INT AS period_days,
    c.currency_code,
    ROUND(c.gross_sales_usd, 2)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS gross_sales_usd,
    ROUND(c.stated_commission_usd, 2)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS stated_commission_usd,
    ROUND(c.expected_commission_usd, 2)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS expected_commission_usd,
    ROUND(c.other_fees_usd, 2)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS other_fees_usd,
    ROUND(c.net_payable_usd, 2)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS net_payable_usd,
    c.period_order_count::INT AS period_order_count,
    c.lines_without_listing::INT AS lines_without_listing,
    ROUND(
      100 * c.commission_minor / NULLIF(c.gross_sales_minor, 0),
      4
    )::NUMBER(9, 4) AS effective_commission_pct,
    ROUND(
      100
      * (
        c.stated_commission_usd - c.expected_commission_usd
      )
      / NULLIF(c.expected_commission_usd, 0),
      4
    )::NUMBER(9, 4) AS commission_variance_pct,
    COALESCE(ABS(100
    * (
      c.stated_commission_usd - c.expected_commission_usd
    )
    / NULLIF(
      c.expected_commission_usd,
      0
    )) <= 0.5, FALSE)::BOOLEAN AS is_within_tolerance,
    (
      c.gross_sales_minor
        - c.commission_minor
        - COALESCE(c.other_fees_minor, 0) = c.net_payable_minor
    )::BOOLEAN AS statement_balances
  FROM converted AS c
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_partner_listing_status
statements.sql:
WITH listings AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_partner_listings
),

catalogue AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_product_catalogue
),

reservations AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_reservations_open
),

price_history AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_price_history
),

partner_orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_partner_orders_unified
),

order_lines AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_partner_order_lines
),

normalised AS (
  SELECT
    l.listing_id,
    l.partner_code,
    l.sku,
    CASE
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(l.listing_status, '^(live|active|published|on_?sale)$')
      THEN 'live'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(l.listing_status, '^(paused|inactive|suspended|out_?of_?stock)$')
      THEN 'paused'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(l.listing_status, '^(rejected|blocked|error.*)$')
      THEN 'rejected'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(l.listing_status, '^(draft|pending.*|in_?review)$')
      THEN 'draft'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(l.listing_status, '^(ended|closed|deleted|archived)$')
      THEN 'ended'
      ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS listing_state,
    l.listed_at,
    l.commission_pct,
    l.fulfilled_by_partner,
    OBJECT_KEYS(COALESCE(l.terms, OBJECT_CONSTRUCT())) AS term_keys,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY l.sku) AS partners_listing_sku
  FROM listings AS l
),

current_prices AS (
  SELECT
    p.sku,
    p.currency_code,
    p.list_amount_minor
  FROM price_history AS p
  WHERE
    p.effective_valid_to IS NULL
    OR p.effective_valid_to > '2026-03-31'::DATE
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY p.sku
      ORDER BY IFF(
        p.currency_code = 'USD',
        0,
        1
      ), p.valid_from DESC, p.price_list_id
    ) = 1
),

stock AS (
  SELECT
    r.sku,
    SUM(GREATEST(r.available_to_promise, 0)) AS available_to_promise
  FROM reservations AS r
  GROUP BY
    r.sku
),

recent_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.partner_order_key,
    o.partner_code
  FROM partner_orders AS o
  WHERE
    o.placed_date > DATEADD(
      'day',
      -30,
      '2026-03-31'::DATE
    )
),

recent_sales AS (
  SELECT
    o.partner_code,
    l.sku,
    SUM(l.quantity) AS units_sold_30d
  FROM order_lines AS l
  INNER JOIN recent_orders AS o
    ON l.partner_order_key = o.partner_order_key
  GROUP BY
    o.partner_code,
    l.sku
),

joined AS (
  SELECT
    n.listing_id,
    n.partner_code,
    n.sku,
    n.listing_state,
    n.listed_at,
    c.title AS product_title,
    c.brand_name,
    c.is_active AS is_catalogue_active,
    p.list_amount_minor AS current_list_price_minor,
    p.currency_code AS list_price_currency_code,
    COALESCE(s.available_to_promise, 0) AS available_to_promise,
    n.commission_pct,
    n.fulfilled_by_partner,
    n.term_keys,
    COALESCE(rs.units_sold_30d, 0) AS units_sold_30d,
    n.partners_listing_sku
  FROM normalised AS n
  LEFT JOIN catalogue AS c
    ON n.sku = c.sku
  LEFT JOIN current_prices AS p
    ON n.sku = p.sku
  LEFT JOIN stock AS s
    ON n.sku = s.sku
  LEFT JOIN recent_sales AS rs
    ON n.partner_code = rs.partner_code
    AND n.sku = rs.sku
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    j.listing_id,
    j.partner_code,
    j.sku,
    j.listing_state::VARCHAR AS listing_state,
    j.listed_at,
    DATEDIFF(
      'day',
      j.listed_at,
      '2026-03-31'::DATE
    )::INT AS days_listed,
    j.product_title::VARCHAR AS product_title,
    j.brand_name::VARCHAR AS brand_name,
    j.is_catalogue_active::BOOLEAN AS is_catalogue_active,
    j.current_list_price_minor::INT AS current_list_price_minor,
    j.list_price_currency_code::VARCHAR AS list_price_currency_code,
    j.available_to_promise::INT AS available_to_promise,
    j.commission_pct,
    j.fulfilled_by_partner,
    IFF(
      j.fulfilled_by_partner,
      'partner',
      'home_delivery'
    ) AS fulfilment_method,
    j.term_keys::ARRAY AS term_keys,
    j.units_sold_30d::INT AS units_sold_30d,
    j.partners_listing_sku::INT AS partners_listing_sku,
    CASE
      WHEN j.listing_state <> 'live'
      THEN 'not_live'
      WHEN j.product_title IS NULL
      THEN 'unknown_sku'
      WHEN NOT COALESCE(j.is_catalogue_active, FALSE)
      THEN 'discontinued'
      WHEN NOT j.fulfilled_by_partner
      AND j.available_to_promise <= 0
      THEN 'unfulfillable'
      WHEN j.current_list_price_minor IS NULL
      THEN 'unpriced'
      ELSE 'healthy'
    END::VARCHAR AS listing_health
  FROM joined AS j
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_partner_orders_unified
statements.sql:
WITH orders_v1 AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_partner_orders_v1
),

orders_v2 AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_partner_orders_v2
),

order_lines AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_partner_order_lines
),

identities AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_customer_identity
),

fx_rates AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
),

currencies AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__currencies
),

headers AS (
  SELECT CAST('stg_partner_orders_v1' AS VARCHAR) AS source_relation, partner_order_key, partner_code, external_order_id, currency_code FROM rel__stg_partner_orders_v1
UNION ALL
SELECT CAST('stg_partner_orders_v2' AS VARCHAR) AS source_relation, partner_order_key, partner_code, external_order_id, currency_code FROM rel__stg_partner_orders_v2
),

v1_details AS (
  SELECT
    o.partner_order_key,
    1 AS payload_version,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', o.placed_at)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS placed_at_utc,
    ROUND(o.order_total * POWER(10, c.minor_unit_exponent)) AS order_total_minor,
    o.buyer_email,
    SHA2(o.buyer_email, 256) AS buyer_email_hash
  FROM orders_v1 AS o
  LEFT JOIN currencies AS c
    ON o.currency_code = c.currency_code
),

v2_details AS (
  SELECT
    o.partner_order_key,
    2 AS payload_version,
    o.placed_at_utc,
    o.order_total_minor,
    NULL::VARCHAR AS buyer_email,
    o.buyer_email_hash
  FROM orders_v2 AS o
),

details AS (
  SELECT
    d.partner_order_key::VARCHAR AS partner_order_key,
    d.payload_version::INT AS payload_version,
    d.placed_at_utc::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS placed_at_utc,
    d.order_total_minor::INT AS order_total_minor,
    d.buyer_email::VARCHAR AS buyer_email,
    d.buyer_email_hash::VARCHAR AS buyer_email_hash
  FROM v1_details AS d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    d.partner_order_key::VARCHAR AS partner_order_key,
    d.payload_version::INT AS payload_version,
    d.placed_at_utc::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS placed_at_utc,
    d.order_total_minor::INT AS order_total_minor,
    d.buyer_email::VARCHAR AS buyer_email,
    d.buyer_email_hash::VARCHAR AS buyer_email_hash
  FROM v2_details AS d
),

line_totals AS (
  SELECT
    l.partner_order_key,
    COUNT(*) AS line_count,
    SUM(l.quantity) AS units,
    SUM(l.quantity * l.unit_amount_minor) AS lines_total_minor
  FROM order_lines AS l
  GROUP BY
    l.partner_order_key
),

identity_hashes AS (
  SELECT
    SHA2(i.email_normalised, 256) AS email_hash,
    MIN(i.customer_id) AS customer_id
  FROM identities AS i
  WHERE i.email_normalised IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    SHA2(i.email_normalised, 256)
),

combined AS (
  SELECT
    h.partner_order_key,
    h.source_relation,
    d.payload_version,
    h.partner_code,
    h.external_order_id,
    h.currency_code,
    d.placed_at_utc,
    d.placed_at_utc::DATE AS placed_date,
    d.order_total_minor,
    COALESCE(t.line_count, 0) AS line_count,
    COALESCE(t.units, 0) AS units,
    COALESCE(t.lines_total_minor, 0) AS lines_total_minor,
    i.customer_id,
    c.minor_unit_exponent
  FROM headers AS h
  INNER JOIN details AS d
    ON h.partner_order_key = d.partner_order_key
  LEFT JOIN line_totals AS t
    ON h.partner_order_key = t.partner_order_key
  LEFT JOIN identity_hashes AS i
    ON d.buyer_email_hash = i.email_hash
  LEFT JOIN currencies AS c
    ON h.currency_code = c.currency_code
),

with_rate AS (
  SELECT
    c.partner_order_key,
    c.source_relation,
    c.payload_version,
    c.partner_code,
    c.external_order_id,
    c.currency_code,
    c.placed_at_utc,
    c.placed_date,
    c.order_total_minor,
    c.line_count,
    c.units,
    c.lines_total_minor,
    c.customer_id,
    c.minor_unit_exponent,
    fx.rate_to_usd
  FROM combined AS c
  ASOF JOIN fx_rates AS fx MATCH_CONDITION (c.placed_date >= fx.rate_date)
    ON c.currency_code = fx.currency_code
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    w.partner_order_key,
    w.source_relation::VARCHAR AS source_relation,
    w.payload_version,
    w.partner_code::VARCHAR AS partner_code,
    w.external_order_id::VARCHAR AS external_order_id,
    w.currency_code::VARCHAR AS currency_code,
    w.placed_at_utc,
    w.placed_date::DATE AS placed_date,
    w.order_total_minor,
    ROUND(
      (ROUND((
  w.order_total_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, COALESCE(w.minor_unit_exponent, 2))::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 6)::NUMBER(38, 6)) * w.rate_to_usd,
      2
    )::NUMBER(18, 2) AS order_total_usd,
    w.line_count::INT AS line_count,
    w.units::INT AS units,
    w.lines_total_minor::INT AS lines_total_minor,
    (
      w.lines_total_minor = w.order_total_minor
    )::BOOLEAN AS lines_match_total,
    w.customer_id::VARCHAR AS customer_id,
    (
      w.customer_id IS NOT NULL
    )::BOOLEAN AS is_known_customer,
    COUNT(*) OVER (
      PARTITION BY w.partner_code
      ORDER BY w.placed_at_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    )::INT AS order_rank_for_partner
  FROM with_rate AS w
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_payout_reconciliation
statements.sql:
WITH payouts AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_payouts
),

payout_lines AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_payout_lines
),

payments AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_payments
),

reports AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_settlement_reports
),

payout_sequence AS (
  SELECT
    p.payout_id,
    DATEDIFF(
      'day',
      LAG(p.paid_out_on) OVER (
        PARTITION BY p.provider_code, p.currency_code
        ORDER BY p.paid_out_on, p.payout_id
      ),
      p.paid_out_on
    ) AS days_since_previous_payout,
    ARRAY_SIZE(COALESCE(p.lines, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT())) AS embedded_line_count
  FROM payouts AS p
),

line_totals AS (
  SELECT
    l.payout_id,
    SUM(
      IFF(l.line_type = 'refund', -ABS(l.gross_minor), l.gross_minor) - COALESCE(l.fee_minor, 0)
    ) AS lines_net_minor,
    COUNT_IF(l.line_type = 'charge') AS charge_line_count,
    COUNT_IF(l.line_type = 'refund') AS refund_line_count,
    COUNT(*) AS loaded_line_count
  FROM payout_lines AS l
  GROUP BY
    l.payout_id
),

orphan_payment_ids AS (
  SELECT l.payment_id::VARCHAR AS payment_id
  FROM payout_lines AS l
  WHERE l.payment_id IS NOT NULL
  MINUS
  SELECT p.payment_id::VARCHAR AS payment_id
  FROM payments AS p
),

line_matches AS (
  SELECT
    l.payout_id,
    COUNT(o.payment_id) AS orphan_line_count,
    SUM(
      IFF(o.payment_id IS NULL AND l.line_type = 'charge', p.amount_minor, 0)
    ) AS matched_payment_minor
  FROM payout_lines AS l
  LEFT JOIN orphan_payment_ids AS o
    ON l.payment_id = o.payment_id
  LEFT JOIN payments AS p
    ON l.payment_id = p.payment_id
  GROUP BY
    l.payout_id
),

daily_reports AS (
  SELECT
    r.provider_code,
    r.report_date,
    r.currency_code,
    r.report_id,
    r.gross_minor - COALESCE(r.fees_minor, 0) AS report_net_minor
  FROM reports AS r
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY r.provider_code, r.report_date, r.currency_code
      ORDER BY r.line_count DESC, r.report_id DESC
    ) = 1
),

joined AS (
  SELECT
    p.payout_id,
    p.provider_code,
    p.currency_code,
    p.paid_out_on,
    p.net_minor AS payout_net_minor,
    COALESCE(t.lines_net_minor, 0) AS lines_net_minor,
    COALESCE(t.charge_line_count, 0) AS charge_line_count,
    COALESCE(t.refund_line_count, 0) AS refund_line_count,
    COALESCE(m.orphan_line_count, 0) AS orphan_line_count,
    s.embedded_line_count,
    COALESCE(t.loaded_line_count, 0) AS loaded_line_count,
    COALESCE(m.matched_payment_minor, 0) AS matched_payment_minor,
    r.report_id,
    r.report_net_minor,
    s.days_since_previous_payout
  FROM payouts AS p
  INNER JOIN payout_sequence AS s
    ON p.payout_id = s.payout_id
  LEFT JOIN line_totals AS t
    ON p.payout_id = t.payout_id
  LEFT JOIN line_matches AS m
    ON p.payout_id = m.payout_id
  LEFT JOIN daily_reports AS r
    ON p.provider_code = r.provider_code
    AND p.paid_out_on = r.report_date
    AND p.currency_code = r.currency_code
),

checked AS (
  SELECT
    j.payout_id,
    j.provider_code,
    j.currency_code,
    j.paid_out_on,
    j.payout_net_minor,
    j.lines_net_minor,
    j.charge_line_count,
    j.refund_line_count,
    j.orphan_line_count,
    j.embedded_line_count,
    j.loaded_line_count,
    j.matched_payment_minor,
    j.report_id,
    j.report_net_minor,
    j.days_since_previous_payout,
    ABS(j.payout_net_minor - j.lines_net_minor) <= 5 AS lines_match_payout,
    COALESCE(
      ABS(j.payout_net_minor - j.report_net_minor) <= 5,
      FALSE
    ) AS report_matches_payout
  FROM joined AS j
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    c.payout_id,
    c.provider_code,
    c.currency_code,
    c.paid_out_on,
    c.payout_net_minor::INT AS payout_net_minor,
    c.lines_net_minor::INT AS lines_net_minor,
    c.charge_line_count::INT AS charge_line_count,
    c.refund_line_count::INT AS refund_line_count,
    c.orphan_line_count::INT AS orphan_line_count,
    c.embedded_line_count::INT AS embedded_line_count,
    c.loaded_line_count::INT AS loaded_line_count,
    c.matched_payment_minor::INT AS matched_payment_minor,
    c.report_id,
    c.report_net_minor::INT AS report_net_minor,
    c.lines_match_payout::BOOLEAN AS lines_match_payout,
    c.report_matches_payout::BOOLEAN AS report_matches_payout,
    CASE
      WHEN c.lines_match_payout
      AND c.report_matches_payout
      AND c.orphan_line_count = 0
      THEN 'reconciled'
      WHEN c.report_id IS NULL
      THEN 'awaiting_report'
      WHEN c.orphan_line_count > 0
      THEN 'orphan_lines'
      WHEN NOT c.lines_match_payout
      THEN 'line_mismatch'
      ELSE 'report_mismatch'
    END::VARCHAR AS reconciliation_status,
    c.days_since_previous_payout::INT AS days_since_previous_payout
  FROM checked AS c
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_pick_performance
statements.sql:
WITH pick_tasks AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_pick_tasks
),

warehouses AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_warehouses
),

countries AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__countries
),

holidays AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__holiday_calendar
),

warehouse_context AS (
  SELECT
    w.warehouse_code,
    w.opening_minutes,
    c.region_code
  FROM warehouses AS w
  LEFT JOIN countries AS c
    ON w.country_code = c.country_code
),

completed AS (
  SELECT
    t.picker_id,
    t.warehouse_code,
    t.started_at_local,
    t.started_at_local::DATE AS work_date_local,
    t.pick_seconds,
    t.units_picked
  FROM pick_tasks AS t
  WHERE
    t.completed_at_local IS NOT NULL
    AND t.pick_seconds > 0
),

daily AS (
  SELECT
    c.picker_id,
    c.warehouse_code,
    c.work_date_local,
    COUNT(*) AS task_count,
    SUM(c.units_picked) AS units_picked,
    SUM(c.pick_seconds) / 3600 AS active_hours,
    PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.pick_seconds) AS p90_task_seconds,
    MIN(HOUR(c.started_at_local)) AS first_task_hour_local
  FROM completed AS c
  GROUP BY
    c.picker_id,
    c.warehouse_code,
    c.work_date_local
),

with_context AS (
  SELECT
    d.picker_id,
    d.warehouse_code,
    d.work_date_local,
    d.task_count,
    d.units_picked,
    d.active_hours,
    d.p90_task_seconds,
    d.first_task_hour_local,
    60 * d.active_hours / NULLIF(w.opening_minutes, 0) AS shift_coverage,
    (
      h.holiday_date IS NOT NULL
    ) AS is_holiday
  FROM daily AS d
  LEFT JOIN warehouse_context AS w
    ON d.warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
  LEFT JOIN holidays AS h
    ON w.region_code = h.region_code
    AND d.work_date_local = h.holiday_date
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      d.picker_id || '|' || d.warehouse_code || '|' || TO_CHAR(d.work_date_local, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    )::VARCHAR AS picker_day_key,
    d.picker_id,
    d.warehouse_code,
    d.work_date_local,
    d.task_count::INT AS task_count,
    d.units_picked::INT AS units_picked,
    ROUND(d.active_hours, 2)::NUMBER(10, 2) AS active_hours,
    ROUND(d.units_picked / NULLIF(d.active_hours, 0), 2)::NUMBER(10, 2) AS units_per_hour,
    d.p90_task_seconds::INT AS p90_task_seconds,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY d.warehouse_code, d.work_date_local
      ORDER BY d.units_picked / NULLIF(d.active_hours, 0) DESC NULLS LAST
    )::INT AS rank_in_warehouse,
    d.first_task_hour_local::INT AS first_task_hour_local,
    ROUND(d.shift_coverage, 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS shift_coverage,
    d.is_holiday::BOOLEAN AS is_holiday
  FROM with_context AS d
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_price_history
statements.sql:
WITH price_lists AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_price_lists
),

ordered AS (
  SELECT
    p.price_list_id,
    p.sku,
    p.currency_code,
    p.list_amount_minor,
    p.valid_from,
    COALESCE(
      p.valid_to,
      LEAD(p.valid_from) OVER (
        PARTITION BY p.sku, p.currency_code
        ORDER BY p.valid_from, p.price_list_id
      )
    ) AS effective_valid_to,
    LAG(p.list_amount_minor) OVER (
      PARTITION BY p.sku, p.currency_code
      ORDER BY p.valid_from, p.price_list_id
    ) AS previous_amount_minor,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY p.sku, p.currency_code
      ORDER BY p.valid_from, p.price_list_id
    ) AS price_version,
    MIN(p.list_amount_minor) OVER (
      PARTITION BY p.sku, p.currency_code
      ORDER BY p.valid_from
      RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS lowest_price_30d_minor
  FROM price_lists AS p
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    o.price_list_id,
    o.sku,
    o.currency_code,
    o.list_amount_minor,
    o.valid_from,
    o.effective_valid_to,
    o.previous_amount_minor::INT AS previous_amount_minor,
    ROUND(
      100
      * (
        o.list_amount_minor - o.previous_amount_minor
      )
      / NULLIF(o.previous_amount_minor, 0),
      4
    )::NUMBER(9, 4) AS change_pct,
    COALESCE(o.list_amount_minor < o.previous_amount_minor, FALSE) AS is_markdown,
    o.price_version::INT AS price_version,
    DATEDIFF('day', o.valid_from, o.effective_valid_to)::INT AS days_at_price,
    o.lowest_price_30d_minor::INT AS lowest_price_30d_minor
  FROM ordered AS o
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_product_margin
statements.sql:
WITH catalogue AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_product_catalogue
),

price_history AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_price_history
),

costs AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_supplier_cost_current
),

fx_rates AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
),

currencies AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__currencies
),

current_prices AS (
  SELECT
    ph.sku,
    ph.currency_code,
    ph.list_amount_minor,
    '2026-03-31'::DATE AS valuation_date
  FROM price_history AS ph
  WHERE ph.effective_valid_to IS NULL
),

with_exponent AS (
  SELECT
    cp.sku,
    cp.currency_code,
    cp.list_amount_minor,
    cp.valuation_date,
    c.minor_unit_exponent
  FROM current_prices AS cp
  INNER JOIN currencies AS c
    ON cp.currency_code = c.currency_code
),

with_rate AS (
  SELECT
    w.sku,
    w.currency_code,
    w.list_amount_minor,
    w.minor_unit_exponent,
    fx.usd_to_rate
  FROM with_exponent AS w
  ASOF JOIN fx_rates AS fx MATCH_CONDITION (w.valuation_date >= fx.rate_date)
    ON w.currency_code = fx.currency_code
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      r.sku || ':' || r.currency_code
    )::VARCHAR AS sku_price_key,
    r.sku,
    r.currency_code,
    (ROUND((
  r.list_amount_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, r.minor_unit_exponent)::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 4)::NUMBER(38, 6))::NUMBER(18, 4) AS list_price,
    ROUND(c.unit_cost_usd * r.usd_to_rate, 4)::NUMBER(18, 4) AS unit_cost,
    (
      (ROUND((
  r.list_amount_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, r.minor_unit_exponent)::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 4)::NUMBER(38, 6))
        - ROUND(c.unit_cost_usd * r.usd_to_rate, 4)
    )::NUMBER(18, 4) AS unit_margin,
    ROUND(
      100
      * (
        1
          - ROUND(c.unit_cost_usd * r.usd_to_rate, 4)
          / NULLIF(
            ROUND((
  r.list_amount_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, r.minor_unit_exponent)::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 4)::NUMBER(38, 6),
            0
          )
      ),
      2
    )::NUMBER(9, 2) AS margin_pct,
    COALESCE(
      ROUND(
        c.unit_cost_usd * r.usd_to_rate,
        4
      ) > (ROUND((
  r.list_amount_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, r.minor_unit_exponent)::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 4)::NUMBER(38, 6)),
      FALSE
    ) AS is_below_cost,
    cat.category_level_1
  FROM with_rate AS r
  LEFT JOIN costs AS c
    ON r.sku = c.sku
  LEFT JOIN catalogue AS cat
    ON r.sku = cat.sku
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_product_specs_flat
statements.sql:
WITH products AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_products
),

spec_entries AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_id,
    LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(
      k.value::VARCHAR,
      '[^A-Za-z0-9]+',
      '_'
    )) AS spec_key,
    GET(p.specs, k.value::VARCHAR) AS spec_value
  FROM products AS p, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => OBJECT_KEYS(p.specs)) AS k
),

typed_entries AS (
  SELECT
    e.product_id,
    e.spec_key,
    e.spec_value,
    TYPEOF(e.spec_value) AS value_type,
    CASE
      WHEN IS_DECIMAL(e.spec_value)
      OR IS_INTEGER(e.spec_value)
      THEN e.spec_value::NUMBER(18, 4)
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
        e.spec_value::VARCHAR,
        '^\\s*[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?\\s*(mm|cm|m)\\s*$',
        'i'
      )
      THEN TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(e.spec_value::VARCHAR, '[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?'), 18, 4)
      * DECODE(
        LOWER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(
          e.spec_value::VARCHAR,
          '(mm|cm|m)',
          1,
          1,
          'i'
        )),
        'mm', 0.1,
        'm', 100,
        1
      )
    END AS numeric_value
  FROM spec_entries AS e
),

pivot_source AS (
  SELECT
    t.product_id,
    t.spec_key,
    t.spec_value
  FROM typed_entries AS t
  WHERE t.spec_key IN ('material', 'colour_family', 'dishwasher_safe')
),

pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_id,
    p.material,
    p.colour_family,
    p.dishwasher_safe
  FROM pivot_source PIVOT(
    MAX(spec_value) FOR spec_key IN ('material', 'colour_family', 'dishwasher_safe')
  ) AS p(product_id, material, colour_family, dishwasher_safe)
),

dimensions AS (
  SELECT
    t.product_id,
    MAX(IFF(t.spec_key IN ('width', 'width_cm'), t.numeric_value, NULL)) AS width_cm,
    MAX(IFF(t.spec_key IN ('height', 'height_cm'), t.numeric_value, NULL)) AS height_cm,
    MAX(IFF(t.spec_key IN ('capacity', 'capacity_ml'), t.numeric_value, NULL)) AS capacity_ml,
    COUNT(t.numeric_value) AS numeric_spec_count,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT t.value_type) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.value_type) AS spec_value_types
  FROM typed_entries AS t
  GROUP BY
    t.product_id
),

leftovers AS (
  SELECT
    t.product_id,
    OBJECT_AGG(t.spec_key, t.spec_value) AS other_specs
  FROM typed_entries AS t
  WHERE
    t.spec_key NOT IN (
      'material',
      'colour_family',
      'dishwasher_safe',
      'width',
      'width_cm',
      'height',
      'height_cm',
      'capacity',
      'capacity_ml'
    )
  GROUP BY
    t.product_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_id,
    INITCAP(pv.material::VARCHAR)::VARCHAR AS material,
    LOWER(pv.colour_family::VARCHAR)::VARCHAR AS colour_family,
    ROUND(d.width_cm, 2)::NUMBER(10, 2) AS width_cm,
    ROUND(d.height_cm, 2)::NUMBER(10, 2) AS height_cm,
    d.capacity_ml::INT AS capacity_ml,
    TRY_TO_BOOLEAN(pv.dishwasher_safe::VARCHAR)::BOOLEAN AS is_dishwasher_safe,
    COALESCE(d.spec_value_types, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT())::ARRAY AS spec_value_types,
    COALESCE(l.other_specs, OBJECT_CONSTRUCT())::OBJECT AS other_specs,
    COALESCE(d.numeric_spec_count, 0)::INT AS numeric_spec_count
  FROM products AS p
  LEFT JOIN pivoted AS pv
    ON p.product_id = pv.product_id
  LEFT JOIN dimensions AS d
    ON p.product_id = d.product_id
  LEFT JOIN leftovers AS l
    ON p.product_id = l.product_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_product_view_affinity
statements.sql:
WITH product_views AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_web_product_views
),

visitor_views AS (
  SELECT
    v.anonymous_id,
    v.sku,
    v.viewed_minute_utc,
    DATEADD('hour', 1, v.viewed_minute_utc) AS window_end_utc
  FROM product_views AS v
),

pairs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    a.anonymous_id,
    a.sku,
    b.sku AS co_viewed_sku
  FROM visitor_views AS a
  INNER JOIN visitor_views AS b
    ON a.anonymous_id = b.anonymous_id
    AND a.sku <> b.sku
    AND b.viewed_minute_utc BETWEEN a.viewed_minute_utc AND a.window_end_utc
),

pair_counts AS (
  SELECT
    p.sku,
    p.co_viewed_sku,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.anonymous_id) AS co_viewers
  FROM pairs AS p
  GROUP BY
    p.sku,
    p.co_viewed_sku
),

sku_counts AS (
  SELECT
    v.sku,
    COUNT(DISTINCT v.anonymous_id) AS sku_viewers
  FROM visitor_views AS v
  GROUP BY
    v.sku
),

visitor_total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.anonymous_id) AS total_viewers
  FROM visitor_views AS v
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      pc.sku || '>' || pc.co_viewed_sku
    )::VARCHAR AS sku_pair_key,
    pc.sku,
    pc.co_viewed_sku,
    pc.co_viewers::INT AS co_viewers,
    a.sku_viewers::INT AS sku_viewers,
    ROUND(pc.co_viewers / NULLIF(a.sku_viewers, 0), 6)::NUMBER(9, 6) AS co_view_rate,
    ROUND(
      (
        pc.co_viewers / NULLIF(a.sku_viewers, 0)
      )
      / NULLIF(b.sku_viewers / NULLIF(t.total_viewers, 0), 0),
      4
    )::NUMBER(12, 4) AS lift,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pc.sku ORDER BY pc.co_viewers DESC)::INT AS pair_rank
  FROM pair_counts AS pc
  INNER JOIN sku_counts AS a
    ON pc.sku = a.sku
  INNER JOIN sku_counts AS b
    ON pc.co_viewed_sku = b.sku
  CROSS JOIN visitor_total AS t
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_promotion_performance
statements.sql:
WITH promotions AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_promotions
),

redemptions AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_promotion_redemptions
),

orders_usd AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_orders_usd
),

tiers AS (
  SELECT
    p.promo_code,
    t.value:threshold_minor::INT AS threshold_minor
  FROM promotions AS p, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => p.rules:tiers, outer => TRUE) AS t
),

top_tiers AS (
  SELECT
    t.promo_code,
    MAX(t.threshold_minor) AS top_tier_threshold_minor
  FROM tiers AS t
  GROUP BY
    t.promo_code
),

redeemed_orders AS (
  SELECT
    r.promo_code,
    r.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.amount_usd,
    o.discount_amount_usd
  FROM redemptions AS r
  INNER JOIN orders_usd AS o
    ON r.order_id = o.order_id
),

promo_totals AS (
  SELECT
    ro.promo_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ro.order_id) AS redemption_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ro.customer_id) AS redeeming_customers,
    SUM(ro.amount_usd) AS revenue_usd,
    SUM(ro.discount_amount_usd) AS discount_usd,
    AVG(ro.amount_usd) AS avg_order_usd
  FROM redeemed_orders AS ro
  GROUP BY
    ro.promo_code
),

baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(o.amount_usd) AS baseline_avg_order_usd
  FROM orders_usd AS o
  WHERE o.promo_code IS NULL
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    p.promo_code,
    p.promo_name,
    (
      CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() BETWEEN p.starts_at AND COALESCE(p.ends_at, '9999-12-31'::TIMESTAMP_TZ)
    ) AS is_active_now,
    COALESCE(pt.redemption_count, 0)::INT AS redemption_count,
    COALESCE(pt.redeeming_customers, 0)::INT AS redeeming_customers,
    COALESCE(pt.revenue_usd, 0)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS revenue_usd,
    COALESCE(pt.discount_usd, 0)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS discount_usd,
    ((
  pt.discount_usd / NULLIF((pt.revenue_usd + pt.discount_usd), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6))::NUMBER(9, 6) AS discount_rate,
    ROUND(pt.avg_order_usd, 2)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS avg_order_usd,
    ROUND(b.baseline_avg_order_usd, 2)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS baseline_avg_order_usd,
    ROUND(100
    * (
      pt.avg_order_usd / NULLIF(b.baseline_avg_order_usd, 0) - 1
    ), 2)::NUMBER(9, 2) AS basket_uplift_pct,
    tt.top_tier_threshold_minor::INT AS top_tier_threshold_minor,
    ARRAY_SIZE(p.eligible_regions)::INT AS eligible_region_count
  FROM promotions AS p
  LEFT JOIN promo_totals AS pt
    ON p.promo_code = pt.promo_code
  LEFT JOIN top_tiers AS tt
    ON p.promo_code = tt.promo_code
  CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_purchase_order_lines_received
statements.sql:
WITH po_lines AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_purchase_order_lines
),

purchase_orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_purchase_orders
),

receipts AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_po_receipts
),

warehouses AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_warehouses
),

receipt_totals AS (
  SELECT
    r.po_id,
    r.sku,
    SUM(r.received_qty) AS received_qty,
    SUM(r.damaged_qty) AS damaged_qty,
    MIN(r.received_at_local) AS first_received_at_local,
    COUNT(*) AS receipt_count,
    ARRAY_DISTINCT(ARRAY_FLATTEN(ARRAY_AGG(r.discrepancy_codes))) AS discrepancy_codes
  FROM receipts AS r
  GROUP BY
    r.po_id,
    r.sku
),

expected_local AS (
  SELECT
    p.po_id,
    p.supplier_code,
    p.warehouse_code,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE(w.iana_timezone, p.expected_at)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS expected_at_local
  FROM purchase_orders AS p
  INNER JOIN warehouses AS w
    ON p.warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    l.po_line_key,
    l.po_id,
    e.supplier_code,
    e.warehouse_code,
    l.sku,
    l.ordered_qty,
    COALESCE(r.received_qty, 0)::INT AS received_qty,
    COALESCE(r.damaged_qty, 0)::INT AS damaged_qty,
    GREATEST(l.ordered_qty - COALESCE(r.received_qty, 0), 0)::INT AS outstanding_qty,
    ROUND(
      LEAST(COALESCE(r.received_qty, 0) / NULLIF(l.ordered_qty, 0), 1),
      4
    )::NUMBER(9, 4) AS fill_rate,
    r.first_received_at_local,
    GREATEST(
      DATEDIFF('day', e.expected_at_local, r.first_received_at_local),
      0
    )::INT AS days_late,
    COALESCE(r.receipt_count, 0)::INT AS receipt_count,
    COALESCE(r.discrepancy_codes, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT())::ARRAY AS discrepancy_codes
  FROM po_lines AS l
  INNER JOIN expected_local AS e
    ON l.po_id = e.po_id
  LEFT JOIN receipt_totals AS r
    ON l.po_id = r.po_id
    AND l.sku = r.sku
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_referral_conversions
statements.sql:
WITH invites AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_referral_invites
),

identities AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_customer_identity
),

order_sequence AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_customer_order_sequence
),

fx_rates AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
),

currencies AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__currencies
),

sequenced_invites AS (
  SELECT
    i.invite_id,
    i.referrer_customer_id,
    i.invitee_email,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(i.invitee_email, '@(.+)$', 1, 1, 'e', 1) AS invitee_email_domain,
    i.sent_at,
    i.accepted_at,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', i.sent_at)::DATE AS sent_date,
    i.reward_amount_minor,
    i.reward_currency_code,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY i.referrer_customer_id
      ORDER BY i.sent_at, i.invite_id
    ) AS invite_sequence_for_referrer
  FROM invites AS i
),

email_accounts AS (
  SELECT
    d.email_normalised,
    MIN_BY(d.customer_id, d.customer_id) AS customer_id
  FROM identities AS d
