  WHERE d.email_normalised IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    d.email_normalised
),

first_orders AS (
  SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    MIN_BY(s.order_id, s.placed_at) AS first_order_id,
    MIN(s.placed_at) AS first_order_at,
    MIN_BY(s.amount_usd, s.placed_at) AS first_order_usd
  FROM order_sequence AS s
  GROUP BY
    s.customer_id
),

referrer_orders AS (
  SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    COUNT(*) AS lifetime_orders
  FROM order_sequence AS s
  GROUP BY
    s.customer_id
),

reward_rates AS (
  SELECT
    v.invite_id,
    (ROUND((
  v.reward_amount_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, cur.minor_unit_exponent)::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 6)::NUMBER(38, 6)) * fx.rate_to_usd AS reward_usd
  FROM sequenced_invites AS v
  INNER JOIN currencies AS cur
    ON v.reward_currency_code = cur.currency_code
  ASOF JOIN fx_rates AS fx MATCH_CONDITION (v.sent_date >= fx.rate_date)
    ON v.reward_currency_code = fx.currency_code
),

matched AS (
  SELECT
    v.invite_id,
    v.referrer_customer_id,
    a.customer_id AS invitee_customer_id,
    v.invitee_email_domain,
    v.sent_at,
    v.accepted_at,
    v.invite_sequence_for_referrer,
    f.first_order_id,
    f.first_order_at,
    f.first_order_usd,
    r.reward_usd,
    COALESCE(ro.lifetime_orders, 0) AS referrer_lifetime_orders
  FROM sequenced_invites AS v
  LEFT JOIN email_accounts AS a
    ON v.invitee_email = a.email_normalised
  LEFT JOIN first_orders AS f
    ON a.customer_id = f.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN reward_rates AS r
    ON v.invite_id = r.invite_id
  LEFT JOIN referrer_orders AS ro
    ON v.referrer_customer_id = ro.customer_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    m.invite_id,
    m.referrer_customer_id,
    m.invitee_customer_id::VARCHAR AS invitee_customer_id,
    m.invitee_email_domain::VARCHAR AS invitee_email_domain,
    m.sent_at,
    m.accepted_at,
    ROUND(DATEDIFF('minute', m.sent_at, m.accepted_at) / 60, 2)::NUMBER(10, 2) AS hours_to_accept,
    m.first_order_id::VARCHAR AS first_order_id,
    m.first_order_usd::NUMBER(18, 2) AS first_order_usd,
    DATEDIFF('day', m.sent_at, m.first_order_at)::INT AS days_to_first_order,
    EQUAL_NULL(m.invitee_customer_id, m.referrer_customer_id)::BOOLEAN AS is_self_referral,
    COALESCE(
      m.first_order_at >= m.sent_at
      AND DATEDIFF('day', m.sent_at, m.first_order_at) <= 30
      AND m.first_order_usd >= 20.0
      AND NOT EQUAL_NULL(m.invitee_customer_id, m.referrer_customer_id),
      FALSE
    )::BOOLEAN AS is_qualified,
    ROUND(m.reward_usd, 2)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS reward_usd,
    m.invite_sequence_for_referrer::INT AS invite_sequence_for_referrer,
    m.referrer_lifetime_orders::INT AS referrer_lifetime_orders
  FROM matched AS m
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_refunds_usd
statements.sql:
WITH refunds AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_refunds
),

payments AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_payments
),

fx_rates AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
),

currencies AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__currencies
),

refund_context AS (
  SELECT
    r.refund_id,
    r.payment_id,
    p.order_id,
    p.currency_code,
    r.refunded_at,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', r.refunded_at)::DATE AS refunded_date,
    r.reason_category,
    r.amount_minor,
    p.amount_minor AS payment_amount_minor,
    p.captured_at
  FROM refunds AS r
  INNER JOIN payments AS p
    ON r.payment_id = p.payment_id
),

with_exponent AS (
  SELECT
    rc.refund_id,
    rc.payment_id,
    rc.order_id,
    rc.currency_code,
    rc.refunded_at,
    rc.refunded_date,
    rc.reason_category,
    rc.amount_minor,
    rc.payment_amount_minor,
    rc.captured_at,
    c.minor_unit_exponent
  FROM refund_context AS rc
  INNER JOIN currencies AS c
    ON rc.currency_code = c.currency_code
),

with_rate AS (
  SELECT
    w.refund_id,
    w.payment_id,
    w.order_id,
    w.currency_code,
    w.refunded_at,
    w.refunded_date,
    w.reason_category,
    w.amount_minor,
    w.payment_amount_minor,
    w.captured_at,
    w.minor_unit_exponent,
    fx.rate_to_usd
  FROM with_exponent AS w
  ASOF JOIN fx_rates AS fx MATCH_CONDITION (w.refunded_date >= fx.rate_date)
    ON w.currency_code = fx.currency_code
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    r.refund_id,
    r.payment_id,
    r.order_id,
    r.currency_code,
    r.refunded_at,
    r.refunded_date,
    r.reason_category,
    ROUND((
  (r.amount_minor) / NULLIF((POWER(10, (r.minor_unit_exponent))::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 6)::NUMBER(38, 6) AS amount,
  ROUND(
    (ROUND((
  (r.amount_minor) / NULLIF((POWER(10, (r.minor_unit_exponent))::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 6)::NUMBER(38, 6)) * r.rate_to_usd,
    2
  )::NUMBER(18, 2) AS amount_usd,
    DATEDIFF('day', r.captured_at, r.refunded_at)::INT AS days_after_payment,
    (
      r.amount_minor >= r.payment_amount_minor
    ) AS is_full_refund
  FROM with_rate AS r
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_reservations_open
statements.sql:
WITH reservations AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_stock_reservations
),

ledger AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_inventory_ledger
),

latest_balance AS (
  SELECT
    l.sku,
    l.warehouse_code,
    l.running_on_hand
  FROM ledger AS l
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY l.sku, l.warehouse_code
      ORDER BY l.entry_sequence DESC, l.ledger_entry_key DESC
    ) = 1
),

open_holds AS (
  SELECT
    r.sku,
    r.warehouse_code,
    COUNT(*) AS open_reservations,
    SUM(IFF(r.is_backorder, 0, r.qty)) AS reserved_qty,
    SUM(IFF(r.is_backorder, r.qty, 0)) AS backordered_qty,
    MIN(r.reserved_at) AS oldest_reserved_at
  FROM reservations AS r
  WHERE r.is_open
  GROUP BY
    r.sku,
    r.warehouse_code
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      o.sku || '|' || o.warehouse_code
    )::VARCHAR AS stock_key,
    o.sku,
    o.warehouse_code,
    o.open_reservations::INT AS open_reservations,
    o.reserved_qty::INT AS reserved_qty,
    o.backordered_qty::INT AS backordered_qty,
    COALESCE(b.running_on_hand, 0)::INT AS on_hand_qty,
    (
      COALESCE(b.running_on_hand, 0) - o.reserved_qty
    )::INT AS available_to_promise,
    o.oldest_reserved_at
  FROM open_holds AS o
  LEFT JOIN latest_balance AS b
    ON o.sku = b.sku
    AND o.warehouse_code = b.warehouse_code
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_return_outcomes
statements.sql:
WITH returns AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_return_reasons
),

raw_returns AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_returns
),

inspections AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_return_inspections
),

refunds AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_refunds_usd
),

latest_inspection AS (
  SELECT
    i.return_id,
    i.grade,
    i.is_resellable,
    ARRAY_SIZE(i.defect_codes) AS defect_count
  FROM inspections AS i
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY i.return_id
      ORDER BY i.inspected_at_local DESC, i.inspection_id DESC
    ) = 1
),

order_refunds AS (
  SELECT
    f.order_id,
    SUM(f.amount_usd) AS refund_usd,
    MIN(f.refunded_at) AS first_refunded_at
  FROM refunds AS f
  WHERE f.reason_category <> 'fraud'
  GROUP BY
    f.order_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    r.return_id,
    r.order_id,
    r.sku,
    r.return_reason,
    li.grade,
    li.is_resellable,
    orf.refund_usd::NUMBER(18, 2) AS refund_usd,
    DATEDIFF('day', rr.requested_at, rr.received_at)::INT AS days_to_receive,
    DATEDIFF('day', rr.requested_at, orf.first_refunded_at)::INT AS days_to_refund,
    CASE
      WHEN li.is_resellable
      THEN 'restocked'
      WHEN li.grade IS NOT NULL
      THEN 'written_off'
      WHEN orf.refund_usd IS NOT NULL
      THEN 'refunded_not_received'
      ELSE 'pending'
    END::VARCHAR AS outcome,
    COALESCE(li.defect_count, 0)::INT AS defect_count
  FROM returns AS r
  INNER JOIN raw_returns AS rr
    ON r.return_id = rr.return_id
  LEFT JOIN latest_inspection AS li
    ON r.return_id = li.return_id
  LEFT JOIN order_refunds AS orf
    ON r.order_id = orf.order_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_return_reasons
statements.sql:
WITH returns AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_returns
),

order_lines AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_order_lines
),

orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_orders
),

catalogue AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_product_catalogue
),

ordered_quantities AS (
  SELECT
    l.order_id,
    l.sku,
    SUM(l.quantity) AS ordered_qty
  FROM order_lines AS l
  GROUP BY
    l.order_id,
    l.sku
),

normalised AS (
  SELECT
    r.return_id,
    r.order_id,
    r.sku,
    r.qty,
    r.reason_text,
    r.requested_at,
    LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(
      COALESCE(r.reason_text, ''),
      '[^A-Za-z ]',
      ' '
    )) AS reason_words
  FROM returns AS r
),

with_order AS (
  SELECT
    n.return_id,
    n.order_id,
    n.sku,
    n.qty,
    n.reason_text,
    n.requested_at,
    n.reason_words,
    c.category_level_1,
    q.ordered_qty,
    o.placed_at
  FROM normalised AS n
  LEFT JOIN catalogue AS c
    ON n.sku = c.sku
  LEFT JOIN ordered_quantities AS q
    ON n.order_id = q.order_id
    AND n.sku = q.sku
  LEFT JOIN orders AS o
    ON n.order_id = o.order_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    n.return_id,
    n.order_id,
    n.sku,
    n.qty,
    n.reason_text,
    CASE
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(n.reason_words, '.*(damag|broken|crack|dent|scratch).*')
      THEN 'damaged'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
        n.reason_words,
        '.*(wrong item|wrong colou?r|not what i ordered|different).*'
      )
      THEN 'wrong_item'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(n.reason_words, '.*(too (big|small|large)|size|fit).*')
      THEN 'size_fit'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(n.reason_words, '.*(not as described|quality|looks different|photo).*')
      THEN 'not_as_described'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(n.reason_words, '.*(changed my mind|no longer|don t need|dont need).*')
      THEN 'changed_mind'
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(n.reason_words, '.*(late|delay|too long).*')
      THEN 'late_delivery'
      ELSE 'other'
    END::VARCHAR AS return_reason,
    IFF(TRIM(n.reason_words) = '', 'default', 'pattern')::VARCHAR AS classified_by,
    n.requested_at,
    n.category_level_1::VARCHAR AS category_level_1,
    n.ordered_qty::INT AS ordered_qty,
    COALESCE(n.qty > n.ordered_qty, TRUE)::BOOLEAN AS is_over_return,
    DATEDIFF('day', n.placed_at, n.requested_at)::INT AS days_after_order
  FROM with_order AS n
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_revenue_recognition_daily
statements.sql:
WITH orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_orders_usd
),

timelines AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_order_status_timeline
),

refunds AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_refunds_usd
),

subscription_days AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_subscription_mrr_daily
),

customers AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_customers
),

delivered_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.region_code,
    o.amount_usd - COALESCE(o.tax_amount_usd, 0) AS recognisable_usd,
    t.first_delivered_at
  FROM orders AS o
  INNER JOIN timelines AS t
    ON o.order_id = t.order_id
  WHERE t.first_delivered_at IS NOT NULL
),

order_regions AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.region_code
  FROM orders AS o
),

subscription_regions AS (
  SELECT
    d.subscription_day_key,
    d.calendar_date,
    d.mrr_usd,
    c.region_code
  FROM subscription_days AS d
  LEFT JOIN customers AS c
    ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id
),

recognition_events AS (
  SELECT
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE(
      COALESCE(PARSE_JSON('{"APAC":"Asia/Tokyo","EU":"Europe/Berlin","MENA":"Asia/Kuwait","US":"America/New_York"}')[d.region_code]::VARCHAR, 'UTC'),
      d.first_delivered_at
    )::DATE AS recognition_date,
    d.region_code::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'product'::VARCHAR AS revenue_stream,
    d.recognisable_usd::NUMBER(18, 4) AS amount_usd,
    d.order_id::VARCHAR AS document_id
  FROM delivered_orders AS d
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    r.refunded_date::DATE AS recognition_date,
    o.region_code::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'refund'::VARCHAR AS revenue_stream,
    (
      -r.amount_usd
    )::NUMBER(18, 4) AS amount_usd,
    r.refund_id::VARCHAR AS document_id
  FROM refunds AS r
  LEFT JOIN order_regions AS o
    ON r.order_id = o.order_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    s.calendar_date::DATE AS recognition_date,
    s.region_code::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'subscription'::VARCHAR AS revenue_stream,
    (
      s.mrr_usd * 12 / 365
    )::NUMBER(18, 4) AS amount_usd,
    s.subscription_day_key::VARCHAR AS document_id
  FROM subscription_regions AS s
),

daily AS (
  SELECT
    e.recognition_date,
    COALESCE(e.region_code, 'UNKNOWN') AS region_code,
    e.revenue_stream,
    SUM(e.amount_usd) AS revenue_usd,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.document_id) AS document_count
  FROM recognition_events AS e
  WHERE e.recognition_date <= '2026-03-31'::DATE
  GROUP BY
    e.recognition_date,
    COALESCE(e.region_code, 'UNKNOWN'),
    e.revenue_stream
),

rolling AS (
  SELECT
    d.recognition_date,
    d.region_code,
    d.revenue_stream,
    d.revenue_usd,
    d.document_count,
    SUM(d.revenue_usd) OVER (
      PARTITION BY d.region_code, d.revenue_stream, DATE_TRUNC('month', d.recognition_date)
      ORDER BY d.recognition_date
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS month_to_date_usd,
    SUM(d.revenue_usd) OVER (
      PARTITION BY d.region_code, d.revenue_stream
      ORDER BY d.recognition_date
      RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '6 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS trailing_7d_usd,
    RATIO_TO_REPORT(d.revenue_usd) OVER (
      PARTITION BY d.recognition_date, d.region_code
    ) AS share_of_day
  FROM daily AS d
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      TO_VARCHAR(r.recognition_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
        || ':'
        || r.region_code
        || ':'
        || r.revenue_stream
    )::VARCHAR AS recognition_key,
    r.recognition_date,
    r.region_code::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    r.revenue_stream,
    ROUND(r.revenue_usd, 2)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS revenue_usd,
    r.document_count::INT AS document_count,
    ROUND(r.month_to_date_usd, 2)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS month_to_date_usd,
    ROUND(r.trailing_7d_usd, 2)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS trailing_7d_usd,
    ROUND(r.share_of_day, 6)::NUMBER(9, 6) AS share_of_day
  FROM rolling AS r
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_reviews_moderated
statements.sql:
WITH reviews AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_reviews
),

order_lines AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_order_lines_priced
),

orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_orders
),

variants AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_product_variants
),

purchases AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    o.customer_id,
    l.sku
  FROM order_lines AS l
  INNER JOIN orders AS o
    ON l.order_id = o.order_id
),

visible AS (
  SELECT
    r.review_id,
    r.sku,
    r.customer_id,
    r.rating,
    r.title,
    r.submitted_at,
    r.body_length
  FROM reviews AS r
  WHERE
    r.moderation_status IN ('approved', 'pending')
    AND ARRAY_SIZE(r.flagged_terms) = 0
),

scored AS (
  SELECT
    v.review_id,
    REGEXP_COUNT(LOWER(v.title), '(love|great|excellent|perfect|sturdy|beautiful)')
      - REGEXP_COUNT(LOWER(v.title), '(broke|broken|cheap|flimsy|disappoint|return|rust)') AS sentiment_score
  FROM visible AS v
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    v.review_id,
    v.sku,
    pv.product_id,
    v.customer_id,
    v.rating,
    v.submitted_at,
    (
      p.customer_id IS NOT NULL
    ) AS is_verified_purchase,
    s.sentiment_score::INT AS sentiment_score,
    ROUND(
      IFF(p.customer_id IS NOT NULL, 1.5, 1.0) * LEAST(1 + LN(1 + v.body_length / 100), 3),
      3
    )::NUMBER(6, 3) AS review_weight,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY v.sku ORDER BY v.rating DESC)::INT AS rating_rank_in_product
  FROM visible AS v
  INNER JOIN scored AS s
    ON v.review_id = s.review_id
  LEFT JOIN purchases AS p
    ON v.customer_id = p.customer_id
    AND v.sku = p.sku
  LEFT JOIN variants AS pv
    ON v.sku = pv.sku
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_search_conversion
statements.sql:
WITH search_log AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_search_queries
),

web_searches AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_web_searches
),

product_views AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_web_product_views
),

all_searches AS (
  SELECT
    q.query_id::VARCHAR AS search_key,
    q.anonymous_id::VARCHAR AS anonymous_id,
    q.query_text::VARCHAR AS search_term,
    q.results_count::INT AS result_count,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', q.searched_at)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS searched_at_utc,
    q.filter_category::VARCHAR AS filter_category
  FROM search_log AS q
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    w.event_id::VARCHAR AS search_key,
    w.anonymous_id::VARCHAR AS anonymous_id,
    w.search_term::VARCHAR AS search_term,
    w.result_count::INT AS result_count,
    w.searched_at_utc::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS searched_at_utc,
    NULL::VARCHAR AS filter_category
  FROM web_searches AS w
),

search_windows AS (
  SELECT
    s.search_key,
    s.anonymous_id,
    s.searched_at_utc,
    DATEADD('minute', 10, s.searched_at_utc) AS window_end_utc
  FROM all_searches AS s
),

followed AS (
  SELECT
    w.search_key,
    COUNT(v.product_view_key) > 0 AS has_view
  FROM search_windows AS w
  LEFT JOIN product_views AS v
    ON w.anonymous_id = v.anonymous_id
    AND v.viewed_minute_utc BETWEEN w.searched_at_utc AND w.window_end_utc
  GROUP BY
    w.search_key
),

by_term AS (
  SELECT
    s.search_term,
    COUNT(*) AS search_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.anonymous_id) AS searching_visitors,
    COUNT_IF(COALESCE(s.result_count, 0) = 0) AS zero_result_count,
    COUNT_IF(f.has_view) AS viewed_count,
    AVG(s.result_count) AS avg_results,
    MODE(s.filter_category) AS top_filter_category,
    MIN(s.searched_at_utc) AS first_searched_at_utc
  FROM all_searches AS s
  INNER JOIN followed AS f
    ON s.search_key = f.search_key
  WHERE
    s.search_term IS NOT NULL
    AND s.search_term <> ''
  GROUP BY
    s.search_term
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    b.search_term,
    b.search_count::INT AS search_count,
    b.searching_visitors::INT AS searching_visitors,
    ROUND(b.zero_result_count / b.search_count, 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS zero_result_rate,
    ROUND(b.viewed_count / b.search_count, 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS view_after_search_rate,
    ROUND(b.avg_results, 2)::NUMBER(12, 2) AS avg_results,
    b.top_filter_category::VARCHAR AS top_filter_category,
    b.first_searched_at_utc
  FROM by_term AS b
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_session_attribution
statements.sql:
WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_web_sessions
),

channel_mapping AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__channel_mapping
),

parsed AS (
  SELECT
    s.session_id,
    s.anonymous_id,
    s.customer_id,
    s.session_start_utc,
    s.referrer_host,
    LOWER(PARSE_URL(s.landing_page_url, 1)['parameters']['utm_source']::VARCHAR) AS utm_source,
    LOWER(
      COALESCE(
        PARSE_URL(s.landing_page_url, 1)['parameters']['utm_medium']::VARCHAR,
        REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.landing_page_url, '[?&]utm_medium=([^&#]+)', 1, 1, 'e', 1)
      )
    ) AS utm_medium,
    LOWER(
      REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.landing_page_url, '[?&]utm_campaign=([^&#]+)', 1, 1, 'e', 1)
    ) AS utm_campaign
  FROM sessions AS s
),

exact_matches AS (
  SELECT
    p.session_id,
    MIN(m.channel_code) AS channel_code,
    BOOLOR_AGG(m.is_paid) AS is_paid
  FROM parsed AS p
  INNER JOIN channel_mapping AS m
    ON p.utm_source = m.utm_source
    AND p.utm_medium = m.utm_medium
  GROUP BY
    p.session_id
),

medium_matches AS (
  SELECT
    p.session_id,
    MIN(m.channel_code) AS channel_code,
    BOOLOR_AGG(m.is_paid) AS is_paid
  FROM parsed AS p
  INNER JOIN channel_mapping AS m
    ON p.utm_medium = m.utm_medium
  WHERE m.utm_source = '-'
  GROUP BY
    p.session_id
),

classified AS (
  SELECT
    p.session_id,
    p.anonymous_id,
    p.customer_id,
    p.session_start_utc,
    p.utm_source,
    p.utm_medium,
    p.utm_campaign,
    COALESCE(
      e.channel_code,
      mm.channel_code,
      IFF(p.referrer_host IS NULL OR p.referrer_host LIKE '%duckshop%', 'DIRECT', 'REFERRAL')
    ) AS channel_code,
    COALESCE(e.is_paid, mm.is_paid, FALSE) AS is_paid
  FROM parsed AS p
  LEFT JOIN exact_matches AS e
    ON p.session_id = e.session_id
  LEFT JOIN medium_matches AS mm
    ON p.session_id = mm.session_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    c.session_id,
    c.anonymous_id,
    c.customer_id,
    c.session_start_utc,
    c.utm_source::VARCHAR AS utm_source,
    c.utm_medium::VARCHAR AS utm_medium,
    c.utm_campaign::VARCHAR AS utm_campaign,
    c.channel_code::VARCHAR AS channel_code,
    c.is_paid::BOOLEAN AS is_paid,
    FIRST_VALUE(c.channel_code) OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.anonymous_id
      ORDER BY c.session_start_utc, c.session_id
    )::VARCHAR AS first_touch_channel,
    LAST_VALUE(c.channel_code) OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.anonymous_id
      ORDER BY c.session_start_utc, c.session_id
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
    )::VARCHAR AS last_touch_channel,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.anonymous_id
      ORDER BY c.session_start_utc, c.session_id
    )::INT AS touch_number
  FROM classified AS c
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_settlement_lines
statements.sql:
WITH reports AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_settlement_reports
),

payments AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_payments
),

refunds AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_refunds
),

raw_lines AS (
  SELECT
    r.report_id,
    r.provider_code,
    r.report_date,
    l.index AS line_index,
    l.value AS line
  FROM reports AS r, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => r.report:lines) AS l
),

typed_lines AS (
  SELECT
    l.report_id,
    l.provider_code,
    l.report_date,
    l.line_index,
    LOWER(COALESCE(l.line:type::VARCHAR, l.line:record_type::VARCHAR, 'unknown')) AS line_type,
    NULLIF(
      TRIM(l.line:reference::VARCHAR),
      ''
    ) AS structured_reference,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(
      l.line:description::VARCHAR,
      '(pay|pi|ch)_[A-Za-z0-9]{6,}'
    ) AS described_reference,
    COALESCE(
      l.line:gross_minor::INT,
      TRY_TO_NUMBER(l.line:gross::VARCHAR, 18, 2) * 100
    ) AS gross_minor,
    COALESCE(l.line:fee_minor::INT, 0) AS fee_minor
  FROM raw_lines AS l
),

referenced AS (
  SELECT
    t.report_id,
    t.provider_code,
    t.report_date,
    t.line_index,
    t.line_type,
    COALESCE(t.structured_reference, t.described_reference) AS payment_reference,
    CASE
      WHEN t.structured_reference IS NOT NULL
      THEN 'structured'
      WHEN t.described_reference IS NOT NULL
      THEN 'description'
      ELSE 'none'
    END AS reference_source,
    t.gross_minor,
    t.fee_minor
  FROM typed_lines AS t
),

payment_refs AS (
  SELECT
    p.gateway_reference::VARCHAR AS payment_reference,
    MIN(p.payment_id) AS payment_id,
    MIN(p.amount_minor) AS payment_amount_minor
  FROM payments AS p
  WHERE p.gateway_reference IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    p.gateway_reference::VARCHAR
),

refund_refs AS (
  SELECT
    f.refund_id AS refund_reference,
    MIN(f.amount_minor) AS refund_amount_minor
  FROM refunds AS f
  GROUP BY
    f.refund_id
),

matched AS (
  SELECT
    r.report_id,
    r.provider_code,
    r.report_date,
    r.line_index,
    r.line_type,
    r.payment_reference,
    r.reference_source,
    r.gross_minor,
    r.fee_minor,
    p.payment_id AS matched_payment_id,
    f.refund_reference AS matched_refund_id,
    COALESCE(p.payment_amount_minor, f.refund_amount_minor) AS matched_amount_minor
  FROM referenced AS r
  LEFT JOIN payment_refs AS p
    ON r.payment_reference = p.payment_reference
  LEFT JOIN refund_refs AS f
    ON r.payment_reference = f.refund_reference
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      m.report_id || ':' || LPAD(m.line_index::VARCHAR, 5, '0')
    )::VARCHAR AS settlement_line_key,
    m.report_id,
    m.provider_code,
    m.report_date,
    (
      m.line_index + 1
    )::INT AS line_number,
    m.line_type::VARCHAR AS line_type,
    m.payment_reference::VARCHAR AS payment_reference,
    m.reference_source::VARCHAR AS reference_source,
    m.gross_minor::INT AS gross_minor,
    m.fee_minor::INT AS fee_minor,
    (
      m.gross_minor - m.fee_minor
    )::INT AS net_minor,
    m.matched_payment_id::VARCHAR AS matched_payment_id,
    m.matched_refund_id::VARCHAR AS matched_refund_id,
    (
      m.matched_payment_id IS NOT NULL
      OR m.matched_refund_id IS NOT NULL
    )::BOOLEAN AS is_matched,
    COALESCE(ABS(m.gross_minor) = ABS(m.matched_amount_minor), FALSE)::BOOLEAN AS amount_matches,
    ROUND(m.fee_minor / NULLIF(ABS(m.gross_minor), 0), 6)::NUMBER(9, 6) AS fee_rate
  FROM matched AS m
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_shipment_costs
statements.sql:
WITH packages AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_shipment_packages
),

shipments AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_shipments
),

warehouses AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_warehouses
),

orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_orders_enriched
),

rate_cards AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_carrier_rate_cards
),

package_lanes AS (
  SELECT
    p.package_id,
    p.shipment_id,
    s.carrier_code,
    s.service_level,
    w.country_code AS origin_country,
    o.ship_to_country_code AS destination_country,
    s.shipped_at::DATE AS shipped_date,
    GREATEST(p.weight_grams / 1000, COALESCE(p.volumetric_weight_kg, 0)) AS chargeable_weight_kg,
    IFF(
      COALESCE(p.volumetric_weight_kg, 0) > p.weight_grams / 1000,
      'volumetric',
      'actual'
    ) AS weight_basis
  FROM packages AS p
  INNER JOIN shipments AS s
    ON p.shipment_id = s.shipment_id
  INNER JOIN warehouses AS w
    ON s.warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
  LEFT JOIN orders AS o
    ON s.order_id = o.order_id
),

bands AS (
  SELECT
    r.carrier_code,
    r.service_level,
    r.origin_country,
    r.destination_country,
    r.currency_code,
    r.valid_from,
    r.valid_to,
    b.value:max_kg::NUMBER(10, 3) AS band_max_kg,
    b.value:amount_minor::INT AS rate_minor
  FROM rate_cards AS r, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => r.bands) AS b
),

matched AS (
  SELECT
    l.package_id,
    MIN(b.band_max_kg) AS band_max_kg,
    MIN_BY(b.rate_minor, b.band_max_kg) AS rate_minor,
    MIN_BY(b.currency_code, b.band_max_kg) AS rate_currency_code
  FROM package_lanes AS l
  INNER JOIN bands AS b
    ON l.carrier_code = b.carrier_code
    AND l.service_level = b.service_level
    AND l.origin_country = b.origin_country
    AND l.destination_country = b.destination_country
    AND l.shipped_date BETWEEN b.valid_from AND b.valid_to
    AND l.chargeable_weight_kg <= b.band_max_kg
  GROUP BY
    l.package_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    l.package_id,
    l.shipment_id,
    l.carrier_code,
    l.service_level,
    ROUND(l.chargeable_weight_kg, 3)::NUMBER(10, 3) AS chargeable_weight_kg,
    l.weight_basis::VARCHAR AS weight_basis,
    m.band_max_kg::NUMBER(10, 3) AS band_max_kg,
    m.rate_minor::INT AS rate_minor,
    m.rate_currency_code::VARCHAR AS rate_currency_code,
    (
      m.rate_minor IS NOT NULL
    ) AS has_rate
  FROM package_lanes AS l
  LEFT JOIN matched AS m
    ON l.package_id = m.package_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_shipment_tracking_events
statements.sql:
WITH tracking_events AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_shipment_tracking_events
),

webhook_events AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_carrier_webhook_events
),

shipments AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_shipments
),

warehouses AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_warehouses
),

combined AS (
  SELECT
    t.tracking_event_key::VARCHAR AS tracking_event_key,
    t.shipment_id::VARCHAR AS shipment_id,
    t.event_code::VARCHAR AS event_code,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', t.event_at)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS event_at_utc,
    t.event_source::VARCHAR AS event_origin
  FROM tracking_events AS t
  WHERE t.event_at IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    (
      'W:' || w.carrier_update_key
    )::VARCHAR AS tracking_event_key,
    w.shipment_id::VARCHAR AS shipment_id,
    w.status_code::VARCHAR AS event_code,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', w.status_at)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS event_at_utc,
    'webhook'::VARCHAR AS event_origin
  FROM webhook_events AS w
  WHERE w.status_at IS NOT NULL
),

deduplicated AS (
  SELECT
    c.tracking_event_key,
    c.shipment_id,
    c.event_code,
    c.event_at_utc,
    c.event_origin
  FROM combined AS c
  QUALIFY
    COUNT(*) OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.shipment_id, c.event_code, DATE_TRUNC('minute', c.event_at_utc)
      ORDER BY c.event_origin, c.tracking_event_key
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) = 1
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    d.tracking_event_key,
    d.shipment_id,
    d.event_code,
    CASE
      WHEN d.event_code RLIKE '^(DELIVERED|DLV|POD).*'
      THEN 'delivered'
      WHEN d.event_code RLIKE '^(OUT_FOR_DELIVERY|OFD).*'
      THEN 'out_for_delivery'
      WHEN d.event_code RLIKE '^EXCEPTION_.*|^(EXC|DELAY|DAMAGE).*'
      THEN 'exception'
      WHEN d.event_code RLIKE '^(PICKED_UP|PU|ACCEPTED).*'
      THEN 'collected'
      ELSE 'in_transit'
    END::VARCHAR AS event_family,
    d.event_at_utc,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE(
      'UTC',
      w.iana_timezone,
      d.event_at_utc
    )::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS event_at_warehouse_local,
    d.event_origin,
    (
      d.event_code RLIKE '^(DELIVERED|DLV|POD).*'
    ) AS is_delivery_event
  FROM deduplicated AS d
  INNER JOIN shipments AS s
    ON d.shipment_id = s.shipment_id
  INNER JOIN warehouses AS w
    ON s.warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_stock_count_variances
statements.sql:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_stock_counts
),

ledger AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_inventory_ledger
),

warehouses AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_warehouses
),

counts_utc AS (
  SELECT
    c.count_id,
    c.sku,
    c.warehouse_code,
    c.counted_at_local,
    c.counted_qty,
    c.is_blind_count,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE(w.iana_timezone, 'UTC', c.counted_at_local)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS counted_at_utc
  FROM counts AS c
  INNER JOIN warehouses AS w
    ON c.warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
),

with_expected AS (
  SELECT
    c.count_id,
    c.sku,
    c.warehouse_code,
    c.counted_at_local,
    c.counted_qty,
    c.is_blind_count,
    COALESCE(l.running_on_hand, 0) AS expected_qty
  FROM counts_utc AS c
  ASOF JOIN ledger AS l MATCH_CONDITION (c.counted_at_utc >= l.occurred_at_utc)
    ON c.sku = l.sku
    AND c.warehouse_code = l.warehouse_code
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    e.count_id,
    e.sku,
    e.warehouse_code,
    e.counted_at_local,
    e.counted_qty,
    e.expected_qty::INT AS expected_qty,
    (
      e.counted_qty - e.expected_qty
    )::INT AS variance_qty,
    ROUND((
      e.counted_qty - e.expected_qty
    )
    / NULLIF(e.expected_qty, 0), 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS variance_pct,
    (
      ABS(e.counted_qty - e.expected_qty) > 2
      AND ABS(
        e.counted_qty - e.expected_qty
      ) > 0.05 * GREATEST(e.expected_qty, 1)
    ) AS is_out_of_tolerance,
    e.is_blind_count,
    COUNT(*) OVER (
      PARTITION BY e.sku, e.warehouse_code, e.counted_at_local::DATE
      ORDER BY e.counted_at_local, e.count_id
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    )::INT AS recount_sequence
  FROM with_expected AS e
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_stock_on_hand_daily
statements.sql:
WITH ledger AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_inventory_ledger
),

counts AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_stock_counts
),

warehouses AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_warehouses
),

spine_offsets AS (
  SELECT ARRAY_GENERATE_RANGE(0, 730) AS day_offsets
),

date_spine AS (
  SELECT
    DATEADD(
      'day',
      d.value::INT,
      '2025-01-01'::DATE
    )::DATE AS calendar_date
  FROM spine_offsets AS o, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => o.day_offsets) AS d
),

stock_keys AS (
  SELECT
    l.sku,
    l.warehouse_code,
    MIN(l.occurred_date_local) AS first_date
  FROM ledger AS l
  GROUP BY
    l.sku,
    l.warehouse_code
), key_days AS (
  SELECT
    k.sku,
    k.warehouse_code,
    d.calendar_date,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE(
      w.iana_timezone,
      'UTC',
      DATEADD('day', 1, d.calendar_date)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ
    )::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS day_end_utc,
    DATEADD('day', 1, d.calendar_date)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS day_end_local
  FROM stock_keys AS k
  INNER JOIN date_spine AS d
    ON d.calendar_date >= k.first_date
  INNER JOIN warehouses AS w
    ON k.warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
  WHERE d.calendar_date <= '2026-03-31'::DATE
), with_balance AS (
  SELECT
    kd.sku,
    kd.warehouse_code,
    kd.calendar_date,
    kd.day_end_local,
    l.running_on_hand
  FROM key_days AS kd
  ASOF JOIN ledger AS l MATCH_CONDITION (kd.day_end_utc > l.occurred_at_utc)
    ON kd.sku = l.sku
    AND kd.warehouse_code = l.warehouse_code
), with_count AS (
  SELECT
    b.sku,
    b.warehouse_code,
    b.calendar_date,
    b.running_on_hand,
    c.counted_qty,
    c.counted_at_local
  FROM with_balance AS b
  ASOF JOIN counts AS c MATCH_CONDITION (b.day_end_local > c.counted_at_local)
    ON b.sku = c.sku
    AND b.warehouse_code = c.warehouse_code
), final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      c.sku || '|' || c.warehouse_code || '|' || TO_CHAR(c.calendar_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    )::VARCHAR AS stock_day_key,
    c.sku,
    c.warehouse_code,
    c.calendar_date,
    DATE_FROM_PARTS(YEAR(c.calendar_date), MONTH(c.calendar_date), 1) AS month_start,
    COALESCE(c.running_on_hand, 0)::INT AS on_hand_qty,
    c.counted_qty::INT AS last_counted_qty,
    c.counted_at_local::DATE AS last_counted_date,
    DATEDIFF(
      'day',
      c.counted_at_local::DATE,
      c.calendar_date
    )::INT AS days_since_count,
    (
      COALESCE(c.running_on_hand, 0) <= 0
    ) AS is_stocked_out
  FROM with_count AS c
)
SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_stock_transfers_in_transit
statements.sql:
WITH transfers AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_stock_transfers
),

lane_history AS (
  SELECT
    t.from_warehouse_code,
    t.to_warehouse_code,
    MEDIAN(t.transit_hours) AS lane_median_transit_hours
  FROM transfers AS t
  WHERE t.arrived_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    t.from_warehouse_code,
    t.to_warehouse_code
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    t.transfer_id,
    t.sku,
    t.from_warehouse_code,
    t.to_warehouse_code,
    t.qty,
    CASE
      WHEN t.arrived_at IS NOT NULL
      THEN 'arrived'
      WHEN t.shipped_at IS NOT NULL
      THEN 'in_transit'
      ELSE 'planned'
    END::VARCHAR AS transfer_state,
    t.shipped_at,
    TIMESTAMPADD(
      'minute',
      ROUND(COALESCE(h.lane_median_transit_hours, 48) * 60)::INT,
      t.shipped_at
    )::TIMESTAMP_TZ AS expected_arrival_at,
    h.lane_median_transit_hours::NUMBER(10, 2) AS lane_median_transit_hours,
    (
      t.arrived_at IS NULL
      AND TIMESTAMPADD(
        'minute',
        ROUND(COALESCE(h.lane_median_transit_hours, 48) * 60)::INT,
        t.shipped_at
      ) < '2026-03-31'::TIMESTAMP_TZ
    ) AS is_overdue
  FROM transfers AS t
  LEFT JOIN lane_history AS h
    ON t.from_warehouse_code = h.from_warehouse_code
    AND t.to_warehouse_code = h.to_warehouse_code
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_store_credit_balances
statements.sql:
WITH ledger AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_store_credit_ledger
),

fx_rates AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
),

currencies AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__currencies
),

grouped AS (
  SELECT
    l.customer_id,
    l.currency_code,
    SUM(l.amount_minor) AS balance_minor,
    SUM(
      IFF(
        l.amount_minor > 0
        AND l.expires_on BETWEEN '2026-03-31'::DATE AND DATEADD(
          'day',
          30,
          '2026-03-31'::DATE
        ),
        l.amount_minor,
        0
      )
    ) AS expiring_30d_minor,
    MIN(l.posted_at) AS first_posted_at,
    MAX(l.posted_at) AS last_posted_at,
    COUNT(*) AS posting_count,
    SUM(IFF(l.reason_code LIKE 'GOODWILL%', l.amount_minor, 0)) AS goodwill_minor,
    SUM(IFF(l.amount_minor > 0, l.amount_minor, 0)) AS issued_minor
  FROM ledger AS l
  GROUP BY
    l.customer_id,
    l.currency_code
),

valued AS (
  SELECT
    g.customer_id,
    g.currency_code,
    g.balance_minor,
    g.expiring_30d_minor,
    g.first_posted_at,
    g.last_posted_at,
    g.posting_count,
    g.goodwill_minor,
    g.issued_minor,
    '2026-03-31'::DATE AS valuation_date,
    c.minor_unit_exponent
  FROM grouped AS g
  LEFT JOIN currencies AS c
    ON g.currency_code = c.currency_code
),

with_rate AS (
  SELECT
    v.customer_id,
    v.currency_code,
    v.balance_minor,
    v.expiring_30d_minor,
    v.first_posted_at,
    v.last_posted_at,
    v.posting_count,
    v.goodwill_minor,
    v.issued_minor,
    v.minor_unit_exponent,
    fx.rate_to_usd
  FROM valued AS v
  ASOF JOIN fx_rates AS fx MATCH_CONDITION (v.valuation_date >= fx.rate_date)
    ON v.currency_code = fx.currency_code
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      g.customer_id || ':' || g.currency_code
    )::VARCHAR AS store_credit_key,
    g.customer_id,
    g.currency_code,
    g.balance_minor::INT AS balance_minor,
    LEAST(g.expiring_30d_minor, GREATEST(g.balance_minor, 0))::INT AS expiring_30d_minor,
    g.first_posted_at,
    g.last_posted_at,
    g.posting_count::INT AS posting_count,
    ROUND(g.goodwill_minor / NULLIF(g.issued_minor, 0), 6)::NUMBER(9, 6) AS goodwill_share,
    ROUND(
      (ROUND((
  g.balance_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, COALESCE(g.minor_unit_exponent, 2))::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 6)::NUMBER(38, 6)) * g.rate_to_usd,
      2
    )::NUMBER(18, 2) AS balance_usd
  FROM with_rate AS g
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_subscription_mrr_daily
statements.sql:
WITH periods AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_subscription_periods
),

fx_rates AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
),

currencies AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__currencies
),

spine_offsets AS (
  SELECT ARRAY_GENERATE_RANGE(0, 730) AS day_offsets
),

date_spine AS (
  SELECT
    DATEADD(
      'day',
      d.value::INT,
      '2025-01-01'::DATE
    )::DATE AS calendar_date
  FROM spine_offsets AS o, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => o.day_offsets) AS d
),

active_periods AS (
  SELECT
    p.subscription_id,
    p.customer_id,
    p.period_start::DATE AS start_date,
    COALESCE(p.period_end::DATE, '2026-12-31'::DATE) AS end_date,
    p.billing_amount_minor,
    p.billing_currency_code,
    p.interval_days
  FROM periods AS p
  WHERE p.period_state = 'active'
), active_days AS (
  SELECT
    a.subscription_id,
    a.customer_id,
    d.calendar_date,
    a.billing_amount_minor,
    a.billing_currency_code,
    a.interval_days
  FROM active_periods AS a
  INNER JOIN date_spine AS d
    ON d.calendar_date >= a.start_date
    AND d.calendar_date < a.end_date
), with_exponent AS (
  SELECT
    ad.subscription_id,
    ad.customer_id,
    ad.calendar_date,
    ad.billing_amount_minor,
    ad.billing_currency_code,
    ad.interval_days,
    c.minor_unit_exponent
  FROM active_days AS ad
  INNER JOIN currencies AS c
    ON ad.billing_currency_code = c.currency_code
), with_rate AS (
  SELECT
    w.subscription_id,
    w.customer_id,
    w.calendar_date,
    w.billing_amount_minor,
    w.interval_days,
    w.minor_unit_exponent,
    fx.rate_to_usd
  FROM with_exponent AS w
  ASOF JOIN fx_rates AS fx MATCH_CONDITION (w.calendar_date >= fx.rate_date)
    ON w.billing_currency_code = fx.currency_code
), final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      r.subscription_id || ':' || TO_CHAR(r.calendar_date, 'YYYYMMDD')
    )::VARCHAR AS subscription_day_key,
    r.subscription_id,
    r.customer_id,
    r.calendar_date,
    ROUND(
      (ROUND((
  r.billing_amount_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, r.minor_unit_exponent)::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 6)::NUMBER(38, 6)) * r.rate_to_usd * 30.4375
        / NULLIF(r.interval_days, 0),
      4
    )::NUMBER(18, 4) AS mrr_usd,
    (
      r.calendar_date = MIN(r.calendar_date) OVER (PARTITION BY r.subscription_id)
    ) AS is_first_day
  FROM with_rate AS r
)
SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_subscription_periods
statements.sql:
WITH subscriptions AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_subscriptions
),

events AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_subscription_events
),

state_events AS (
  SELECT
    e.subscription_id,
    e.event_id,
    e.occurred_at,
    CASE e.event_type
      WHEN 'PAUSE'
      THEN 'paused'
      WHEN 'CANCEL'
      THEN 'cancelled'
      ELSE 'active'
    END AS state
  FROM events AS e
  WHERE e.event_type IN ('PAUSE', 'RESUME', 'CANCEL')
),

changes AS (
  SELECT
    s.subscription_id,
    s.event_id,
    s.occurred_at,
    s.state,
    LAG(s.state, 1, 'active') OVER (
      PARTITION BY s.subscription_id
      ORDER BY s.occurred_at, s.event_id
    ) AS previous_state
  FROM state_events AS s
),

islands AS (
  SELECT
    c.subscription_id,
    c.occurred_at,
    c.state,
    SUM(IFF(c.previous_state <> c.state, 1, 0)) OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.subscription_id
      ORDER BY c.occurred_at, c.event_id
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS island_number
  FROM changes AS c
),

event_periods AS (
  SELECT
    i.subscription_id,
    i.island_number,
    ANY_VALUE(i.state) AS period_state,
    MIN(i.occurred_at) AS period_start
  FROM islands AS i
  WHERE i.island_number >= 1
  GROUP BY
    i.subscription_id,
    i.island_number
),

bounded AS (
  SELECT
    p.subscription_id,
    p.island_number + 1 AS period_number,
    p.period_state,
    p.period_start,
    LEAD(p.period_start) OVER (
      PARTITION BY p.subscription_id
      ORDER BY p.island_number
    ) AS period_end
  FROM event_periods AS p
),

first_change AS (
  SELECT
    p.subscription_id,
    MIN(p.period_start) AS first_change_at
  FROM event_periods AS p
  GROUP BY
    p.subscription_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      s.subscription_id || '#1'
    )::VARCHAR AS subscription_period_key,
    s.subscription_id::VARCHAR AS subscription_id,
    s.customer_id::VARCHAR AS customer_id,
    1::INT AS period_number,
    'active'::VARCHAR AS period_state,
    s.started_at::TIMESTAMP_TZ AS period_start,
    COALESCE(f.first_change_at, s.cancelled_at)::TIMESTAMP_TZ AS period_end,
    ROUND(
      DATEDIFF('hour', s.started_at, COALESCE(f.first_change_at, s.cancelled_at)) / 24,
      2
    )::NUMBER(10, 2) AS period_days,
    s.billing_amount_minor::INT AS billing_amount_minor,
    s.billing_currency_code::VARCHAR AS billing_currency_code,
    s.interval_days::INT AS interval_days
  FROM subscriptions AS s
  LEFT JOIN first_change AS f
    ON s.subscription_id = f.subscription_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    (
      b.subscription_id || '#' || b.period_number::VARCHAR
    )::VARCHAR AS subscription_period_key,
    b.subscription_id::VARCHAR AS subscription_id,
    s.customer_id::VARCHAR AS customer_id,
    b.period_number::INT AS period_number,
    b.period_state::VARCHAR AS period_state,
    b.period_start::TIMESTAMP_TZ AS period_start,
    COALESCE(
      b.period_end,
      IFF(b.period_state = 'cancelled', b.period_start, s.cancelled_at)
    )::TIMESTAMP_TZ AS period_end,
    ROUND(
      DATEDIFF(
        'hour',
        b.period_start,
        COALESCE(b.period_end, IFF(b.period_state = 'cancelled', b.period_start, s.cancelled_at))
      )
      / 24,
      2
    )::NUMBER(10, 2) AS period_days,
    s.billing_amount_minor::INT AS billing_amount_minor,
    s.billing_currency_code::VARCHAR AS billing_currency_code,
    s.interval_days::INT AS interval_days
  FROM bounded AS b
  INNER JOIN subscriptions AS s
    ON b.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_supplier_cost_current
statements.sql:
WITH supplier_costs AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_supplier_costs
),

suppliers AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_suppliers
),

fx_rates AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_fx_rates
),

currencies AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__currencies
),

current_costs AS (
  SELECT
    c.cost_id,
    c.supplier_code,
    c.sku,
    c.currency_code,
    COALESCE(c.best_break_cost_minor, c.unit_cost_minor) AS unit_cost_minor,
    c.effective_from
  FROM supplier_costs AS c
  WHERE
    c.effective_to IS NULL
    OR c.effective_to >= '2026-03-31'::DATE
),

with_exponent AS (
  SELECT
    cc.cost_id,
    cc.supplier_code,
    cc.sku,
    cc.currency_code,
    cc.unit_cost_minor,
    cc.effective_from,
    cur.minor_unit_exponent
  FROM current_costs AS cc
  INNER JOIN currencies AS cur
    ON cc.currency_code = cur.currency_code
),

in_usd AS (
  SELECT
    w.cost_id,
    w.supplier_code,
    w.sku,
    w.currency_code,
    w.unit_cost_minor,
    w.effective_from,
    ROUND(
      (ROUND((
  w.unit_cost_minor / NULLIF((POWER(10, w.minor_unit_exponent)::NUMBER(38, 0)), 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 6)::NUMBER(38, 6)) * fx.rate_to_usd,
      4
    ) AS unit_cost_usd
  FROM with_exponent AS w
  ASOF JOIN fx_rates AS fx MATCH_CONDITION (w.effective_from >= fx.rate_date)
    ON w.currency_code = fx.currency_code
),

per_sku AS (
  SELECT
    u.sku,
    MIN_BY(u.cost_id, u.unit_cost_usd) AS cheapest_cost_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.supplier_code) AS supplier_count,
    MAX(u.unit_cost_usd) AS max_cost_usd
  FROM in_usd AS u
  GROUP BY
    u.sku
),

ranked AS (
  SELECT
    p.sku,
    u.supplier_code,
    u.currency_code,
    u.unit_cost_minor,
    u.unit_cost_usd,
    u.effective_from,
    p.supplier_count,
    p.max_cost_usd
  FROM per_sku AS p
  INNER JOIN in_usd AS u
    ON p.cheapest_cost_id = u.cost_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    r.sku,
    r.supplier_code,
    s.supplier_name,
    r.currency_code,
    r.unit_cost_minor::INT AS unit_cost_minor,
    r.unit_cost_usd::NUMBER(18, 4) AS unit_cost_usd,
    r.effective_from,
    r.supplier_count::INT AS supplier_count,
    s.payment_terms_days,
    ROUND(100
    * (
      r.max_cost_usd - r.unit_cost_usd
    )
    / NULLIF(r.unit_cost_usd, 0), 2)::NUMBER(9, 2) AS cost_spread_pct
  FROM ranked AS r
  LEFT JOIN suppliers AS s
    ON r.supplier_code = s.supplier_code
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_supplier_lead_times
statements.sql:
WITH purchase_orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_purchase_orders
),

po_lines AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_purchase_order_lines_received
),

suppliers AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_suppliers
),

po_fill AS (
  SELECT
    l.po_id,
    SUM(l.received_qty) / NULLIF(SUM(l.ordered_qty), 0) AS po_fill_rate,
    MAX(l.days_late) AS max_days_late
  FROM po_lines AS l
  GROUP BY
    l.po_id
),

received AS (
  SELECT
    p.supplier_code,
    p.ordered_at,
    DATEDIFF('hour', p.ordered_at, p.received_at) / 24 AS lead_time_days,
    f.po_fill_rate,
    f.max_days_late
  FROM purchase_orders AS p
  INNER JOIN po_fill AS f
    ON p.po_id = f.po_id
  WHERE p.received_at IS NOT NULL
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    r.supplier_code,
    s.supplier_name,
    COUNT(*)::INT AS received_po_count,
    ROUND(
      PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r.lead_time_days),
      2
    )::NUMBER(10, 2) AS lead_time_p50_days,
    ROUND(
      PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r.lead_time_days),
      2
    )::NUMBER(10, 2) AS lead_time_p90_days,
    ROUND(STDDEV_SAMP(r.lead_time_days), 2)::NUMBER(10, 2) AS lead_time_stddev_days,
    ROUND(COUNT_IF(r.max_days_late = 0) / COUNT(*), 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS on_time_rate,
    ROUND(AVG(r.po_fill_rate), 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS avg_fill_rate,
    MAX(r.ordered_at) AS latest_po_at
  FROM received AS r
  LEFT JOIN suppliers AS s
    ON r.supplier_code = s.supplier_code
  GROUP BY
    r.supplier_code,
    s.supplier_name
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_survey_answers_flat
statements.sql:
WITH responses AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_survey_responses
),

latest_responses AS (
  SELECT
    r.response_id,
    r.survey_code,
    r.customer_id,
    r.submitted_at,
    r.nps_score,
    r.answers
  FROM responses AS r
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY r.customer_id, r.survey_code
      ORDER BY r.submitted_at DESC NULLS LAST, r.response_id DESC
    ) = 1
),

answers AS (
  SELECT
    r.response_id,
    r.survey_code,
    r.customer_id,
    r.submitted_at,
    r.nps_score,
    a.key AS raw_question_key,
    a.value AS answer_value,
    TYPEOF(a.value) AS value_type
  FROM latest_responses AS r, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => r.answers) AS a
),

typed AS (
  SELECT
    a.response_id,
    a.survey_code,
    a.customer_id,
    a.submitted_at,
    a.nps_score,
    LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(a.raw_question_key), '[^A-Za-z0-9]+', '_')) AS question_key,
    CASE a.value_type
      WHEN 'NULL_VALUE'
      THEN 'null'
      WHEN 'INTEGER'
      THEN 'number'
      WHEN 'DECIMAL'
      THEN 'number'
      WHEN 'DOUBLE'
      THEN 'number'
      WHEN 'BOOLEAN'
      THEN 'flag'
      WHEN 'ARRAY'
      THEN 'choices'
      WHEN 'VARCHAR'
      THEN IFF(TRY_TO_NUMBER(a.answer_value::VARCHAR, 18, 4) IS NULL, 'text', 'number')
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS answer_kind,
    a.answer_value
  FROM answers AS a
),

cleaned AS (
  SELECT
    t.response_id,
    t.survey_code,
    t.customer_id,
    t.submitted_at,
    t.nps_score,
    t.question_key,
    t.answer_kind,
    IFF(
      t.answer_kind = 'number',
      TRY_TO_NUMBER(t.answer_value::VARCHAR, 18, 4),
      NULL
    ) AS answer_number,
    IFF(t.answer_kind = 'flag', t.answer_value::BOOLEAN, NULL) AS answer_flag,
    IFF(
      t.answer_kind = 'text',
      REGEXP_REPLACE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.answer_value AS VARCHAR)), ''), '\\s{2,}', ' '),
      NULL
    ) AS answer_text,
    IFF(t.answer_kind = 'choices', t.answer_value::ARRAY, NULL) AS answer_choices
  FROM typed AS t
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      c.response_id || ':' || c.question_key
    )::VARCHAR AS answer_key,
    c.response_id,
    c.survey_code,
    c.customer_id,
    c.submitted_at,
    c.question_key::VARCHAR AS question_key,
    c.answer_kind::VARCHAR AS answer_kind,
    c.answer_number::NUMBER(18, 4) AS answer_number,
    c.answer_flag::BOOLEAN AS answer_flag,
    c.answer_text::VARCHAR AS answer_text,
    c.answer_choices::ARRAY AS answer_choices,
    (
      c.answer_kind <> 'null'
    )::BOOLEAN AS is_answered,
    CASE
      WHEN c.nps_score IS NULL
      THEN NULL
      WHEN c.nps_score >= 9
      THEN 'promoter'
      WHEN c.nps_score >= 7
      THEN 'passive'
      ELSE 'detractor'
    END::VARCHAR AS nps_group,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.response_id ORDER BY c.question_key)::INT AS question_position
  FROM cleaned AS c
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_tax_applied
statements.sql:
WITH tax_lines AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_invoice_tax_lines
),

invoices AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_invoices
),

orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_orders_enriched
),

tax_rates AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_tax_rates
),

rate_windows AS (
  SELECT
    r.tax_rate_id,
    r.country_code,
    LOWER(r.tax_category) AS tax_category,
    r.rate_pct,
    r.valid_from,
    COALESCE(r.valid_to, '9999-12-31'::DATE) AS valid_to_effective
  FROM tax_rates AS r
),

line_context AS (
  SELECT
    l.invoice_tax_line_key,
    l.invoice_id,
    i.order_id,
    UPPER(l.tax_code) AS tax_code,
    LOWER(
      COALESCE(REGEXP_SUBSTR(l.tax_code, '^[A-Za-z]+[_-]([A-Za-z]+)', 1, 1, 'e', 1), 'standard')
    ) AS tax_category,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', i.issued_at)::DATE AS issued_date,
    l.tax_rate_pct AS charged_rate_pct,
    l.taxable_minor,
    l.tax_minor AS charged_tax_minor
  FROM tax_lines AS l
  INNER JOIN invoices AS i
    ON l.invoice_id = i.invoice_id
),

with_country AS (
  SELECT
    c.invoice_tax_line_key,
    c.invoice_id,
    c.order_id,
    c.tax_code,
    c.tax_category,
    o.ship_to_country_code,
    c.issued_date,
    c.charged_rate_pct,
    c.taxable_minor,
    c.charged_tax_minor
  FROM line_context AS c
  LEFT JOIN orders AS o
    ON c.order_id = o.order_id
),

candidate_rates AS (
  SELECT
    w.invoice_tax_line_key,
    MAX_BY(r.rate_pct, r.valid_from) AS published_rate_pct,
    COUNT(r.tax_rate_id) AS candidate_rate_count
  FROM with_country AS w
  INNER JOIN rate_windows AS r
    ON w.ship_to_country_code = r.country_code
    AND w.tax_category = r.tax_category
    AND w.issued_date >= r.valid_from
    AND w.issued_date < r.valid_to_effective
  GROUP BY
    w.invoice_tax_line_key
),

expected AS (
  SELECT
    w.invoice_tax_line_key,
    w.invoice_id,
    w.order_id,
    w.tax_code,
    w.tax_category,
    w.ship_to_country_code,
    w.issued_date,
    w.charged_rate_pct,
    c.published_rate_pct,
    w.taxable_minor,
    w.charged_tax_minor,
    ROUND(w.taxable_minor * c.published_rate_pct / 100, 0) AS expected_tax_minor,
    COALESCE(c.candidate_rate_count, 0) AS candidate_rate_count
  FROM with_country AS w
  LEFT JOIN candidate_rates AS c
    ON w.invoice_tax_line_key = c.invoice_tax_line_key
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    e.invoice_tax_line_key,
    e.invoice_id,
    e.order_id,
    e.tax_code::VARCHAR AS tax_code,
    e.tax_category::VARCHAR AS tax_category,
    e.ship_to_country_code,
    e.issued_date,
    e.charged_rate_pct,
    e.published_rate_pct::NUMBER(9, 4) AS published_rate_pct,
    e.taxable_minor,
    e.charged_tax_minor,
    e.expected_tax_minor::INT AS expected_tax_minor,
    (
      e.charged_tax_minor - e.expected_tax_minor
    )::INT AS variance_minor,
    (
      e.published_rate_pct IS NOT NULL
    )::BOOLEAN AS has_published_rate,
    COALESCE(e.charged_rate_pct <> e.published_rate_pct, FALSE)::BOOLEAN AS is_rate_mismatch,
    e.candidate_rate_count::INT AS candidate_rate_count
  FROM expected AS e
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_ticket_business_hours
statements.sql:
WITH first_responses AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_ticket_first_response
),

holidays AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__holiday_calendar
),

spine_offsets AS (
  SELECT ARRAY_GENERATE_RANGE(0, 730) AS day_offsets
),

date_spine AS (
  SELECT
    DATEADD(
      'day',
      d.value::INT,
      '2025-01-01'::DATE
    )::DATE AS calendar_date
  FROM spine_offsets AS o, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => o.day_offsets) AS d
),

local_times AS (
  SELECT
    f.ticket_id,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE(
      'UTC',
      'Europe/Berlin',
      f.created_at_utc
    )::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS created_local,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE(
      'UTC',
      'Europe/Berlin',
      f.first_response_at_utc
    )::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS response_local
  FROM first_responses AS f
), local_dates AS (
  SELECT
    l.ticket_id,
    l.created_local,
    l.response_local,
    l.created_local::DATE AS created_date,
    l.response_local::DATE AS response_date
  FROM local_times AS l
  WHERE l.response_local IS NOT NULL
), eu_holidays AS (
  SELECT h.holiday_date
  FROM holidays AS h
  WHERE h.region_code = 'EU'
), working_days AS (
  SELECT d.calendar_date
  FROM date_spine AS d
  LEFT JOIN eu_holidays AS h
    ON d.calendar_date = h.holiday_date
  WHERE
    DAYOFWEEKISO(d.calendar_date) <= 5
    AND h.holiday_date IS NULL
), day_windows AS (
  SELECT
    ld.ticket_id,
    GREATEST(
      ld.created_local,
      TIMESTAMP_NTZ_FROM_PARTS(
        YEAR(w.calendar_date),
        MONTH(w.calendar_date),
        DAY(w.calendar_date),
        8,
        0,
        0
      )
    ) AS window_start,
    LEAST(
      ld.response_local,
      TIMESTAMP_NTZ_FROM_PARTS(
        YEAR(w.calendar_date),
        MONTH(w.calendar_date),
        DAY(w.calendar_date),
        20,
        0,
        0
      )
    ) AS window_end
  FROM local_dates AS ld
  INNER JOIN working_days AS w
    ON w.calendar_date >= ld.created_date
    AND w.calendar_date <= ld.response_date
), business_minutes AS (
  SELECT
    dw.ticket_id,
    SUM(
      GREATEST(DATEDIFF('minute', dw.window_start, dw.window_end), 0)
    ) AS business_minutes_to_response
  FROM day_windows AS dw
  GROUP BY
    dw.ticket_id
), final AS (
  SELECT
    l.ticket_id,
    l.created_local AS created_at_support_local,
    l.response_local AS first_response_at_support_local,
    DATEDIFF('minute', l.created_local, l.response_local)::INT AS calendar_minutes_to_response,
    COALESCE(b.business_minutes_to_response, 0)::INT AS business_minutes_to_response,
    (
      HOUR(l.created_local) NOT BETWEEN 8 AND 20 - 1
      OR DAYOFWEEKISO(l.created_local) > 5
    ) AS created_outside_hours
  FROM local_times AS l
  LEFT JOIN business_minutes AS b
    ON l.ticket_id = b.ticket_id
)
SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_ticket_first_response
statements.sql:
WITH tickets AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_tickets
),

comments AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_ticket_comments
),

tickets_utc AS (
  SELECT
    t.ticket_id,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', t.created_at::TIMESTAMP_LTZ)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS created_at_utc
  FROM tickets AS t
),

comments_utc AS (
  SELECT
    c.ticket_id,
    c.author_type,
    c.author_id,
    c.is_public,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', c.created_at)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS created_at_utc
  FROM comments AS c
),

response_windows AS (
  SELECT
    c.ticket_id,
    c.author_type,
    c.author_id,
    c.created_at_utc,
    MIN(
      IFF(c.author_type = 'agent' AND c.is_public, c.created_at_utc, NULL)
    ) OVER (PARTITION BY c.ticket_id) AS first_response_at_utc
  FROM comments_utc AS c
),

first_responses AS (
  SELECT
    r.ticket_id,
    MIN(r.first_response_at_utc) AS first_response_at_utc,
    MIN_BY(
      IFF(r.author_type = 'agent', r.author_id, NULL),
      IFF(r.author_type = 'agent', r.created_at_utc, NULL)
    ) AS first_responder_id,
    MIN(
      IFF(
        r.author_type = 'customer' AND r.created_at_utc > r.first_response_at_utc,
        r.created_at_utc,
        NULL
      )
    ) AS first_customer_reply_at_utc,
    COUNT_IF(r.author_type = 'system') > 0 AS has_auto_reply
  FROM response_windows AS r
  GROUP BY
    r.ticket_id
),

agent_burst AS (
  SELECT
    r.ticket_id,
    COUNT(*) AS agent_responses_before_customer_reply
  FROM response_windows AS r
  INNER JOIN first_responses AS f
    ON r.ticket_id = f.ticket_id
  WHERE
    r.author_type = 'agent'
    AND r.created_at_utc < COALESCE(f.first_customer_reply_at_utc, '9999-12-31'::TIMESTAMP_NTZ)
  GROUP BY
    r.ticket_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    t.ticket_id,
    t.created_at_utc,
    f.first_response_at_utc,
    f.first_responder_id::VARCHAR AS first_responder_id,
    DATEDIFF('minute', t.created_at_utc, f.first_response_at_utc)::INT AS minutes_to_first_response,
    f.first_customer_reply_at_utc,
    COALESCE(
      a.agent_responses_before_customer_reply,
      0
    )::INT AS agent_responses_before_customer_reply,
    COALESCE(f.has_auto_reply, FALSE)::BOOLEAN AS has_auto_reply
  FROM tickets_utc AS t
  LEFT JOIN first_responses AS f
    ON t.ticket_id = f.ticket_id
  LEFT JOIN agent_burst AS a
    ON t.ticket_id = a.ticket_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_ticket_sla_breaches
statements.sql:
WITH tickets AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_tickets
),

policies AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_sla_policies
),

first_responses AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_ticket_first_response
),

business_hours AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_ticket_business_hours
),

matched AS (
  SELECT
    t.ticket_id,
    t.priority,
    t.channel,
    t.solved_at,
    p.policy_id,
    p.first_response_minutes,
    p.resolution_minutes,
    p.business_hours_only
  FROM tickets AS t
  LEFT JOIN policies AS p
    ON t.priority = p.priority
    AND t.channel = p.channel
),

measured AS (
  SELECT
    m.ticket_id,
    m.priority,
    m.channel,
    m.policy_id,
    m.first_response_minutes,
    m.resolution_minutes,
    IFF(
      m.business_hours_only,
      bh.business_minutes_to_response,
      fr.minutes_to_first_response
    ) AS first_response_minutes_used,
    DATEDIFF(
      'minute',
      fr.created_at_utc,
      CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', m.solved_at)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ
    ) AS resolution_minutes_used,
    IFF(m.solved_at IS NULL, DATEDIFF(
      'minute',
      fr.created_at_utc,
      CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())::TIMESTAMP_NTZ
    ), NULL) AS open_minutes_now
  FROM matched AS m
  INNER JOIN first_responses AS fr
    ON m.ticket_id = fr.ticket_id
  LEFT JOIN business_hours AS bh
    ON m.ticket_id = bh.ticket_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    x.ticket_id,
    x.priority,
    x.channel,
    x.policy_id,
    x.first_response_minutes::INT AS first_response_target_minutes,
    x.first_response_minutes_used::INT AS first_response_minutes_used,
    COALESCE(
      x.first_response_minutes_used > x.first_response_minutes,
      FALSE
    ) AS is_first_response_breached,
    x.resolution_minutes::INT AS resolution_target_minutes,
    x.resolution_minutes_used::INT AS resolution_minutes_used,
    COALESCE(x.resolution_minutes_used > x.resolution_minutes, FALSE) AS is_resolution_breached,
    (
      IFF(COALESCE(x.first_response_minutes_used > x.first_response_minutes, FALSE), 1, 0)
        + IFF(COALESCE(x.resolution_minutes_used > x.resolution_minutes, FALSE), 1, 0)
    )::INT AS breach_count,
    x.open_minutes_now::INT AS open_minutes_now
  FROM measured AS x
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_ticket_threads
statements.sql:
WITH comments AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_ticket_comments
),

tickets AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_tickets
),

ordered_comments AS (
  SELECT
    c.ticket_id,
    c.comment_id,
    c.author_type,
    c.author_id,
    c.is_public,
    c.created_at,
    c.attachment_count,
    c.contains_order_reference,
    LAG(c.author_type) OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.ticket_id
      ORDER BY c.created_at, c.comment_id
    ) AS previous_author_type
  FROM comments AS c
),

thread_stats AS (
  SELECT
    o.ticket_id,
    COUNT(*) AS comment_count,
    COUNT_IF(o.is_public) AS public_comment_count,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT IFF(o.author_type = 'agent', o.author_id, NULL)) WITHIN GROUP (
      ORDER BY IFF(o.author_type = 'agent', o.author_id, NULL)
    ) AS agent_participants,
    ARRAY_AGG(o.author_type) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY o.created_at, o.comment_id) AS author_sequence,
    COUNT_IF(
      o.previous_author_type IS NOT NULL AND o.previous_author_type <> o.author_type
    ) AS handoff_count,
    SUM(o.attachment_count) AS total_attachments,
    MAX(o.created_at) AS last_comment_at,
    MAX_BY(o.author_type, o.created_at) AS last_author_type,
    BOOLOR_AGG(o.contains_order_reference) AS mentions_order,
    COUNT_IF(o.author_type = 'agent') AS agent_comments,
    COUNT_IF(o.author_type = 'customer') AS customer_comments,
    COUNT_IF(o.author_type = 'system') AS system_comments
  FROM ordered_comments AS o
  GROUP BY
    o.ticket_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    t.ticket_id,
    COALESCE(s.comment_count, 0)::INT AS comment_count,
    COALESCE(s.public_comment_count, 0)::INT AS public_comment_count,
    COALESCE(s.agent_participants, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT())::ARRAY AS agent_participants,
    COALESCE(s.author_sequence, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT())::ARRAY AS author_sequence,
    COALESCE(s.handoff_count, 0)::INT AS handoff_count,
    OBJECT_CONSTRUCT_KEEP_NULL(
      'agent',
      s.agent_comments,
      'customer',
      s.customer_comments,
      'system',
      NULLIF(s.system_comments, 0)
    )::OBJECT AS author_breakdown,
    COALESCE(s.total_attachments, 0)::INT AS total_attachments,
    s.last_comment_at,
    s.last_author_type::VARCHAR AS last_author_type,
    COALESCE(s.mentions_order, FALSE)::BOOLEAN AS mentions_order
  FROM tickets AS t
  LEFT JOIN thread_stats AS s
    ON t.ticket_id = s.ticket_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_web_sessions
statements.sql:
WITH web_events AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_web_events
),

human_events AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    e.anonymous_id,
    e.customer_id,
    e.event_type,
    e.event_at_utc,
    e.page_url,
    e.page_path,
    e.referrer_host,
    e.client_timezone
  FROM web_events AS e
  WHERE
    e.event_at_utc >= DATEADD('hour', -24, TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ('2026-01-01 00:00:00'))
    AND e.event_at_utc < DATEADD('hour', 24, TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ('2026-01-02 00:00:00'))
    AND NOT e.is_bot
    AND e.anonymous_id IS NOT NULL
),

gaps AS (
  SELECT
    h.event_id,
    h.anonymous_id,
    h.customer_id,
    h.event_type,
    h.event_at_utc,
    h.page_url,
    h.page_path,
    h.referrer_host,
    h.client_timezone,
    IFF(DATEDIFF(
      'minute',
      LAG(h.event_at_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY h.anonymous_id ORDER BY h.event_at_utc, h.event_id),
      h.event_at_utc
    ) <= 30, 0, 1) AS is_session_start
  FROM human_events AS h
),

numbered AS (
  SELECT
    g.anonymous_id,
    g.customer_id,
    g.event_type,
    g.event_at_utc,
    g.page_url,
    g.page_path,
    g.referrer_host,
    g.client_timezone,
    SUM(g.is_session_start) OVER (
      PARTITION BY g.anonymous_id
      ORDER BY g.event_at_utc, g.event_id
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS session_number
  FROM gaps AS g
),

sessions AS (
  SELECT
    n.anonymous_id,
    MAX(n.customer_id) AS customer_id,
    MIN(n.event_at_utc) AS session_start_utc,
    MAX(n.event_at_utc) AS session_end_utc,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    COUNT_IF(n.event_type = 'page_view') AS page_view_count,
    MIN_BY(n.page_path, n.event_at_utc) AS landing_page_path,
    MAX_BY(n.page_path, n.event_at_utc) AS exit_page_path,
    MIN_BY(n.referrer_host, n.event_at_utc) AS referrer_host,
    MIN_BY(n.page_url, n.event_at_utc) AS landing_page_url,
    MIN_BY(n.client_timezone, n.event_at_utc) AS client_timezone,
    BOOLOR_AGG(n.event_type = 'add_to_cart') AS has_add_to_cart,
    BOOLOR_AGG(n.event_type = 'order_completed') AS has_order
  FROM numbered AS n
  GROUP BY
    n.anonymous_id,
    n.session_number
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      s.anonymous_id || ':' || TO_CHAR(s.session_start_utc, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
    )::VARCHAR AS session_id,
    s.anonymous_id,
    s.customer_id::VARCHAR AS customer_id,
    DATE_TRUNC('day', s.session_start_utc)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS session_day,
    s.session_start_utc,
    s.session_end_utc,
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE(
      'UTC',
      COALESCE(s.client_timezone, 'UTC'),
      s.session_start_utc
    )::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS session_start_visitor_local,
    DATEDIFF('second', s.session_start_utc, s.session_end_utc)::INT AS duration_seconds,
    s.event_count::INT AS event_count,
    s.page_view_count::INT AS page_view_count,
    s.landing_page_path::VARCHAR AS landing_page_path,
    s.exit_page_path::VARCHAR AS exit_page_path,
    s.referrer_host::VARCHAR AS referrer_host,
    s.landing_page_url::VARCHAR AS landing_page_url,
    (
      s.page_view_count <= 1
      AND s.event_count <= 1
    ) AS is_bounce,
    s.has_add_to_cart::BOOLEAN AS has_add_to_cart,
    s.has_order::BOOLEAN AS has_order
  FROM sessions AS s
  WHERE
    s.session_start_utc >= TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ('2026-01-01 00:00:00')
    AND s.session_start_utc < TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ('2026-01-02 00:00:00')
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: int_wishlist_demand
statements.sql:
WITH wishlist_items AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_wishlist_items
),

wishlists AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_wishlists
),

order_lines AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_order_lines
),

orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_orders
),

saved AS (
  SELECT
    i.sku,
    i.customer_id,
    MIN(i.added_at) AS added_at,
    MAX(IFF(w.is_public, 1, 0)) AS on_public_list
  FROM wishlist_items AS i
  INNER JOIN wishlists AS w
    ON i.wishlist_id = w.wishlist_id
  GROUP BY
    i.sku,
    i.customer_id
),

purchases AS (
  SELECT
    l.sku,
    o.customer_id,
    MIN(o.placed_at) AS first_purchased_at
  FROM order_lines AS l
  INNER JOIN orders AS o
    ON l.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY
    l.sku,
    o.customer_id
),

matched AS (
  SELECT
    s.sku,
    s.customer_id,
    s.added_at,
    s.on_public_list,
    p.first_purchased_at,
    IFF(
      p.first_purchased_at >= s.added_at,
      DATEDIFF('hour', s.added_at, p.first_purchased_at) / 24,
      NULL
    ) AS days_to_purchase
  FROM saved AS s
  LEFT JOIN purchases AS p
    ON s.sku = p.sku
    AND s.customer_id = p.customer_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    m.sku,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.customer_id)::INT AS wishlisting_customers,
    SUM(m.on_public_list)::INT AS public_wishlist_count,
    COUNT_IF(m.first_purchased_at >= m.added_at)::INT AS purchased_after_wishlist,
    ROUND(
      COUNT_IF(m.first_purchased_at >= m.added_at) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT m.customer_id), 0),
      6
    )::NUMBER(9, 6) AS wishlist_conversion_rate,
    MEDIAN(m.days_to_purchase)::NUMBER(10, 2) AS median_days_to_purchase,
    MIN(m.added_at) AS first_added_at
  FROM matched AS m
  GROUP BY
    m.sku
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_affiliate_payouts_monthly
statements.sql:
WITH commissions AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_affiliate_commissions_usd
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      c.affiliate_network || ':'
      || TO_VARCHAR(
        DATE_TRUNC('month', CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', c.converted_at)),
        'YYYY-MM'
      )
    )::VARCHAR AS affiliate_month_key,
    c.affiliate_network,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', c.converted_at))::DATE AS conversion_month,
    COUNT(*)::INT AS conversions,
    COUNT_IF(c.is_last_click)::INT AS last_click_conversions,
    SUM(c.payable_commission_usd)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS payable_commission_usd,
    SUM(
      IFF(c.is_last_click AND c.is_reversible, c.commission_usd, 0)
    )::NUMBER(18, 2) AS reversed_commission_usd,
    ROUND(
      SUM(c.payable_commission_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(IFF(c.is_last_click, c.order_amount_usd, 0)), 0),
      6
    )::NUMBER(9, 6) AS effective_commission_rate
  FROM commissions AS c
  GROUP BY
    c.affiliate_network,
    DATE_TRUNC(
      'month',
      CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', c.converted_at)
    )
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_agent_scorecard
statements.sql:
WITH utilisation AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_agent_utilisation
),

first_responses AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_ticket_first_response
),

history AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_customer_support_history
),

agent_csat AS (
  SELECT
    f.first_responder_id AS agent_id,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', f.first_response_at_utc) AS response_month,
    AVG(h.csat_score) AS average_csat
  FROM first_responses AS f
  INNER JOIN history AS h
    ON f.ticket_id = h.ticket_id
  WHERE h.csat_score IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
),

monthly AS (
  SELECT
    u.agent_id,
    u.team_code,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', u.shift_start_utc) AS shift_month,
    COUNT(*) AS shifts,
    SUM(u.productive_minutes) / 60 AS productive_hours,
    AVG(u.utilisation) AS average_utilisation,
    SUM(u.calls_handled) AS calls_handled,
    SUM(u.tickets_first_responded) AS tickets_first_responded
  FROM utilisation AS u
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2,
    3
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      m.agent_id || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(m.shift_month, 'YYYY-MM')
    )::VARCHAR AS agent_month_key,
    m.agent_id,
    m.team_code,
    m.shift_month::DATE AS shift_month,
    m.shifts::INT AS shifts,
    ROUND(m.productive_hours, 2)::NUMBER(10, 2) AS productive_hours,
    ROUND(m.average_utilisation, 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS average_utilisation,
    m.calls_handled::INT AS calls_handled,
    m.tickets_first_responded::INT AS tickets_first_responded,
    ROUND(c.average_csat, 2)::NUMBER(4, 2) AS average_csat,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.team_code, m.shift_month
      ORDER BY m.average_utilisation DESC NULLS LAST
    )::INT AS utilisation_rank_in_team
  FROM monthly AS m
  LEFT JOIN agent_csat AS c
    ON m.agent_id = c.agent_id
    AND m.shift_month = c.response_month
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_basket_mix_weekly
statements.sql:
WITH lines AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__fct_order_lines
),

orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__fct_orders
),

weekly AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('week', o.placed_date_local) AS week_start,
    COALESCE(l.category_level_1, 'uncategorised') AS category_level_1,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count,
    SUM(l.quantity) AS units,
    SUM(l.net_amount_minor) AS net_amount_minor,
    AVG(IFF(l.discount_amount_minor > 0, 1, 0)) AS discounted_line_share
  FROM lines AS l
  INNER JOIN orders AS o
    ON l.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('week', o.placed_date_local),
    COALESCE(l.category_level_1, 'uncategorised')
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      TO_VARCHAR(w.week_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ':' || w.category_level_1
    )::VARCHAR AS basket_week_key,
    w.week_start::DATE AS week_start,
    w.category_level_1::VARCHAR AS category_level_1,
    w.order_count::INT AS order_count,
    w.units::INT AS units,
    w.net_amount_minor::INT AS net_amount_minor,
    ROUND(w.discounted_line_share, 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS discounted_line_share,
    ROUND(
      RATIO_TO_REPORT(w.units) OVER (PARTITION BY w.week_start),
      4
    )::NUMBER(9, 4) AS unit_share_of_week,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.week_start ORDER BY w.units DESC)::INT AS category_rank
  FROM weekly AS w
)

statements.name: rpt_campaign_roas_monthly
statements.sql:
WITH spend AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__fct_campaign_spend
),

orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__fct_orders
),

campaigns AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__dim_campaigns
),

campaign_keys AS (
  SELECT
    LOWER(c.campaign_id) AS utm_campaign,
    c.channel
  FROM campaigns AS c
),

monthly_spend AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', s.spend_date) AS spend_month,
    s.channel,
    SUM(s.spend_usd) AS spend_usd,
    SUM(s.clicks) AS clicks
  FROM spend AS s
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
),

monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', o.placed_date_local) AS spend_month,
    k.channel,
    COUNT(*) AS attributed_orders,
    SUM(o.amount_usd) AS attributed_revenue_usd
  FROM orders AS o
  INNER JOIN campaign_keys AS k
    ON o.utm_campaign = k.utm_campaign
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      TO_VARCHAR(s.spend_month, 'YYYY-MM') || ':' || s.channel
    )::VARCHAR AS roas_key,
    s.spend_month::DATE AS spend_month,
    s.channel,
    s.spend_usd::NUMBER(18, 2) AS spend_usd,
    s.clicks::INT AS clicks,
    COALESCE(r.attributed_orders, 0)::INT AS attributed_orders,
    COALESCE(r.attributed_revenue_usd, 0)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS attributed_revenue_usd,
    ROUND(r.attributed_revenue_usd / NULLIF(s.spend_usd, 0), 4)::NUMBER(12, 4) AS return_on_ad_spend
  FROM monthly_spend AS s
  LEFT JOIN monthly_revenue AS r
    ON s.spend_month = r.spend_month
    AND s.channel = r.channel
)

statements.name: rpt_carrier_performance_weekly
statements.sql:
WITH shipments AS (

final AS (

      || TO_VARCHAR(

    s.carrier_code,

    COUNT(*)::INT AS shipments,
    ROUND(AVG(IFF(s.is_dispatch_on_time, 1, 0)), 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS on_time_dispatch_rate,
    ROUND(
      PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.hours_to_deliver),
      2
    )::NUMBER(10, 2) AS p50_hours_to_deliver,
    ROUND(
      PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.hours_to_deliver),
      2
    )::NUMBER(10, 2) AS p90_hours_to_deliver,
    ROUND(AVG(IFF(s.exception_count > 0, 1, 0)), 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS exception_rate,
    SUM(s.compensation_usd)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS compensation_usd
  FROM shipments AS s

statements.name: rpt_category_tree_sales
statements.sql:
WITH categories AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_category_paths
),

catalogue AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__dim_products
),

lines AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__fct_order_lines
),

product_catalogue AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_product_catalogue
),

product_categories AS (
  SELECT
    p.sku,
    c.category_id,
    c.slug_path
  FROM catalogue AS p
  INNER JOIN product_catalogue AS pc
    ON p.sku = pc.sku
  INNER JOIN categories AS c
    ON pc.category_id = c.category_id
),

node_ranges AS (
  SELECT
    c.category_id,
    c.slug_path || '/' AS range_start,
    c.slug_path || '0' AS range_end
  FROM categories AS c
),

own_sales AS (
  SELECT
    pc.category_id,
    pc.slug_path || '/' AS slug_path_key,
    SUM(l.quantity) AS own_units,
    SUM(l.net_amount_minor) AS own_net_minor
  FROM lines AS l
  INNER JOIN product_categories AS pc
    ON l.sku = pc.sku
  GROUP BY
    pc.category_id,
    pc.slug_path
),

subtree AS (
  SELECT
    r.category_id,
    SUM(s.own_units) AS subtree_units,
    SUM(s.own_net_minor) AS subtree_net_minor
  FROM node_ranges AS r
  INNER JOIN own_sales AS s
    ON s.slug_path_key >= r.range_start
    AND s.slug_path_key < r.range_end
  GROUP BY
    r.category_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    c.category_id,
    c.slug_path,
    c.depth,
    c.is_leaf,
    COALESCE(o.own_units, 0)::INT AS own_units,
    COALESCE(t.subtree_units, 0)::INT AS subtree_units,
    COALESCE(t.subtree_net_minor, 0)::INT AS subtree_net_amount_minor,
    ROUND(t.subtree_units / NULLIF(pt.subtree_units, 0), 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS share_of_parent_units
  FROM categories AS c
  LEFT JOIN own_sales AS o
    ON c.category_id = o.category_id
  LEFT JOIN subtree AS t
    ON c.category_id = t.category_id
  LEFT JOIN subtree AS pt
    ON c.parent_category_id = pt.category_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_channel_attribution_daily
statements.sql:
WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__fct_web_sessions
),

channel_days AS (
  SELECT
    s.session_start_utc::DATE AS session_date,
    COALESCE(s.channel_code, 'UNKNOWN') AS channel_code,
    s.session_id,
    s.anonymous_id,
    s.converted,
    s.is_paid,
    'last_touch' AS credit_basis
  FROM sessions AS s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    s.session_start_utc::DATE AS session_date,
    COALESCE(s.first_touch_channel, 'UNKNOWN') AS channel_code,
    s.session_id,
    s.anonymous_id,
    s.converted,
    s.is_paid,
    'first_touch' AS credit_basis
  FROM sessions AS s
  WHERE s.converted
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      TO_VARCHAR(c.session_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ':' || c.channel_code
    )::VARCHAR AS channel_day_key,
    c.session_date::DATE AS session_date,
    c.channel_code::VARCHAR AS channel_code,
    COUNT_IF(c.credit_basis = 'last_touch')::INT AS sessions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(c.credit_basis = 'last_touch', c.anonymous_id, NULL))::INT AS visitors,
    COUNT_IF(c.credit_basis = 'last_touch' AND c.converted)::INT AS conversions,
    ROUND(
      COUNT_IF(c.credit_basis = 'last_touch' AND c.converted)
        / NULLIF(COUNT_IF(c.credit_basis = 'last_touch'), 0),
      4
    )::NUMBER(9, 4) AS conversion_rate,
    COUNT(
      DISTINCT IFF(c.credit_basis = 'first_touch', c.session_id, NULL)
    )::INT AS first_touch_credit,
    ROUND(
      AVG(IFF(c.credit_basis = 'last_touch', IFF(c.is_paid, 1, 0), NULL)),
      4
    )::NUMBER(9, 4) AS paid_share
  FROM channel_days AS c
  GROUP BY
    c.session_date,
    c.channel_code
)

statements.name: rpt_chargeback_exposure

statements.name: rpt_consent_coverage
statements.sql:
WITH customers AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__dim_customers
),

consents AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_customer_consent_state
),

joined AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(c.region_code, 'UNKNOWN') AS region_code,
    COALESCE(s.email_marketing, FALSE) AS email_marketing,

final AS (

    ROUND(AVG(IFF(j.sms_marketing, 1, 0)), 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS sms_marketing_share,
    ROUND(AVG(IFF(j.personalisation, 1, 0)), 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS personalisation_share,
    ROUND(AVG(IFF(j.third_party_sharing, 1, 0)), 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS third_party_share,
