statements.name: rpt_contact_reasons_monthly
statements.sql:
WITH tickets AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__fct_support_tickets
),

calls AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_call_ivr_paths
),

ticket_reasons AS (
  SELECT
    t.ticket_id,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', t.created_at_utc)::DATE AS contact_month,
    COALESCE(t.contact_reason, 'unspecified') AS contact_reason,
    t.is_repeat_contact_7d
  FROM tickets AS t
  WHERE t.created_at_utc IS NOT NULL
),

call_counts AS (
  SELECT
    c.ticket_id,
    COUNT(*) AS calls,
    COUNT_IF(c.abandoned_in_ivr) AS abandoned_in_ivr
  FROM calls AS c
  WHERE c.ticket_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    c.ticket_id
),

monthly AS (
  SELECT
    r.contact_month,
    r.contact_reason,
    COUNT(*) AS tickets,
    COUNT_IF(r.is_repeat_contact_7d) AS repeat_contacts,
    SUM(COALESCE(c.calls, 0)) AS calls,
    SUM(COALESCE(c.abandoned_in_ivr, 0)) AS abandoned_in_ivr
  FROM ticket_reasons AS r
  LEFT JOIN call_counts AS c
    ON r.ticket_id = c.ticket_id
  GROUP BY
    r.contact_month,
    r.contact_reason
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      TO_VARCHAR(m.contact_month, 'YYYY-MM') || ':' || m.contact_reason
    )::VARCHAR AS reason_month_key,
    m.contact_month,
    m.contact_reason::VARCHAR AS contact_reason,
    m.tickets::INT AS tickets,
    m.repeat_contacts::INT AS repeat_contacts,
    ROUND(m.repeat_contacts / NULLIF(m.tickets, 0), 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS repeat_rate,
    m.calls::INT AS calls,
    m.abandoned_in_ivr::INT AS abandoned_in_ivr,
    (
      m.tickets - LAG(m.tickets) OVER (PARTITION BY m.contact_reason ORDER BY m.contact_month)
    )::INT AS month_over_month_change
  FROM monthly AS m
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_customer_cohorts_monthly
statements.sql:
WITH order_sequence AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_customer_order_sequence
),

activity AS (
  SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    s.cohort_month,
    DATEDIFF(
      'month',
      s.cohort_month,
      DATE_TRUNC('month', s.placed_date_local)
    ) AS months_since_first_order,
    s.amount_usd
  FROM order_sequence AS s
),

cohort_sizes AS (
  SELECT
    a.cohort_month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id) AS cohort_size
  FROM activity AS a
  GROUP BY
    a.cohort_month
),

cells AS (
  SELECT
    a.cohort_month,
    a.months_since_first_order,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id) AS active_customers,
    SUM(a.amount_usd) AS revenue_usd
  FROM activity AS a
  GROUP BY
    a.cohort_month,
    a.months_since_first_order
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      TO_VARCHAR(c.cohort_month, 'YYYY-MM') || '+' || c.months_since_first_order::VARCHAR
    )::VARCHAR AS cohort_cell_key,
    c.cohort_month,
    c.months_since_first_order::INT AS months_since_first_order,
    z.cohort_size::INT AS cohort_size,
    c.active_customers::INT AS active_customers,
    ROUND(c.active_customers / NULLIF(z.cohort_size, 0), 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS retention_rate,
    c.revenue_usd::NUMBER(18, 2) AS revenue_usd,
    ROUND(
      SUM(c.revenue_usd) OVER (
        PARTITION BY c.cohort_month
        ORDER BY c.months_since_first_order
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      )
        / NULLIF(z.cohort_size, 0),
      2
    )::NUMBER(18, 2) AS cumulative_revenue_per_customer_usd
  FROM cells AS c
  INNER JOIN cohort_sizes AS z
    ON c.cohort_month = z.cohort_month
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_daily_sales_by_region
statements.sql:
WITH orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__fct_orders
),

daily AS (
  SELECT
    o.placed_date_local,
    COALESCE(o.region_code, 'UNKNOWN') AS region_code,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customer_count,
    COUNT_IF(o.is_first_order) AS first_order_count,
    SUM(o.units) AS units,
    SUM(o.amount_usd) AS revenue_usd,
    SUM(o.discount_amount_usd) AS discount_usd
  FROM orders AS o
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'PENDING')
  GROUP BY
    o.placed_date_local,
    COALESCE(o.region_code, 'UNKNOWN')
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      d.region_code || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(d.placed_date_local, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    )::VARCHAR AS sales_day_key,
    d.placed_date_local,
    d.region_code::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    d.order_count::INT AS order_count,
    d.customer_count::INT AS customer_count,
    d.first_order_count::INT AS first_order_count,
    d.units::INT AS units,
    d.revenue_usd::NUMBER(18, 2) AS revenue_usd,
    d.discount_usd::NUMBER(18, 2) AS discount_usd,
    ROUND(d.revenue_usd / NULLIF(d.order_count, 0), 2)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS average_order_usd,
    SUM(d.revenue_usd) OVER (
      PARTITION BY d.region_code
      ORDER BY d.placed_date_local
      RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '7 days' PRECEDING AND INTERVAL '7 days' PRECEDING
    )::NUMBER(18, 2) AS revenue_same_day_last_week_usd,
    SUM(d.revenue_usd) OVER (
      PARTITION BY d.region_code
      ORDER BY d.placed_date_local
      RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '27 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    )::NUMBER(18, 2) AS revenue_trailing_28d_usd
  FROM daily AS d
)

statements.name: rpt_delivery_exceptions_monthly
statements.sql:
WITH exceptions AS (

),

dated_codes AS (

    e.carrier_code,
    e.responsibility,
    e.exception_code
  FROM exceptions AS e
  WHERE e.exception_code IS NOT NULL
),

code_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d.exception_month,
    d.carrier_code,
    d.responsibility,
    d.exception_code,
    COUNT(*) AS code_exceptions
  FROM dated_codes AS d
  GROUP BY
    d.exception_month,
    d.carrier_code,
    d.responsibility,
    d.exception_code
),

top_codes AS (
  SELECT
    cc.exception_month,
    cc.carrier_code,
    cc.responsibility,
    cc.exception_code
  FROM code_counts AS cc
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY cc.exception_month, cc.carrier_code, cc.responsibility
      ORDER BY cc.code_exceptions DESC, cc.exception_code
    ) = 1
),

counts AS (
  SELECT
    (
      TO_VARCHAR(
        DATE_TRUNC('month', CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', e.occurred_at)),
        'YYYY-MM'
      )
      || ':' || e.carrier_code || ':' || e.responsibility
    )::VARCHAR AS exception_month_key,
    DATE_TRUNC(
      'month',
      CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', e.occurred_at)
    )::DATE AS exception_month,
    e.carrier_code,
    e.responsibility,
    COUNT(*)::INT AS exceptions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.shipment_id)::INT AS shipments_affected,
    ROUND(MEDIAN(e.hours_to_resolve), 2)::NUMBER(10, 2) AS median_hours_to_resolve,
    SUM(e.compensation_usd)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS compensation_usd
  FROM exceptions AS e
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC(
      'month',
      CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', e.occurred_at)
    ),
    e.carrier_code,
    e.responsibility
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    c.exception_month_key,
    c.exception_month,
    c.carrier_code,
    c.responsibility,
    c.exceptions,
    c.shipments_affected,
    c.median_hours_to_resolve,
    c.compensation_usd,
    t.exception_code::VARCHAR AS top_exception_code
  FROM counts AS c
  LEFT JOIN top_codes AS t
    ON c.exception_month = t.exception_month
    AND c.carrier_code = t.carrier_code
    AND c.responsibility = t.responsibility
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_executive_kpis_daily
statements.sql:
WITH orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__fct_orders
),

refunds AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__fct_refunds
),

web_sessions AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__fct_web_sessions
),

tickets AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__fct_support_tickets
),

shipments AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__fct_shipments
),

warehouses AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__dim_warehouses
),

campaign_spend AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__fct_campaign_spend
),

inventory AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__fct_inventory_daily
),

recognition AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_revenue_recognition_daily
),

partner_orders AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__fct_partner_orders
),

chargebacks AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_chargeback_exposure
),

calendar AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__dim_date
),

reporting_window AS (
  SELECT c.calendar_date
  FROM calendar AS c
  WHERE
    c.calendar_date <= '2026-03-31'::DATE
    AND c.calendar_date > DATEADD(
      'day',
      -120,
      '2026-03-31'::DATE
    )
),

completed_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.placed_date_local AS kpi_date,
    COALESCE(o.region_code, 'GLOBAL') AS region_code,
    o.amount_usd,
    o.is_first_order
  FROM orders AS o
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'PENDING')
),

order_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    c.kpi_date,
    c.region_code,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count,
    SUM(c.amount_usd) AS revenue_usd,
    AVG(c.amount_usd) AS average_order_usd,
    COUNT_IF(c.is_first_order) AS new_customers
  FROM completed_orders AS c
  GROUP BY
    c.kpi_date,
    c.region_code
),

order_regions AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    COALESCE(o.region_code, 'GLOBAL') AS region_code
  FROM orders AS o
),

refund_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    r.refunded_date AS kpi_date,
    COALESCE(o.region_code, 'GLOBAL') AS region_code,
    SUM(r.amount_usd) AS refund_usd,
    COUNT(*) AS refund_count
  FROM refunds AS r
  LEFT JOIN order_regions AS o
    ON r.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
),

session_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    s.session_start_utc::DATE AS kpi_date,
    COUNT(*) AS sessions,
    AVG(IFF(s.converted, 1, 0)) AS conversion_rate,
    AVG(IFF(s.is_bounce, 1, 0)) AS bounce_rate
  FROM web_sessions AS s
  GROUP BY
    1
),

ticket_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    t.created_at_utc::DATE AS kpi_date,
    COUNT(*) AS tickets,
    AVG(IFF(t.is_first_response_breached, 1, 0)) AS first_response_breach_rate,
    AVG(t.csat_score) AS average_csat
  FROM tickets AS t
  WHERE t.created_at_utc IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    1
),

warehouse_regions AS (
  SELECT
    w.warehouse_code,
    COALESCE(w.region_code, 'GLOBAL') AS region_code
  FROM warehouses AS w
),

shipment_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', s.shipped_at)::DATE AS kpi_date,
    COALESCE(w.region_code, 'GLOBAL') AS region_code,
    COUNT(*) AS shipments,
    AVG(IFF(s.is_dispatch_on_time, 1, 0)) AS on_time_dispatch_rate,
    AVG(s.hours_to_deliver) AS average_hours_to_deliver
  FROM shipments AS s
  LEFT JOIN warehouse_regions AS w
    ON s.warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
  WHERE s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
),

spend_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    s.spend_date AS kpi_date,
    SUM(s.spend_usd) AS spend_usd,
    SUM(s.clicks) AS paid_clicks
  FROM campaign_spend AS s
  GROUP BY
    1
),

stock_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    i.calendar_date AS kpi_date,
    COALESCE(w.region_code, 'GLOBAL') AS region_code,
    COUNT_IF(i.is_stocked_out) AS stocked_out_sku_days,
    SUM(i.stock_value_usd) AS stock_value_usd
  FROM inventory AS i
  LEFT JOIN warehouse_regions AS w
    ON i.warehouse_code = w.warehouse_code
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
),

subscription_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    r.recognition_date AS kpi_date,
    r.region_code,
    SUM(r.revenue_usd) AS subscription_revenue_usd
  FROM recognition AS r
  WHERE r.revenue_stream = 'subscription'
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
),

partner_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    p.placed_date AS kpi_date,
    COUNT(*) AS partner_orders,
    SUM(p.order_total_usd) AS partner_revenue_usd
  FROM partner_orders AS p
  GROUP BY
    1
),

chargeback_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', c.opened_at)::DATE AS kpi_date,
    COUNT(*) AS chargebacks_opened,
    SUM(c.amount_usd) AS chargeback_usd
  FROM chargebacks AS c
  GROUP BY
    1
),

all_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    m.kpi_date::DATE AS kpi_date,
    m.region_code::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'orders'::VARCHAR AS metric_name,
    m.order_count::NUMBER(18, 4) AS metric_value
  FROM order_metrics AS m
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    m.kpi_date::DATE AS kpi_date,
    m.region_code::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'revenue_usd'::VARCHAR AS metric_name,
    m.revenue_usd::NUMBER(18, 4) AS metric_value
  FROM order_metrics AS m
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    m.kpi_date::DATE AS kpi_date,
    m.region_code::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'average_order_usd'::VARCHAR AS metric_name,
    m.average_order_usd::NUMBER(18, 4) AS metric_value
  FROM order_metrics AS m
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    m.kpi_date::DATE AS kpi_date,
    m.region_code::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'new_customers'::VARCHAR AS metric_name,
    m.new_customers::NUMBER(18, 4) AS metric_value
  FROM order_metrics AS m
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    r.kpi_date::DATE AS kpi_date,
    r.region_code::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'refund_usd'::VARCHAR AS metric_name,
    r.refund_usd::NUMBER(18, 4) AS metric_value
  FROM refund_metrics AS r
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    r.kpi_date::DATE AS kpi_date,
    r.region_code::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'refunds'::VARCHAR AS metric_name,
    r.refund_count::NUMBER(18, 4) AS metric_value
  FROM refund_metrics AS r
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    s.kpi_date::DATE AS kpi_date,
    'GLOBAL'::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'web_sessions'::VARCHAR AS metric_name,
    s.sessions::NUMBER(18, 4) AS metric_value
  FROM session_metrics AS s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    s.kpi_date::DATE AS kpi_date,
    'GLOBAL'::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'web_conversion_rate'::VARCHAR AS metric_name,
    s.conversion_rate::NUMBER(18, 4) AS metric_value
  FROM session_metrics AS s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    s.kpi_date::DATE AS kpi_date,
    'GLOBAL'::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'web_bounce_rate'::VARCHAR AS metric_name,
    s.bounce_rate::NUMBER(18, 4) AS metric_value
  FROM session_metrics AS s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    t.kpi_date::DATE AS kpi_date,
    'GLOBAL'::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'support_tickets'::VARCHAR AS metric_name,
    t.tickets::NUMBER(18, 4) AS metric_value
  FROM ticket_metrics AS t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    t.kpi_date::DATE AS kpi_date,
    'GLOBAL'::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'first_response_breach_rate'::VARCHAR AS metric_name,
    t.first_response_breach_rate::NUMBER(18, 4) AS metric_value
  FROM ticket_metrics AS t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    t.kpi_date::DATE AS kpi_date,
    'GLOBAL'::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'average_csat'::VARCHAR AS metric_name,
    t.average_csat::NUMBER(18, 4) AS metric_value
  FROM ticket_metrics AS t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    s.kpi_date::DATE AS kpi_date,
    s.region_code::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'shipments'::VARCHAR AS metric_name,
    s.shipments::NUMBER(18, 4) AS metric_value
  FROM shipment_metrics AS s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    s.kpi_date::DATE AS kpi_date,
    s.region_code::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'on_time_dispatch_rate'::VARCHAR AS metric_name,
    s.on_time_dispatch_rate::NUMBER(18, 4) AS metric_value
  FROM shipment_metrics AS s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    s.kpi_date::DATE AS kpi_date,
    s.region_code::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'average_hours_to_deliver'::VARCHAR AS metric_name,
    s.average_hours_to_deliver::NUMBER(18, 4) AS metric_value
  FROM shipment_metrics AS s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    p.kpi_date::DATE AS kpi_date,
    'GLOBAL'::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'marketing_spend_usd'::VARCHAR AS metric_name,
    p.spend_usd::NUMBER(18, 4) AS metric_value
  FROM spend_metrics AS p
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    p.kpi_date::DATE AS kpi_date,
    'GLOBAL'::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'paid_clicks'::VARCHAR AS metric_name,
    p.paid_clicks::NUMBER(18, 4) AS metric_value
  FROM spend_metrics AS p
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    k.kpi_date::DATE AS kpi_date,
    k.region_code::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'stocked_out_sku_days'::VARCHAR AS metric_name,
    k.stocked_out_sku_days::NUMBER(18, 4) AS metric_value
  FROM stock_metrics AS k
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    k.kpi_date::DATE AS kpi_date,
    k.region_code::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'stock_value_usd'::VARCHAR AS metric_name,
    k.stock_value_usd::NUMBER(18, 4) AS metric_value
  FROM stock_metrics AS k
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    b.kpi_date::DATE AS kpi_date,
    b.region_code::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'subscription_revenue_usd'::VARCHAR AS metric_name,
    b.subscription_revenue_usd::NUMBER(18, 4) AS metric_value
  FROM subscription_metrics AS b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    p.kpi_date::DATE AS kpi_date,
    'GLOBAL'::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'partner_orders'::VARCHAR AS metric_name,
    p.partner_orders::NUMBER(18, 4) AS metric_value
  FROM partner_metrics AS p
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    p.kpi_date::DATE AS kpi_date,
    'GLOBAL'::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'partner_revenue_usd'::VARCHAR AS metric_name,
    p.partner_revenue_usd::NUMBER(18, 4) AS metric_value
  FROM partner_metrics AS p
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    c.kpi_date::DATE AS kpi_date,
    'GLOBAL'::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'chargebacks_opened'::VARCHAR AS metric_name,
    c.chargebacks_opened::NUMBER(18, 4) AS metric_value
  FROM chargeback_metrics AS c
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    c.kpi_date::DATE AS kpi_date,
    'GLOBAL'::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    'chargeback_usd'::VARCHAR AS metric_name,
    c.chargeback_usd::NUMBER(18, 4) AS metric_value
  FROM chargeback_metrics AS c
),

metric_catalogue AS (
  SELECT
    v.metric_name,
    v.business_area,
    v.metric_label,
    v.unit,
    v.higher_is_better
  FROM VALUES
    ('orders', 'orders', 'Orders', 'count', TRUE),
    ('revenue_usd', 'orders', 'Revenue', 'usd', TRUE),
    ('average_order_usd', 'orders', 'Average order value', 'usd', TRUE),
    ('new_customers', 'customers', 'New customers', 'count', TRUE),
    ('refund_usd', 'orders', 'Refunded', 'usd', FALSE),
    ('refunds', 'orders', 'Refunds', 'count', FALSE),
    ('web_sessions', 'clickstream', 'Web sessions', 'count', TRUE),
    ('web_conversion_rate', 'clickstream', 'Web conversion rate', 'ratio', TRUE),
    ('web_bounce_rate', 'clickstream', 'Web bounce rate', 'ratio', FALSE),
    ('support_tickets', 'support', 'Support tickets', 'count', FALSE),
    ('first_response_breach_rate', 'support', 'First response SLA breaches', 'ratio', FALSE),
    ('average_csat', 'support', 'Average CSAT', 'score', TRUE),
    ('shipments', 'fulfilment', 'Shipments dispatched', 'count', TRUE),
    ('on_time_dispatch_rate', 'fulfilment', 'On-time dispatch', 'ratio', TRUE),
    ('average_hours_to_deliver', 'fulfilment', 'Hours to deliver', 'hours', FALSE),
    ('marketing_spend_usd', 'growth', 'Marketing spend', 'usd', FALSE),
    ('paid_clicks', 'growth', 'Paid clicks', 'count', TRUE),
    ('stocked_out_sku_days', 'inventory', 'Stocked-out SKU days', 'count', FALSE),
    ('stock_value_usd', 'inventory', 'Stock value', 'usd', FALSE),
    ('subscription_revenue_usd', 'finance', 'Subscription revenue', 'usd', TRUE),
    ('partner_orders', 'partners', 'Partner orders', 'count', TRUE),
    ('partner_revenue_usd', 'partners', 'Partner revenue', 'usd', TRUE),
    ('chargebacks_opened', 'finance', 'Chargebacks opened', 'count', FALSE),
    ('chargeback_usd', 'finance', 'Chargeback amount', 'usd', FALSE) AS v(metric_name, business_area, metric_label, unit, higher_is_better)
),

metric_regions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    a.region_code,
    a.metric_name
  FROM all_metrics AS a
),

dense_grid AS (
  SELECT
    w.calendar_date AS kpi_date,
    r.region_code,
    r.metric_name
  FROM reporting_window AS w
  CROSS JOIN metric_regions AS r
),

filled AS (
  SELECT
    g.kpi_date,
    g.region_code,
    g.metric_name,
    COALESCE(a.metric_value, 0) AS metric_value
  FROM dense_grid AS g
  LEFT JOIN all_metrics AS a
    ON g.kpi_date = a.kpi_date
    AND g.region_code = a.region_code
    AND g.metric_name = a.metric_name
),

compared AS (
  SELECT
    f.kpi_date,
    f.region_code,
    f.metric_name,
    f.metric_value,
    SUM(f.metric_value) OVER (
      PARTITION BY f.region_code, f.metric_name
      ORDER BY f.kpi_date
      RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '7 days' PRECEDING AND INTERVAL '7 days' PRECEDING
    ) AS value_week_ago,
    AVG(f.metric_value) OVER (
      PARTITION BY f.region_code, f.metric_name
      ORDER BY f.kpi_date
      RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '27 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS trailing_28d_average
  FROM filled AS f
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      TO_VARCHAR(c.kpi_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ':' || c.region_code || ':' || c.metric_name
    )::VARCHAR AS kpi_key,
    c.kpi_date::DATE AS kpi_date,
    c.region_code::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    m.business_area::VARCHAR AS business_area,
    c.metric_name::VARCHAR AS metric_name,
    m.metric_label::VARCHAR AS metric_label,
    m.unit::VARCHAR AS unit,
    m.higher_is_better::BOOLEAN AS higher_is_better,
    c.metric_value::NUMBER(18, 4) AS metric_value,
    c.value_week_ago::NUMBER(18, 4) AS value_week_ago,
    ROUND(100
    * (
      c.metric_value / NULLIF(c.value_week_ago, 0) - 1
    ), 2)::NUMBER(12, 2) AS week_over_week_pct,
    ROUND(c.trailing_28d_average, 4)::NUMBER(18, 4) AS trailing_28d_average,
    IFF(
      m.higher_is_better,
      c.metric_value >= c.value_week_ago,
      c.metric_value <= c.value_week_ago
    )::BOOLEAN AS is_favourable_change
  FROM compared AS c
  LEFT JOIN metric_catalogue AS m
    ON c.metric_name = m.metric_name
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_experiment_results
statements.sql:
WITH exposures AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_experiment_exposures
),

variants AS (
  SELECT
    e.experiment_key,
    e.variant_key,
    BOOLOR_AGG(e.is_control) AS is_control,
    COUNT(*) AS exposed,
    COUNT_IF(e.converted) AS converted,
    MEDIAN(e.days_to_convert) AS median_days_to_convert
  FROM exposures AS e
  GROUP BY
    e.experiment_key,
    e.variant_key
),

controls AS (
  SELECT
    v.experiment_key,
    SUM(v.exposed) AS control_exposed,
    SUM(v.converted) AS control_converted
  FROM variants AS v
  WHERE v.is_control
  GROUP BY
    v.experiment_key
),

compared AS (
  SELECT
    v.experiment_key,
    v.variant_key,
    v.is_control,
    v.exposed,
    v.converted,
    v.median_days_to_convert,
    v.converted / NULLIF(v.exposed, 0) AS rate,
    c.control_converted / NULLIF(c.control_exposed, 0) AS control_rate,
    (
      v.converted + c.control_converted
    )
    / NULLIF(v.exposed + c.control_exposed, 0) AS pooled_rate,
    c.control_exposed
  FROM variants AS v
  LEFT JOIN controls AS c
    ON v.experiment_key = c.experiment_key
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      c.experiment_key || ':' || c.variant_key
    )::VARCHAR AS experiment_variant_key,
    c.experiment_key,
    c.variant_key,
    c.is_control::BOOLEAN AS is_control,
    c.exposed::INT AS exposed,
    c.converted::INT AS converted,
    ROUND(c.rate, 6)::NUMBER(9, 6) AS conversion_rate,
    ROUND(c.rate - c.control_rate, 6)::NUMBER(9, 6) AS lift_vs_control,
    ROUND(
      (
        c.rate - c.control_rate
      )
      / NULLIF(
        SQRT(c.pooled_rate
        * (
          1 - c.pooled_rate
        )
        * (
          1 / NULLIF(c.exposed, 0) + 1 / NULLIF(c.control_exposed, 0)
        )),
        0
      ),
      4
    )::NUMBER(9, 4) AS z_score,
    ROUND(c.median_days_to_convert, 2)::NUMBER(10, 2) AS median_days_to_convert
  FROM compared AS c
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_gift_card_liability
statements.sql:
WITH cards AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_gift_card_balances
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      c.currency_code || ':' || c.liability_status
    )::VARCHAR AS liability_key,
    c.currency_code,
    c.liability_status,
    COUNT(*)::INT AS card_count,
    SUM(GREATEST(c.balance_usd, 0))::NUMBER(18, 2) AS balance_usd,
    SUM(
      IFF(c.expires_on <= DATEADD('day', 90, '2026-03-31'::DATE), c.balance_usd, 0)
    )::NUMBER(18, 2) AS expiring_90d_usd,
    COUNT_IF(
      c.last_used_at < DATEADD('year', -1, '2026-03-31'::TIMESTAMP_TZ)
    )::INT AS dormant_card_count
  FROM cards AS c
  GROUP BY
    c.currency_code,
    c.liability_status
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_influencer_leaderboard
statements.sql:
WITH posts AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_influencer_promo_orders
),

creators AS (
  SELECT
    p.creator_handle,
    MODE(p.platform) AS primary_platform,
    COUNT(*) AS posts,
    SUM(p.impressions) AS impressions,
    SUM(p.engagements) AS engagements,
    SUM(p.credited_orders) AS credited_orders,
    SUM(p.credited_revenue_usd) AS credited_revenue_usd,
    SUM(p.discount_given_usd) AS discount_given_usd
  FROM posts AS p
  GROUP BY
    p.creator_handle
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    c.creator_handle,
    c.primary_platform::VARCHAR AS primary_platform,
    c.posts::INT AS posts,
    c.impressions::INT AS impressions,
    c.engagements::INT AS engagements,
    c.credited_orders::INT AS credited_orders,
    c.credited_revenue_usd::NUMBER(18, 2) AS credited_revenue_usd,
    c.discount_given_usd::NUMBER(18, 2) AS discount_given_usd,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.primary_platform
      ORDER BY c.credited_revenue_usd DESC
    )::INT AS revenue_rank
  FROM creators AS c
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_inventory_valuation_monthly
statements.sql:
WITH valuation AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_inventory_valuation_daily
),

month_ends AS (
  SELECT
    v.warehouse_code,
    v.calendar_date AS month_end,
    v.stock_value_usd,
    v.units_on_hand,
    v.unvalued_units,
    v.stocked_out_skus
  FROM valuation AS v
  WHERE
    v.calendar_date = LAST_DAY(v.calendar_date)
    OR v.calendar_date = '2026-03-31'::DATE
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      m.warehouse_code || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(m.month_end, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    )::VARCHAR AS valuation_month_key,
    m.warehouse_code,
    m.month_end,
    m.stock_value_usd,
    LAG(m.stock_value_usd) OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.warehouse_code
      ORDER BY m.month_end
    )::NUMBER(18, 2) AS previous_month_value_usd,
    ROUND(
      100
      * (
        m.stock_value_usd
        / NULLIF(
          LAG(m.stock_value_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY m.warehouse_code ORDER BY m.month_end),
          0
        )
        - 1
      ),
      2
    )::NUMBER(9, 2) AS change_pct,
    m.units_on_hand,
    m.unvalued_units,
    m.stocked_out_skus
  FROM month_ends AS m
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_invoice_sequence_gaps
statements.sql:
WITH invoices AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_invoices_reconciled
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    i.invoice_series,
    COUNT(*)::INT AS invoices,
    MIN(i.invoice_sequence)::INT AS first_sequence,
    MAX(i.invoice_sequence)::INT AS last_sequence,
    COUNT(i.sequence_gap)::INT AS gap_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(i.sequence_gap), 0)::INT AS missing_numbers,
    COUNT_IF(NOT i.header_balances)::INT AS unbalanced_headers,
    COUNT_IF(NOT i.tax_lines_agree OR NOT i.matches_order_tax)::INT AS tax_disagreements,
    COUNT_IF(NOT i.invoice_currency_matches_order)::INT AS currency_mismatches
  FROM invoices AS i
  GROUP BY
    i.invoice_series
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_loyalty_liability
statements.sql:
WITH balances AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_loyalty_balances
),

latest AS (
  SELECT
    b.loyalty_account_id,
    COALESCE(b.tier_code, 'NONE') AS tier_code,
    b.running_points,
    b.running_value_usd,
    b.expiring_points
  FROM balances AS b
  WHERE b.posted_at <= '2026-03-31'::TIMESTAMP_TZ
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY b.loyalty_account_id
      ORDER BY b.posted_at DESC, b.entry_id DESC
    ) = 1
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    l.tier_code::VARCHAR AS tier_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.loyalty_account_id)::INT AS member_count,
    SUM(l.running_points)::INT AS outstanding_points,
    ROUND(SUM(l.running_value_usd), 2)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS liability_usd,
    SUM(l.expiring_points)::INT AS expiring_points,
    ROUND(AVG(l.running_points), 2)::NUMBER(12, 2) AS average_points_per_member
  FROM latest AS l
  GROUP BY
    l.tier_code
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_margin_by_category
statements.sql:
WITH margins AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_product_margin
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      COALESCE(m.category_level_1, 'uncategorised') || ':' || m.currency_code
    )::VARCHAR AS margin_key,
    COALESCE(m.category_level_1, 'uncategorised')::VARCHAR AS category_level_1,
    m.currency_code,
    COUNT(*)::INT AS sku_count,
    ROUND(AVG(m.margin_pct), 2)::NUMBER(9, 2) AS average_margin_pct,
    ROUND(
      PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m.margin_pct),
      2
    )::NUMBER(9, 2) AS p25_margin_pct,
    ROUND(
      PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m.margin_pct),
      2
    )::NUMBER(9, 2) AS p75_margin_pct,
    COUNT_IF(m.is_below_cost)::INT AS below_cost_skus
  FROM margins AS m
  GROUP BY
    COALESCE(m.category_level_1, 'uncategorised'),
    m.currency_code
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_newsletter_growth_monthly
statements.sql:
WITH subscribers AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_newsletter_status
),

events AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(
      'month',
      CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', s.first_subscribed_at)
    )::DATE AS activity_month,
    1 AS subscribed,
    IFF(s.is_prospect, 1, 0) AS prospect,
    0 AS unsubscribed
  FROM subscribers AS s
  WHERE s.first_subscribed_at IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(
      'month',
      CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', s.last_unsubscribed_at)
    )::DATE AS activity_month,
    0 AS subscribed,
    0 AS prospect,
    1 AS unsubscribed
  FROM subscribers AS s
  WHERE
    s.is_globally_unsubscribed
    AND s.last_unsubscribed_at IS NOT NULL
),

monthly AS (
  SELECT
    e.activity_month,
    SUM(e.subscribed) AS new_subscribers,
    SUM(e.prospect) AS new_prospects,
    SUM(e.unsubscribed) AS unsubscribes
  FROM events AS e
  GROUP BY
    e.activity_month
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    m.activity_month,
    m.new_subscribers::INT AS new_subscribers,
    m.new_prospects::INT AS new_prospects,
    m.unsubscribes::INT AS unsubscribes,
    (
      m.new_subscribers - m.unsubscribes
    )::INT AS net_growth,
    SUM(m.new_subscribers - m.unsubscribes) OVER (
      ORDER BY m.activity_month
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    )::INT AS running_audience
  FROM monthly AS m
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_partner_fees_variance
statements.sql:
WITH fees AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_partner_fees_usd
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      f.partner_code || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(DATE_TRUNC('quarter', f.period_end), 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    )::VARCHAR AS partner_quarter_key,
    f.partner_code,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', f.period_end)::DATE AS settlement_quarter,
    COUNT(*)::INT AS statements,
    SUM(f.gross_sales_usd)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS gross_sales_usd,
    SUM(f.stated_commission_usd)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS stated_commission_usd,
    SUM(f.expected_commission_usd)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS expected_commission_usd,
    (
      SUM(f.stated_commission_usd) - SUM(f.expected_commission_usd)
    )::NUMBER(18, 2) AS variance_usd,
    COUNT_IF(NOT f.is_within_tolerance)::INT AS statements_out_of_tolerance,
    COUNT_IF(NOT f.statement_balances)::INT AS unbalanced_statements
  FROM fees AS f
  GROUP BY
    f.partner_code,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', f.period_end)
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_partner_listing_health
statements.sql:
WITH listings AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_partner_listing_status
),

grouped AS (
  SELECT
    l.partner_code,
    l.listing_health,
    COUNT(*) AS listings,
    COUNT_IF(l.fulfilled_by_partner) AS partner_fulfilled,
    SUM(l.units_sold_30d) AS units_sold_30d,
    AVG(l.commission_pct) AS average_commission_pct
  FROM listings AS l
  GROUP BY
    l.partner_code,
    l.listing_health
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      g.partner_code || ':' || g.listing_health
    )::VARCHAR AS listing_health_key,
    g.partner_code,
    g.listing_health,
    g.listings::INT AS listings,
    g.partner_fulfilled::INT AS partner_fulfilled,
    g.units_sold_30d::INT AS units_sold_30d,
    ROUND(g.average_commission_pct, 2)::NUMBER(5, 2) AS average_commission_pct,
    ROUND(
      RATIO_TO_REPORT(g.listings) OVER (PARTITION BY g.partner_code),
      4
    )::NUMBER(9, 4) AS share_of_partner_listings
  FROM grouped AS g
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_payment_decline_rates
statements.sql:
WITH payments AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__fct_payments
),

monthly AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(
      'month',
      CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', p.authorised_at)
    )::DATE AS attempt_month,
    p.payment_method,
    p.decline_family,
    COUNT(*) AS attempts,
    SUM(p.amount_usd) AS attempted_usd,
    COUNT_IF(NOT p.is_successful AND NOT p.is_final_attempt) AS recovered_on_retry
  FROM payments AS p
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2,
    3
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      TO_VARCHAR(m.attempt_month, 'YYYY-MM')
        || ':'
        || COALESCE(m.payment_method, '?')
        || ':'
        || m.decline_family
    )::VARCHAR AS decline_key,
    m.attempt_month,
    m.payment_method,
    m.decline_family,
    m.attempts::INT AS attempts,
    ROUND(
      RATIO_TO_REPORT(m.attempts) OVER (PARTITION BY m.attempt_month, m.payment_method),
      4
    )::NUMBER(9, 4) AS share_of_method_attempts,
    m.attempted_usd::NUMBER(18, 2) AS attempted_usd,
    m.recovered_on_retry::INT AS recovered_on_retry,
    ROUND((
  m.recovered_on_retry / NULLIF(m.attempts, 0)
)::NUMBER(38, 6), 4, 'HALF_TO_EVEN')::NUMBER(9, 4) AS retry_recovery_rate
  FROM monthly AS m
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_payout_reconciliation_status
statements.sql:
WITH payouts AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_payout_reconciliation
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      p.provider_code || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', p.paid_out_on), 'YYYY-MM')
    )::VARCHAR AS payout_status_key,
    p.provider_code,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', p.paid_out_on)::DATE AS payout_month,
    COUNT(*)::INT AS payouts,
    COUNT_IF(p.reconciliation_status = 'reconciled')::INT AS reconciled,
    COUNT_IF(p.reconciliation_status = 'awaiting_report')::INT AS awaiting_report,
    COUNT_IF(p.reconciliation_status IN ('line_mismatch', 'report_mismatch'))::INT AS mismatched,
    SUM(p.orphan_line_count)::INT AS orphan_lines,
    SUM(
      IFF(p.reconciliation_status <> 'reconciled', p.payout_net_minor, 0)
    )::INT AS unreconciled_net_minor,
    ROUND(
      AVG(IFF(p.reconciliation_status = 'reconciled', 1, 0)),
      4
    )::NUMBER(9, 4) AS reconciled_share
  FROM payouts AS p
  GROUP BY
    p.provider_code,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', p.paid_out_on)
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_price_changes_weekly
statements.sql:
WITH price_history AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_price_history
),

changes AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('week', CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', p.valid_from))::DATE AS week_start,
    p.currency_code,
    p.change_pct,
    p.is_markdown,
    p.sku,
    (
      p.list_amount_minor < p.lowest_price_30d_minor
    ) AS is_below_30d_low
  FROM price_history AS p
  WHERE p.previous_amount_minor IS NOT NULL
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      TO_VARCHAR(c.week_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ':' || c.currency_code
    )::VARCHAR AS price_week_key,
    c.week_start,
    c.currency_code,
    COUNT(*)::INT AS price_changes,
    COUNT_IF(c.change_pct > 0)::INT AS increases,
    COUNT_IF(c.is_markdown)::INT AS markdowns,
    ROUND(AVG(IFF(c.change_pct > 0, c.change_pct, NULL)), 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS average_increase_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(IFF(c.is_markdown, c.change_pct, NULL)), 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS average_markdown_pct,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(c.is_below_30d_low, c.sku, NULL))::INT AS skus_below_30d_low
  FROM changes AS c
  GROUP BY
    c.week_start,
    c.currency_code
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_product_affinity_top
statements.sql:
WITH affinity AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_product_view_affinity
),

products AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__dim_products
),

top_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    a.sku,
    a.co_viewed_sku,
    a.lift,
    a.pair_rank,
    a.sku_viewers
  FROM affinity AS a
  WHERE a.pair_rank <= 5
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    t.sku,
    MAX(p.title)::VARCHAR AS title,
    MAX(t.sku_viewers)::INT AS sku_viewers,
    ARRAY_AGG(
      OBJECT_CONSTRUCT('sku', t.co_viewed_sku, 'lift', t.lift)
    ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.pair_rank, t.co_viewed_sku)::ARRAY AS top_co_viewed,
    MAX(t.lift)::NUMBER(12, 4) AS best_lift
  FROM top_pairs AS t
  LEFT JOIN products AS p
    ON t.sku = p.sku
  GROUP BY
    t.sku
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_referral_program
statements.sql:
WITH referrals AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_referral_conversions
),

monthly AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', r.sent_at))::DATE AS invite_month,
    COUNT(*) AS invites_sent,
    COUNT(r.accepted_at) AS accepted,
    COUNT_IF(r.is_qualified) AS qualified,
    COUNT_IF(r.is_self_referral) AS self_referrals,
    SUM(IFF(r.is_qualified, r.reward_usd, 0)) AS reward_cost_usd,
    SUM(IFF(r.is_qualified, r.first_order_usd, 0)) AS referred_revenue_usd
  FROM referrals AS r
  GROUP BY
    1
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    m.invite_month,
    m.invites_sent::INT AS invites_sent,
    m.accepted::INT AS accepted,
    m.qualified::INT AS qualified,
    m.self_referrals::INT AS self_referrals,
    ROUND(m.accepted / NULLIF(m.invites_sent, 0), 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS acceptance_rate,
    m.reward_cost_usd::NUMBER(18, 2) AS reward_cost_usd,
    m.referred_revenue_usd::NUMBER(18, 2) AS referred_revenue_usd,
    ROUND(m.reward_cost_usd / NULLIF(m.qualified, 0), 2)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS cost_per_qualified_usd
  FROM monthly AS m
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_region_scorecard_monthly
statements.sql:
WITH sales AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__rpt_daily_sales_by_region
),

recognition AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__rpt_revenue_recognition_monthly
),

monthly_sales AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', s.placed_date_local)::DATE AS scorecard_month,
    s.region_code,
    SUM(s.order_count)::NUMBER(18, 4) AS orders,
    SUM(s.revenue_usd)::NUMBER(18, 4) AS revenue_usd,
    SUM(s.first_order_count)::NUMBER(18, 4) AS first_orders,
    (
      SUM(s.revenue_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(s.order_count), 0)
    )::NUMBER(18, 4) AS average_order_usd
  FROM sales AS s
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
),

wide AS (
  SELECT
    m.scorecard_month,
    m.region_code,
    m.orders,
    m.revenue_usd,
    m.first_orders,
    m.average_order_usd,
    COALESCE(r.refund_ratio, 0)::NUMBER(18, 4) AS refund_ratio,
    COALESCE(r.subscription_usd, 0)::NUMBER(18, 4) AS subscription_usd
  FROM monthly_sales AS m
  LEFT JOIN recognition AS r
    ON m.scorecard_month = r.recognition_month
    AND m.region_code = r.region_code
),

long_form AS (
  SELECT
    u.scorecard_month,
    u.region_code,
    u.measure,
    u.measure_value
  FROM wide UNPIVOT(
    measure_value FOR measure IN (
      orders,
      revenue_usd,
      first_orders,
      average_order_usd,
      refund_ratio,
      subscription_usd
    )
  ) AS u
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      TO_VARCHAR(l.scorecard_month, 'YYYY-MM') || ':' || l.region_code || ':' || LOWER(l.measure)
    )::VARCHAR AS scorecard_key,
    l.scorecard_month::DATE AS scorecard_month,
    l.region_code::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    LOWER(l.measure)::VARCHAR AS measure,
    l.measure_value::NUMBER(18, 4) AS measure_value,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY l.scorecard_month, l.measure
      ORDER BY l.measure_value DESC
    )::INT AS rank_among_regions
  FROM long_form AS l
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_returns_by_reason
statements.sql:
WITH reasons AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_return_reasons
),

outcomes AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_return_outcomes
),

monthly AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', r.requested_at))::DATE AS return_month,
    r.return_reason,
    COUNT(*) AS returns,
    SUM(r.qty) AS units,
    AVG(IFF(o.is_resellable, 1, 0)) AS resellable_share,
    SUM(o.refund_usd) AS refund_usd,
    MEDIAN(o.days_to_refund) AS median_days_to_refund
  FROM reasons AS r
  LEFT JOIN outcomes AS o
    ON r.return_id = o.return_id
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      TO_VARCHAR(m.return_month, 'YYYY-MM') || ':' || m.return_reason
    )::VARCHAR AS return_reason_key,
    m.return_month,
    m.return_reason::VARCHAR AS return_reason,
    m.returns::INT AS returns,
    m.units::INT AS units,
    ROUND(m.resellable_share, 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS resellable_share,
    m.refund_usd::NUMBER(18, 2) AS refund_usd,
    ROUND(m.median_days_to_refund, 2)::NUMBER(10, 2) AS median_days_to_refund,
    ROUND(
      RATIO_TO_REPORT(m.returns) OVER (PARTITION BY m.return_month),
      4
    )::NUMBER(9, 4) AS share_of_month
  FROM monthly AS m
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_revenue_recognition_monthly
statements.sql:
WITH recognition AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_revenue_recognition_daily
),

monthly AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', r.recognition_date) AS recognition_month,
    r.region_code,
    r.revenue_stream,
    r.revenue_usd
  FROM recognition AS r
),

pivoted AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM monthly PIVOT(
    SUM(revenue_usd) FOR revenue_stream IN ('product', 'refund', 'subscription')
  ) AS p(recognition_month, region_code, product_usd, refund_usd, subscription_usd)
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      TO_VARCHAR(p.recognition_month, 'YYYY-MM') || ':' || p.region_code
    )::VARCHAR AS recognition_month_key,
    p.recognition_month::DATE AS recognition_month,
    p.region_code::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    COALESCE(p.product_usd, 0)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS product_usd,
    COALESCE(p.refund_usd, 0)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS refund_usd,
    COALESCE(p.subscription_usd, 0)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS subscription_usd,
    (
      COALESCE(p.product_usd, 0) + COALESCE(p.refund_usd, 0) + COALESCE(p.subscription_usd, 0)
    )::NUMBER(18, 2) AS net_revenue_usd,
    ROUND(-p.refund_usd / NULLIF(p.product_usd, 0), 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS refund_ratio
  FROM pivoted AS p
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_review_scores_by_product
statements.sql:
WITH reviews AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_reviews_moderated
),

rating_counts AS (
  SELECT
    r.product_id,
    r.rating,
    COUNT(*) AS rating_count
  FROM reviews AS r
  GROUP BY
    r.product_id,
    r.rating
),

distribution AS (
  SELECT
    c.product_id,
    OBJECT_AGG(c.rating::VARCHAR, c.rating_count::VARIANT) AS rating_distribution
  FROM rating_counts AS c
  GROUP BY
    c.product_id
),

summary AS (
  SELECT
    r.product_id,
    COUNT(*) AS review_count,
    SUM(r.rating * r.review_weight) / NULLIF(SUM(r.review_weight), 0) AS weighted_rating,
    AVG(IFF(r.is_verified_purchase, 1, 0)) AS verified_share,
    SUM(r.sentiment_score) AS net_sentiment,
    MAX(r.submitted_at) AS latest_review_at
  FROM reviews AS r
  GROUP BY
    r.product_id
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    s.product_id,
    s.review_count::INT AS review_count,
    ROUND(s.weighted_rating, 2)::NUMBER(4, 2) AS weighted_rating,
    d.rating_distribution::OBJECT AS rating_distribution,
    ROUND(s.verified_share, 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS verified_share,
    s.net_sentiment::INT AS net_sentiment,
    s.latest_review_at
  FROM summary AS s
  LEFT JOIN distribution AS d
    ON s.product_id = d.product_id
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_rfm_segment_summary
statements.sql:
WITH customers AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__dim_customers
),

grouped AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(c.region_code, 'UNKNOWN') AS region_code,
    c.rfm_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customers,
    COUNT_IF(c.is_vip) AS vip_customers,
    SUM(c.lifetime_revenue_usd) AS lifetime_revenue_usd,
    MEDIAN(c.days_since_last_order) AS median_days_since_last_order
  FROM customers AS c
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      g.region_code || ':' || g.rfm_segment
    )::VARCHAR AS segment_key,
    g.region_code::VARCHAR AS region_code,
    g.rfm_segment,
    g.customers::INT AS customers,
    g.vip_customers::INT AS vip_customers,
    g.lifetime_revenue_usd::NUMBER(18, 2) AS lifetime_revenue_usd,
    ROUND(
      RATIO_TO_REPORT(g.lifetime_revenue_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY g.region_code),
      4
    )::NUMBER(9, 4) AS revenue_share_in_region,
    ROUND(g.median_days_since_last_order, 2)::NUMBER(10, 2) AS median_days_since_last_order
  FROM grouped AS g
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_search_terms_top
statements.sql:
WITH searches AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_search_conversion
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    s.search_term,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.search_count DESC, s.search_term)::INT AS search_rank,
    s.search_count,
    s.searching_visitors,
    s.zero_result_rate,
    s.view_after_search_rate,
    (
      s.zero_result_rate > 0.2
      OR s.view_after_search_rate < 0.1
    )::BOOLEAN AS needs_merchandising
  FROM searches AS s
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.search_count DESC, s.search_term) <= 500
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_stock_count_accuracy
statements.sql:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_stock_count_variances
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      c.warehouse_code || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', c.counted_at_local), 'YYYY-MM')
    )::VARCHAR AS count_month_key,
    c.warehouse_code,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', c.counted_at_local)::DATE AS count_month,
    COUNT(*)::INT AS counts,
    COUNT_IF(c.is_blind_count)::INT AS blind_counts,
    COUNT_IF(c.variance_qty = 0)::INT AS accurate_counts,
    ROUND(AVG(IFF(c.variance_qty = 0, 1, 0)), 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS accuracy_rate,
    COUNT_IF(c.is_out_of_tolerance)::INT AS out_of_tolerance,
    SUM(c.variance_qty)::INT AS net_variance_qty,
    ROUND(AVG(IFF(c.recount_sequence > 1, 1, 0)), 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS recount_rate
  FROM counts AS c
  GROUP BY

statements.name: rpt_stock_outs_weekly
statements.sql:
WITH inventory AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__fct_inventory_daily
),

runs AS (
  SELECT
    i.sku,
    i.warehouse_code,
    i.calendar_date,
    i.is_stocked_out,
    DATEADD(
      'day',
      -COUNT_IF(i.is_stocked_out) OVER (
        PARTITION BY i.sku, i.warehouse_code
        ORDER BY i.calendar_date
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ),
      i.calendar_date
    ) AS run_anchor
  FROM inventory AS i
),

run_lengths AS (
  SELECT
    r.warehouse_code,
    DATE_TRUNC('week', MIN(r.calendar_date)) AS week_start,
    COUNT(*) AS run_days
  FROM runs AS r
  WHERE r.is_stocked_out
  GROUP BY
    r.sku,
    r.warehouse_code,
    r.run_anchor
),

weekly AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('week', r.calendar_date) AS week_start,
    r.warehouse_code,
    COUNT(*) AS sku_days,
    COUNT_IF(r.is_stocked_out) AS stocked_out_sku_days,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IFF(r.is_stocked_out, r.sku, NULL)) AS skus_affected
  FROM runs AS r
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
),

longest AS (
  SELECT
    l.week_start,
    l.warehouse_code,
    MAX(l.run_days) AS longest_run_days
  FROM run_lengths AS l
  GROUP BY
    l.week_start,
    l.warehouse_code
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      w.warehouse_code || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(w.week_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    )::VARCHAR AS stock_out_key,
    w.week_start::DATE AS week_start,
    w.warehouse_code,
    w.sku_days::INT AS sku_days,
    w.stocked_out_sku_days::INT AS stocked_out_sku_days,
    ROUND(w.stocked_out_sku_days / NULLIF(w.sku_days, 0), 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS stock_out_rate,
    w.skus_affected::INT AS skus_affected,
    COALESCE(l.longest_run_days, 0)::INT AS longest_run_days
  FROM weekly AS w
  LEFT JOIN longest AS l
    ON w.week_start = l.week_start
    AND w.warehouse_code = l.warehouse_code
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_subscription_mrr_monthly
statements.sql:
WITH mrr_days AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_subscription_mrr_daily
),

month_ends AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', d.calendar_date) AS month_start,
    d.subscription_id,
    d.mrr_usd
  FROM mrr_days AS d
  WHERE
    d.calendar_date = LAST_DAY(d.calendar_date)
    OR d.calendar_date = '2026-03-31'::DATE
),

firsts AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', d.calendar_date) AS month_start,
    SUM(d.mrr_usd) AS new_mrr_usd,
    COUNT(*) AS new_subscribers
  FROM mrr_days AS d
  WHERE d.is_first_day
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('month', d.calendar_date)
),

closing AS (
  SELECT
    m.month_start,
    SUM(m.mrr_usd) AS closing_mrr_usd,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.subscription_id) AS active_subscribers
  FROM month_ends AS m
  GROUP BY
    m.month_start
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    c.month_start::DATE AS month_start,
    c.closing_mrr_usd::NUMBER(18, 2) AS closing_mrr_usd,
    LAG(c.closing_mrr_usd, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY c.month_start)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS opening_mrr_usd,
    COALESCE(f.new_mrr_usd, 0)::NUMBER(18, 2) AS new_mrr_usd,
    GREATEST(
      LAG(c.closing_mrr_usd, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY c.month_start)
        + COALESCE(f.new_mrr_usd, 0)
        - c.closing_mrr_usd,
      0
    )::NUMBER(18, 2) AS churned_mrr_usd,
    (
      c.closing_mrr_usd - LAG(c.closing_mrr_usd, 1, 0) OVER (ORDER BY c.month_start)
    )::NUMBER(18, 2) AS net_change_usd,
    c.active_subscribers::INT AS active_subscribers,
    COALESCE(f.new_subscribers, 0)::INT AS new_subscribers
  FROM closing AS c
  LEFT JOIN firsts AS f
    ON c.month_start = f.month_start
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: rpt_supplier_scorecard
statements.sql:
WITH po_lines AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__int_purchase_order_lines_received
),

quarterly AS (
  SELECT
    p.supplier_code,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', p.first_received_at_local)::DATE AS quarter_start,
    COUNT(*) AS po_lines,
    SUM(p.ordered_qty) AS ordered_qty,
    SUM(p.received_qty) AS received_qty,
    AVG(IFF(p.days_late > 0, 1, 0)) AS late_line_share,
    SUM(p.damaged_qty) AS damaged_qty,
    ARRAY_DISTINCT(ARRAY_FLATTEN(ARRAY_AGG(p.discrepancy_codes))) AS discrepancy_codes
  FROM po_lines AS p
  WHERE p.first_received_at_local IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      q.supplier_code || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(q.quarter_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    )::VARCHAR AS scorecard_key,
    q.supplier_code,
    q.quarter_start,
    q.po_lines::INT AS po_lines,
    q.ordered_qty::INT AS ordered_qty,
    q.received_qty::INT AS received_qty,
    ROUND(q.received_qty / NULLIF(q.ordered_qty, 0), 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS fill_rate,
    ROUND(q.late_line_share, 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS late_line_share,
    ROUND(q.damaged_qty / NULLIF(q.received_qty, 0), 4)::NUMBER(9, 4) AS damage_rate,
    q.discrepancy_codes::ARRAY AS discrepancy_codes
  FROM quarterly AS q
)

    ROUND(MEDIAN(t.minutes_to_first_response), 2)::NUMBER(10, 2) AS p50_minutes_to_first_response,
    ROUND(
      PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.business_minutes_to_response),

statements.sql:
WITH answers AS (

  FROM rel__int_survey_answers_flat

responses AS (

    a.survey_code,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', a.submitted_at))::DATE AS response_month,
    MAX(a.nps_group) AS nps_group,
    COUNT_IF(a.answer_kind = 'text') AS free_text_answers
  FROM answers AS a
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2,
    3
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      r.survey_code || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(r.response_month, 'YYYY-MM')
    )::VARCHAR AS nps_key,
    r.survey_code,
    r.response_month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.response_id)::INT AS responses,
    COUNT_IF(r.nps_group = 'promoter')::INT AS promoters,
    COUNT_IF(r.nps_group = 'passive')::INT AS passives,
    COUNT_IF(r.nps_group = 'detractor')::INT AS detractors,
    ROUND(
      100
      * (
        COUNT_IF(r.nps_group = 'promoter') - COUNT_IF(r.nps_group = 'detractor')
      )
      / NULLIF(COUNT(r.nps_group), 0),
      2
    )::NUMBER(6, 2) AS net_promoter_score,
    SUM(r.free_text_answers)::INT AS free_text_answers
  FROM responses AS r

WITH picks AS (

daily_picks AS (

    COUNT(DISTINCT p.picker_id) AS pickers,
    SUM(p.units_picked) AS units_picked,
    SUM(p.active_hours) AS active_hours,
    MAX_BY(p.picker_id, p.units_per_hour) AS top_picker_id,
    BOOLOR_AGG(p.is_holiday) AS is_holiday
  FROM picks AS p
  GROUP BY
    p.warehouse_code,
    p.work_date_local
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      d.warehouse_code || ':' || TO_VARCHAR(d.work_date_local, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

    d.warehouse_code,
    d.work_date_local,
    d.pickers::INT AS pickers,
    d.units_picked::INT AS units_picked,
    ROUND(d.units_picked / NULLIF(d.active_hours, 0), 2)::NUMBER(10, 2) AS units_per_picker_hour,
    d.top_picker_id::VARCHAR AS top_picker_id,
    s.utilisation AS slot_utilisation,
    d.is_holiday::BOOLEAN AS is_holiday
  FROM daily_picks AS d
  LEFT JOIN slots AS s
    ON d.warehouse_code = s.warehouse_code

statements.name: stg_carrier_webhooks
statements.sql:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__fulfilment__carrier_webhooks
),

parsed AS (
  SELECT
    w.webhook_id,
    w.carrier_code,
    w.received_at,
    TRY_PARSE_JSON(w.body) AS payload
  FROM src AS w
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w.webhook_id ORDER BY w._loaded_at DESC) = 1
),

single_updates AS (
  SELECT
    p.webhook_id,
    0 AS update_index,
    p.carrier_code,
    p.received_at,
    p.payload AS update_payload,
    FALSE AS is_batched
  FROM parsed AS p
  WHERE
    p.payload IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT COALESCE(IS_ARRAY(p.payload:events), FALSE)
),

batched_updates AS (
  SELECT
    p.webhook_id,
    e.index AS update_index,
    p.carrier_code,
    p.received_at,
    e.value AS update_payload,
    TRUE AS is_batched
  FROM parsed AS p, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => p.payload:events) AS e
  WHERE IS_ARRAY(p.payload:events)
),

all_updates AS (
  SELECT
    s.webhook_id,
    s.update_index,
    s.carrier_code,
    s.received_at,
    s.update_payload,
    s.is_batched
  FROM single_updates AS s
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    b.webhook_id,
    b.update_index,
    b.carrier_code,
    b.received_at,
    b.update_payload,
    b.is_batched
  FROM batched_updates AS b
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      u.webhook_id || ':' || u.update_index::VARCHAR
    )::VARCHAR AS carrier_update_key,
    u.webhook_id,
    UPPER(u.carrier_code)::VARCHAR AS carrier_code,
    u.received_at,
    UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(
      COALESCE(u.update_payload:tracking_number, u.update_payload:trackingNumber)::VARCHAR,
      '[^A-Za-z0-9]',
      ''
    ))::VARCHAR AS tracking_number,
    UPPER(
      COALESCE(u.update_payload:status.code, u.update_payload:event)::VARCHAR
    )::VARCHAR AS status_code,
    TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(
      COALESCE(u.update_payload:status.at, u.update_payload:timestamp)::VARCHAR
    ) AS status_at,
    TRY_TO_NUMBER(u.update_payload:event_id::VARCHAR)::NUMBER(38, 0) AS carrier_event_id,
    u.is_batched
  FROM all_updates AS u
)

SELECT *
FROM final

    FALSE AS is_legacy
  FROM cdc_latest AS c
), legacy_profiles AS (
  SELECT
    p.customer_id,
    p.created_at,
    p.profile
  FROM customers AS p
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.customer_id ORDER BY p._seq DESC) = 1
    AND p._op <> 'D'
), legacy_consents AS (
  SELECT
    (
      'legacy:' || l.customer_id || ':' || UPPER(f.value::VARCHAR)
    ) AS consent_id,
    l.customer_id,
    UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(
      f.value::VARCHAR,
      '[^A-Za-z]+',
      '_'
    )) AS consent_type,
    TRUE AS is_granted,
    l.created_at AS captured_at,
    'profile' AS capture_surface,
    NULL AS policy_version,
    TRUE AS is_legacy
  FROM legacy_profiles AS l, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => l.profile:consents) AS f
), legacy_only AS (
  SELECT
    lc.consent_id,
    lc.customer_id,
    lc.consent_type,
    lc.is_granted,
    lc.captured_at,
    lc.capture_surface,
    lc.policy_version,
    lc.is_legacy
  FROM legacy_consents AS lc
  LEFT JOIN explicit_consents AS ec
    ON lc.customer_id = ec.customer_id
    AND lc.consent_type = ec.consent_type
  WHERE ec.consent_id IS NULL
), final AS (
  SELECT
    e.consent_id,
    e.customer_id,
    e.consent_type::VARCHAR AS consent_type,
    e.is_granted,
    e.captured_at,
    e.capture_surface::VARCHAR AS capture_surface,
    e.policy_version::VARCHAR AS policy_version,
    e.is_legacy
  FROM explicit_consents AS e
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    l.consent_id::VARCHAR AS consent_id,
    l.customer_id,
    l.consent_type::VARCHAR AS consent_type,
    l.is_granted,
    l.captured_at,
    l.capture_surface::VARCHAR AS capture_surface,
    l.policy_version::VARCHAR AS policy_version,
    l.is_legacy
  FROM legacy_only AS l
)
SELECT *
FROM final

  FROM rel__stg_product_variants

  SELECT
    v.sku,
    b.index::INT AS barcode_index,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(
      b.value::VARCHAR,
      '[^0-9]',
      ''
    ) AS digits
  FROM variants AS v, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => v.barcodes) AS b
),

unambiguous AS (
  SELECT
    a.sku,
    a.digits,
    MIN(a.barcode_index) AS barcode_index
  FROM array_barcodes AS a
  WHERE a.digits <> ''
  GROUP BY
    a.sku,
    a.digits
  QUALIFY COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY a.digits) = 1
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    u.digits::VARCHAR AS barcode,
    u.sku,
    CASE LENGTH(u.digits)
      WHEN 13
      THEN 'EAN13'
      WHEN 12
      THEN 'UPCA'
      WHEN 8
      THEN 'EAN8'
      ELSE 'OTHER'
    END::VARCHAR AS symbology,
    (
      u.barcode_index = 0
    ) AS is_primary
  FROM unambiguous AS u
)

statements.name: stg_shipment_tracking_events
statements.sql:
WITH shipments AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_shipments
),

exceptions AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_delivery_exceptions
),

scans AS (
  SELECT
    s.shipment_id,
    e.index::INT AS event_sequence,
    e.value:code::VARCHAR AS raw_code,
    COALESCE(TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(e.value:ts::VARCHAR), TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(
      e.value:ts::VARCHAR,
      'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI TZHTZM'
    )) AS event_at,
    e.value:location::VARCHAR AS raw_location
  FROM shipments AS s, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => s.tracking_events) AS e
),

scan_events AS (
  SELECT
    (
      s.shipment_id || ':' || s.event_sequence::VARCHAR
    ) AS tracking_event_key,
    s.shipment_id,
    'scan' AS event_source,
    UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(s.raw_code, '[^A-Za-z_]', '')) AS event_code,
    s.event_at,
    INITCAP(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(s.raw_location, ',', 1))) AS location_text,
    UPPER(
      REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.raw_location, ',\\s*([A-Za-z]{2})\\s*$', 1, 1, 'e', 1)
    ) AS location_country_code,
    s.event_sequence
  FROM scans AS s
),

exception_events AS (
  SELECT
    (
      x.shipment_id || ':x:' || x.exception_id
    ) AS tracking_event_key,
    x.shipment_id,
    'exception' AS event_source,
    (
      'EXCEPTION_' || x.exception_code
    ) AS event_code,
    x.occurred_at AS event_at,
    NULL AS location_text,
    NULL AS location_country_code,
    NULL AS event_sequence
  FROM exceptions AS x
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    se.tracking_event_key::VARCHAR AS tracking_event_key,
    se.shipment_id,
    se.event_source::VARCHAR AS event_source,
    se.event_code::VARCHAR AS event_code,
    se.event_at,
    se.location_text::VARCHAR AS location_text,
    se.location_country_code::VARCHAR AS location_country_code,
    se.event_sequence::INT AS event_sequence
  FROM scan_events AS se
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    ee.tracking_event_key::VARCHAR AS tracking_event_key,
    ee.shipment_id,
    ee.event_source::VARCHAR AS event_source,
    ee.event_code::VARCHAR AS event_code,
    ee.event_at,
    ee.location_text::VARCHAR AS location_text,
    ee.location_country_code::VARCHAR AS location_country_code,
    ee.event_sequence::INT AS event_sequence
  FROM exception_events AS ee
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: stg_suppliers
statements.sql:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__catalogue__suppliers
),

cdc_versions AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM src
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_code ORDER BY _seq DESC) = 1
),

cdc_latest AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM cdc_versions
  WHERE _op <> 'D'
),

contacts AS (
  SELECT
    s.supplier_code,
    c.value:email::VARCHAR AS contact_email,
    COALESCE(c.value:is_primary::BOOLEAN, FALSE) AS is_primary,
    c.index AS contact_index
  FROM cdc_latest AS s, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => s.contacts, outer => TRUE) AS c
), primary_contacts AS (
  SELECT
    c.supplier_code,
    c.contact_email,
    COUNT(c.contact_email) OVER (PARTITION BY c.supplier_code) AS contact_count
  FROM contacts AS c
  QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.supplier_code ORDER BY c.is_primary DESC, c.contact_index) = 1
), final AS (
  SELECT
    UPPER(s.supplier_code)::VARCHAR AS supplier_code,
    s.supplier_name,
    UPPER(s.country_code)::VARCHAR AS country_code,
    COALESCE(s.payment_terms:net_days::INT, TRY_TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(
      s.payment_terms:label::VARCHAR,
      'NET\\s*([0-9]+)',
      1,
      1,
      'ie',
      1
    )))::INT AS payment_terms_days,
    s.payment_terms:early_discount_pct::NUMBER(5, 2) AS early_payment_discount_pct,
    IFF(
  REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(pc.contact_email)), '^[a-z0-9._%+-]+@[a-z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}$'),
  REGEXP_REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(pc.contact_email)), '\\+[^@]*@', '@'),
  NULL
) AS primary_contact_email,
    pc.contact_count::INT AS contact_count,
    s.payment_terms::OBJECT AS payment_terms,
    s._seq AS source_seq,
  TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(s._loaded_at) AS source_loaded_at
  FROM cdc_latest AS s
  LEFT JOIN primary_contacts AS pc
    ON s.supplier_code = pc.supplier_code
)
SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: stg_ticket_tags
statements.sql:
WITH tickets AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_tickets
),

array_tags AS (
  SELECT
    t.ticket_id,
    f.value::VARCHAR AS raw_tag
  FROM tickets AS t, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => t.tag_list) AS f
  WHERE f.value IS NOT NULL
),

label_tags AS (
  SELECT
    t.ticket_id,
    s.value::VARCHAR AS raw_tag
  FROM tickets AS t, LATERAL FLATTEN(input => SPLIT(
    t.custom_fields:labels::VARCHAR,
    ','
  )) AS s
  WHERE t.custom_fields:labels IS NOT NULL
),

combined AS (
  SELECT
    a.ticket_id,
    LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(a.raw_tag), '[\\s_]+', '-')) AS tag
  FROM array_tags AS a
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT
    l.ticket_id,
    LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(l.raw_tag), '[\\s_]+', '-')) AS tag
  FROM label_tags AS l
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      c.ticket_id || ':' || c.tag
    )::VARCHAR AS ticket_tag_key,
    c.ticket_id,
    c.tag::VARCHAR AS tag
  FROM combined AS c
  WHERE c.tag <> ''
)

SELECT *
FROM final

), REGEXP_SUBSTR(

))::VARCHAR AS contact_reason,

cart_events AS (

final AS (

  REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM((i.value:sku::VARCHAR)), '\\s+', ''),

)) AS sku,
    (
      IFF(c.action = 'add', 1, -1) * COALESCE(i.value:quantity::INT, 1)

WITH web_events AS (

steps AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    e.anonymous_id,
    e.event_at_utc,
    COALESCE(
      e.properties:step::INT,
      TRY_TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(e.page_path, '/checkout/step-([0-9])', 1, 1, 'e', 1))
    ) AS step_number,
    LOWER(e.properties:step_name::VARCHAR) AS step_name,
    LOWER(e.properties:payment_option::VARCHAR) AS payment_option
  FROM web_events AS e
  WHERE
    e.event_type IN ('checkout_step', 'checkout_started')
    AND e.anonymous_id IS NOT NULL
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      s.anonymous_id || '#' || s.step_number::VARCHAR
    )::VARCHAR AS checkout_step_key,
    s.anonymous_id,
    s.step_number::INT AS step_number,
    s.step_name::VARCHAR AS step_name,
    s.event_at_utc AS first_reached_at_utc,
    s.payment_option::VARCHAR AS payment_option
  FROM steps AS s
  WHERE s.step_number IS NOT NULL
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY s.anonymous_id, s.step_number
      ORDER BY s.event_at_utc, s.event_id
    ) = 1

statements.name: stg_web_events
statements.sql:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__clickstream__web_events
),

deduplicated AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    e.received_at,
    e.event
  FROM src AS e
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.event_id ORDER BY e._loaded_at DESC) = 1
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    d.event_id,
    d.received_at,
    LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(
      d.event:type::VARCHAR,
      '[^A-Za-z]+',
      '_'
    ))::VARCHAR AS event_type,
    COALESCE(
      TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ((d.event:ts_ms::NUMBER(38, 0)), 3),
      d.received_at
    ) AS event_at_utc,
    LOWER(d.event:anonymous_id::VARCHAR)::VARCHAR AS anonymous_id,
    NULLIF(
  TRIM(STRIP_NULL_VALUE((d.event:user.id))::VARCHAR),
  ''
) AS customer_id,
    IFF(
  REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM((d.event:user.email::VARCHAR))), '^[a-z0-9._%+-]+@[a-z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}$'),
  REGEXP_REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM((d.event:user.email::VARCHAR))), '\\+[^@]*@', '@'),
  NULL
) AS user_email,
    d.event:page.url::VARCHAR AS page_url,
    (
      '/' || LTRIM(PARSE_URL(d.event:page.url::VARCHAR, 1)['path']::VARCHAR, '/')
    )::VARCHAR AS page_path,
    LOWER(PARSE_URL(d.event:page.referrer::VARCHAR, 1)['host']::VARCHAR)::VARCHAR AS referrer_host,
    d.event:context.ua::VARCHAR AS user_agent,
    REPLACE(
      d.event:context.locale::VARCHAR,
      '_',
      '-'
    )::VARCHAR AS locale,
    d.event:context.tz::VARCHAR AS client_timezone,
    COALESCE(REGEXP_LIKE(
      d.event:context.ua::VARCHAR,
      '.*(bot|crawler|spider|headless).*',
      'i'
    ), FALSE) AS is_bot,
    COALESCE(d.event:properties, OBJECT_CONSTRUCT())::OBJECT AS properties,
    COALESCE(d.event:items, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT())::ARRAY AS items
  FROM deduplicated AS d
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: stg_web_identifies
statements.sql:
WITH web_events AS (

identified AS (

    e.event_at_utc,
    COALESCE(e.properties:method::VARCHAR, e.event_type) AS identify_method
  FROM web_events AS e
  WHERE
    e.anonymous_id IS NOT NULL
    AND e.customer_id IS NOT NULL
    AND e.event_type IN ('identify', 'login', 'signup', 'order_completed')
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      i.anonymous_id || '>' || i.customer_id
    )::VARCHAR AS identity_link_key,
    i.anonymous_id,
    i.customer_id,
    MIN(i.event_at_utc) AS first_seen_at_utc,
    MAX(i.event_at_utc) AS last_seen_at_utc,
    COUNT(*)::INT AS event_count,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i.identify_method) WITHIN GROUP (
      ORDER BY i.identify_method
    )::ARRAY AS identify_methods
  FROM identified AS i
  GROUP BY
    i.anonymous_id,
    i.customer_id
)

FROM final

statements.name: stg_web_page_views
statements.sql:
WITH web_events AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__stg_web_events
),

page_views AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    e.anonymous_id,
    e.customer_id,
    e.event_at_utc,
    e.page_url,
    e.page_path,
    e.referrer_host,
    e.properties:title::VARCHAR AS page_title
  FROM web_events AS e
  WHERE
    e.event_type = 'page_view'
    AND NOT e.is_bot
    AND e.anonymous_id IS NOT NULL
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    p.event_id,
    p.anonymous_id,
    p.customer_id,
    p.event_at_utc AS viewed_at_utc,
    p.page_path,
    CASE
      WHEN p.page_path RLIKE '^/products?/.*'
      THEN 'product'
      WHEN p.page_path RLIKE '^/(c|category)/.*'
      THEN 'category'
      WHEN p.page_path RLIKE '^/checkout.*'
      THEN 'checkout'
      WHEN p.page_path IN ('/', '')
      THEN 'home'
      ELSE 'content'
    END::VARCHAR AS page_type,
    LAG(p.page_path) OVER (
      PARTITION BY p.anonymous_id
      ORDER BY p.event_at_utc, p.event_id
    )::VARCHAR AS previous_page_path,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.page_url, '[?&]utm_source=([^&#]+)', 1, 1, 'e', 1)::VARCHAR AS utm_source,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.page_url, '[?&]utm_medium=([^&#]+)', 1, 1, 'e', 1)::VARCHAR AS utm_medium,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(p.page_url, '[?&]utm_campaign=([^&#]+)', 1, 1, 'e', 1)::VARCHAR AS utm_campaign,
    p.referrer_host,
    p.page_title::VARCHAR AS page_title
  FROM page_views AS p
)

SELECT *
FROM final

    DATE_TRUNC('minute', e.event_at_utc) AS viewed_minute_utc,
    e.properties:list.name::VARCHAR AS list_name,
    e.properties:list.position::INT AS list_position
  FROM web_events AS e
  WHERE
    e.event_type = 'product_view'
    AND NOT e.is_bot
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    (
      v.anonymous_id || '|' || v.sku || '|' || TO_VARCHAR(v.viewed_minute_utc, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MI')
    )::VARCHAR AS product_view_key,
    v.anonymous_id,
    v.customer_id,
    v.sku,
    v.viewed_minute_utc,
    v.list_name::VARCHAR AS list_name,
    v.list_position
  FROM views AS v
  WHERE
    v.sku IS NOT NULL
    AND v.anonymous_id IS NOT NULL
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY v.anonymous_id, v.sku, v.viewed_minute_utc

statements.name: stg_wishlist_items

items AS (

    i.added_at,
    i.item_position
  FROM items AS i
  WHERE i.raw_sku IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT *
FROM final

statements.name: stg_wishlists
statements.sql:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM rel__storefront__wishlists
),

cdc_versions AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM src
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wishlist_id ORDER BY _seq DESC) = 1
),

cdc_latest AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM cdc_versions
  WHERE _op <> 'D'
),

final AS (
  SELECT
    w.wishlist_id,
    w.customer_id,
    w.created_at,
    COALESCE(w.is_public, FALSE) AS is_public,
    ARRAY_SIZE(COALESCE(w.items, ARRAY_CONSTRUCT()))::INT AS item_count,
    w.items::ARRAY AS items,
    w._seq AS source_seq,
  TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(w._loaded_at) AS source_loaded_at
  FROM cdc_latest AS w
)
SELECT *
FROM final
